source:
Campanīle
A #poetry thread
i.
A Roman church belfry,
gold cross reaching for clouds:
bell tolls, sets brass note free,
sings out through misty shroud,
its high peal an appeal
to the faithful long gone.
No more piety’s zeal:
many sunsetted dawns.
Its stone tower keeps watch
through the mask of dusk-rain,
skies loosing their barrage
upon roof tiles again.
🧵👇🏼
#poem #poemaday #moody #neoclassical #church #night #photography

ii.
Who pulled on the bell cord?
Lone monk in his cloister
with none left in accord.
He, grain in church oyster —
yet no cell holds his bed,
no dust stirred by his shoes,
his name never was said,
no old books that he used.
The bell rope hangs, worn, frayed,
gnawed by church mice’s teeth.
It’s been long since it swayed,
pulled by hands underneath.
🧵👇🏼

iii.
The night wind whispers psalms
and breathes canticles’ chant
to swing the clapper of bronze,
I answer in descant —
but not with my own voice.
The wind swallows my call,
chimes its own holy noise
with the hands of its squall.
✋🏼🧵
hypothesis:
Campanīle
Utas #puisi
i.
Menara lonceng sebuah gereja di Roma,
salib emas menggapai awan:
lonceng berdentang, melepas nada kuningan,
bernyanyi menembus selubung kabut,
dentang nyaringnya jadi seruan
untuk umat yang sudah lama pergi.
Tak ada lagi kobar kesalehan:
banyak fajar sudah terbenam.
Menara batunya tetap berjaga
di balik topeng hujan senja,
langit melepas gempurannya
ke atas genteng lagi.
🧵👇🏼
#puisi #puisiharian #sendu #neoklasik #gereja #malam #fotografi

ii.
Siapa yang menarik tali lonceng?
Biarawan sendirian di biaranya
tanpa siapa pun lagi yang seirama.
Dia, butir pasir dalam tiram gereja —
tapi tak ada kamar biara menyimpan ranjangnya,
tak ada debu yang terusik oleh sepatunya,
namanya tak pernah disebut,
tak ada buku tua yang pernah ia pakai.
Tali lonceng menggantung, aus, terurai,
digerogoti gigi tikus-tikus gereja.
Sudah lama ia tak berayun,
ditarik tangan-tangan dari bawah.
🧵👇🏼

iii.
Angin malam membisikkan mazmur
dan mengembuskan lantunan kidung pujian
untuk mengayun bandul perunggu,
aku menyahut dengan melodi tandingan —
tapi bukan dengan suaraku sendiri.
Angin menelan seruanku,
mendentangkan riuh sucinya sendiri
dengan tangan-tangan badainya.
✋🏼🧵

Vega the Digital Dragon surprises a trio of mischievous scamps who snuck into her arcade in the middle of the night but one of them recognizes her as a town superhero and they end up having a heartwarming moment geeking out over video games. Unfortunately, the moment is interrupted by somebody or something landing on the roof of the arcade... 1/?

Vega goes to investigate and finds Dr. Vesper, in his monstrous bat form that the press has dubbed the "Gargoyle Man," along with a harpy-like creature that Vesper describes as his "little protegee." Vesper says that they have come to introduce themselves and invite Vega to join their society of man-creature misfits that is led by "The Madame," Dr. Diana Laughton of the Laughton Institute. 2/?

source:
In a surprise Inspector Clouseau twist, I now have an extra thing to investigate for Spooky Kitties Sciences!
I was doing a quick scroll through the evenings secondary camera video, when I spotted a curious The Inspector standing on the trunk of the tree near the feeding station. Kept jumping around, finding him near where the magpies had been, so I initially suspect(edit) he was simply chasing them as they sometimes let him do, until I randomly chance stop...
#SpookyKittiesSciences

There Inspector Clouseau was, rolling around like crazing about 2 meters NE of the tree, mostly hidden by the unfortunate placement of the awnings east post. Still, there he was for 5 minutes, at which point he ran back up the tree, walked across the lawn to the hill, flattened himself at the bottom, and then ran off camera, presumably in the middle of The Zoomies.
2/
#SpookyKittiesSciences

Now, as some of my Spooky Kitties Sciences readers may know, the motivations behind that tests are not just to entertain the kitties. While the most important aspect is the genuine curiosity I had seeing the kitties rolling around in the snow, I really wanted to find something that The Inspector liked. I came out of the initial testing with only a single moment to hint that he liked something. What that was is still a mystery.
3/
#SpookyKittiesSciences
hypothesis:
Dengan twist Inspector Clouseau yang mengejutkan, sekarang aku punya satu hal lagi yang perlu diselidiki untuk Spooky Kitties Sciences!
Aku lagi scroll cepat-cepat video kamera sekunder malam itu, ketika aku melihat The Inspector berdiri dengan penasaran di batang pohon dekat stasiun pemberian makan. Dia terus loncat-loncat, aku nemuin dia di dekat tempat para murai tadi berada, jadi awalnya aku curiga(edit) dia cuma lagi mengejar mereka seperti yang kadang-kadang mereka biarkan dia lakukan, sampai aku secara kebetulan berhenti secara acak...
#IlmuKucingMenyeramkan

Di sanalah Inspector Clouseau, berguling-guling seperti gila sekitar 2 meter di sebelah timur laut pohon, sebagian besar tersembunyi di balik tiang timur kanopi yang sayangnya menghalangi. Tapi dia tetap ada di sana selama 5 menit, setelah itu dia lari kembali ke atas pohon, berjalan menyeberangi halaman menuju bukit, merebahkan dirinya di bagian bawah, lalu lari keluar dari kamera, kemungkinan lagi dalam kondisi The Zoomies.
2/
#IlmuKucingMenyeramkan

Nah, seperti yang mungkin diketahui beberapa pembaca Spooky Kitties Sciences-ku, motivasi di balik tes-tes itu bukan sekadar untuk menghibur para kucing. Meskipun aspek yang paling penting adalah rasa penasaran nyata yang aku rasakan saat melihat para kucing berguling-guling di salju, aku benar-benar ingin menemukan sesuatu yang disukai The Inspector. Dari hasil pengujian awal, aku hanya mendapat satu momen kecil yang mengisyaratkan bahwa dia menyukai sesuatu. Apa itu masih menjadi misteri.
3/
#IlmuKucingMenyeramkan

source:
Today's Sunday Best features my Knight from Ragnarok Online! This was my very first online PC game, he was an agi/dex 2HQ knight w/ a set of elemental claymores. I played on iRO Loki, and had two drawings featured as loadscreen art!
My online handle stems from this guy. O'Reiley -> Reiley -> Rally

Coming in just under the wire on today's Sunday Best, it's my Deep Rock Galactic Engineer! The loadout I ran most of the time was Executioner LOK-1 & RJ-250 Grenade Launcher. I think the LOK-1 is one of the coolest weapon designs in an FPS, a lock-on mechanic that encouraged finesse & deep mastery.

This week's Sunday Best is my Xenoverse OC, Parma (for parmesan cheese). She had a partner named Brie. Parma dressed up to match the teachers she studied under, but her final fit reflected the one she started with, styled to match this one pair of gloves. She used Giant Storm & Double Sunday a lot.

For my Sunday Best I drew my Paxultek from Remnant II. The goal of my build was to make the damage number from a single shot as large as possible. I used a Widowmaker single-shot elephant rifle we nicknamed The Governor. It was so strong it one-shot teammates through friendly fire damage reduction.

Today's Sunday Best features my funny gay dog lady from Webfishing. Her voice had a deeper, slower pitch so she sounded old & chill. One time I joined a full server, sat somewhere & started posting practical life advice, bits of big-sister wisdom, & the whole server found me & sat with me to listen.

It's Sunday, today's feature is my Darktide Zealot. Her name is Callista, she's chasing sainthood to be pardoned of her many crimes so she won't have to apologize for any of them. She has black dreams full of teeth and is constantly flirting with female Loner Psykers. She's unwell, but Female Loose Cannon Veterans think it's endearing and constantly hit on her for it. Their in-game voices say all of this.

Today's Sunday Best feature is QP from 100% Orange Juice! I played OJ a lot with my fighting game friends; for some reason I'd always have the hand pictured here. We used to post in text chat during games and I'd always say, Do NOT test me. I played so much QP the devs awarded me a special QP badge!

This week's Sunday Best is "Local Psychopath," Fem Boss #1 from Saint's Row 3. This was the first game I wanted to use the create-a-feature to make a character who blended in with the cast and looked like a genuine member of the Third Street Saints. I picked 3 cuz my favorite jacket wasn't in 4. :(

For today's Sunday Best I've got my Animal Crossing Villager to share. My favorite way to play these games is as part of a global cartel of goons who shared their wealth. When one person had big Turnips, everyone got paid. No profiteering; you need a rare item to make your room idea work? We got you.

It's technically Sunday, and this week's fit lands a bit early! I don't Tekken very often, but when I do I like to pick Steve and do all his slippery punches. In Tekken 7 he had a loose-fit, full-body track suit, so I made him into a deer man. When he's in Peekaboo Stance the antlers point forward!

This week's Sunday Best feature is Gaige from Borderlands 2. Pure Anarchy is one of the coolest FPS mechanics in the genre, an escalating accumulation of power that came with a diminishing level of control, lowering both TTK & effective range. Ride the wave & figure it out on the fly, it'll be fine.
Gaige's voice actress plays V in Cyberpunk 2077, I learned recently. An old friend.

Today's Sunday Best isn't a person, it's a plane from an old Vlambeer game called Luftrausers! The music changes to match your airplane. My favorite configuration is called "Shipwreck," a sword-hulled amphibious prop plane with shotgun cannons, it can divebomb through boats & burst up from the sea.

Tonight our Sunday Best feature is the Houndmaster from a charming Crawl-like sidescroller called Vagante. Lovingly referred to as the Dogmancer, I loved to spec into skills that increased damage when you threw the dog at monsters. The dog roams on its own, but you can also carry it on your back!

For this week's Sunday Best we're going all the way back to Cyborg Justice on the Genesis. I played this game a lot and I always liked to make this one guy: round torso, big stampy feet and the buzzsaw hand. I always remember the magazine ad for this game vividly; you might too if you're of an age.

I did a bit of archaeological research to uncover references for this week's Sunday Best. This was my guy from Loadout, a third-person arena shooter about fiddly weapon customization. My main gun was an electric pulse cannon called "Kill-a-Watts" and the backup was a flaming LMG named "Roast Beef."

Nama online-ku berasal dari dia. O'Reiley -> Reiley -> Rally

Masuk dalam daftar “Sunday Best” hari ini, inilah karakter Deep Rock Galactic Engineer milik saya! Senjata yang paling sering saya gunakan adalah Executioner LOK-1 dan RJ-250 Grenade Launcher. Menurut saya, LOK-1 merupakan salah satu desain senjata terkeren dalam genre FPS; mekanisme “lock-on”-nya mendorong pemain untuk menggunakan teknik yang tepat dan menguasai senjata tersebut dengan baik.

Sunday Best minggu ini adalah Xenoverse OC saya, Parma (untuk keju parmesan). Ia memiliki pasangan bernama Brie. Parma berdandan agar cocok dengan guru-gurunya, tetapi penampilan terakhirnya merefleksikan penampilan awal, yang didesain agar cocok dengan sepasang sarung tangan ini. Ia menggunakan Giant Storm & Double Sunday secara ekstensif.

Untuk Sunday Best saya, saya menggambar Paxultek dari Remnant II. Tujuan dari build saya adalah untuk membuat jumlah kerusakan dari satu tembakan sebanyak mungkin. Saya menggunakan senjata Widowmaker, senjata singa tunggal yang kami juluki Gubernur. Senjata itu sangat kuat sehingga bisa menembak mati teman satu tim lewat pengurangan kerusakan tembakan teman sendiri.

Sunday Best hari ini menampilkan wanita anjing lucu saya dari Webfishing. Suaranya memiliki nada yang lebih dalam dan lebih lambat sehingga terdengar tua dan tenang. Suatu kali saya bergabung dengan server penuh, duduk di suatu tempat dan mulai memposting nasihat kehidupan praktis, sedikit kebijaksanaan kakak perempuan, dan seluruh server menemukan saya dan duduk bersama saya untuk mendengarkan.

Hari Minggu, fitur hari ini adalah Darktide Zealot saya. Namanya Callista, dia mengejar status suci untuk diampuni atas banyak kejahatannya sehingga dia tidak perlu meminta maaf atas kejahatan-kejahatan tersebut. Dia memiliki mimpi-mimpi hitam yang penuh dengan gigi dan terus-menerus menggoda Psykers Loner perempuan. Dia sedang tidak sehat, tetapi Veteran Loose Cannon Perempuan menganggap itu menggemaskan dan terus-menerus menggoda dia untuk itu. Suara dalam game mereka mengatakan semua ini.

Sunday Best hari ini menghadirkan QP dari 100% Orange Juice! Aku sering bermain OJ bersama teman-teman game pertarungan ku; entah kenapa tanganku selalu terlihat seperti gambar di sini. Dulu kami biasa berkomentar via teks chat selama pertandingan dan aku selalu berkata JANGAN UJI AKU! Aku memainkan QP sebanyak-banyaknya hingga pengembang memberikan lencana QP khusus buat ku!

Fitur Sunday Best minggu ini adalah "Psychopath Lokal," Bos Wanita #1 dari Saint's Row 3. Ini adalah game pertama yang ingin saya gunakan fitur buat-karakter untuk membuat karakter yang berbaur dengan pemain dan terlihat seperti anggota asli Third Street Saints. Saya memilih 3 karena jaket favorit saya tidak ada di 4. :(

Untuk Sunday Best hari ini, saya akan membagikan Villager Animal Crossing saya. Cara favorit saya untuk memainkan game-game ini adalah sebagai bagian dari sebuah kartel global yang terdiri dari para bajingan yang membagi kekayaan mereka. Ketika satu orang memiliki Lobak Besar, semua orang dibayar. Tidak ada untung-untungan; kamu butuh barang langka untuk membuat ide kamarmu berhasil? Kami punya kamu.

Ini hari Minggu, dan kostum minggu ini datang sedikit lebih awal! Saya tidak terlalu sering bermain Tekken, tetapi ketika saya bermain, saya suka memilih Steve dan melakukan semua pukulan licinnya. Di Tekken 7 dia mengenakan setelan olahraga longgar yang menutupi seluruh tubuh, jadi saya membuatnya menjadi manusia rusa. Saat berada dalam Posisi Peekaboo, tanduknya mengarah ke depan!

Sunday Best mingguan kali ini menampilkan Gaige dari Borderlands 2. Pure Anarchy merupakan salah satu mekanik FPS paling keren dalam genrenya; akumulasi kekuatan bertahap yang datang dengan penurunan kontrol sekaligus mengurangi TTK & jangkauan efektif sambil tetap melaju gelombang & menyelesaikan masalah secara spontanistis itu akan teratasi.
Aktres suara Gaige memerankan V di Cyberpunk 2077 baru saja kutahu sebentar lalu kemarin Teman lama.

Sunday Best hari ini bukan orang, melainkan pesawat dari game lama Vlambeer yang dinamakan Luftrausers! Musiknya berubah sesuai dengan pesawat kamu. Konfigurasi favorit saya dinamakan "Shipwreck," sebuah pesawat amfibi dengan lambung berhiaskan pedang dan meriam senjata otomatis, bisa menembak jatuh kapal dan menembus dari laut.

Sunday Best malam ini adalah Houndmaster dari permainan sidescroller bernama Vagante yang sangat menarik. Saya suka sekali memainkan peran sebagai Dogmancer, dan menyukai berbagai skill yang bisa meningkatkan damage saat kamu melempar anjing ke monster. Anjing ini berkelana dengan sendirinya, tetapi kamu juga bisa membawanya di punggungmu!

Untuk fitur Sunday Best minggu ini, kita akan bernostalgia ke Cyborg Justice di Genesis. Saya banyak memainkan game ini dan saya selalu menyukai satu karakter: tubuh bulat, kaki besar yang kokoh, dan tangan gergaji. Saya masih ingat dengan jelas iklan majalah untuk game ini; Anda mungkin juga masih ingat jika Anda seumuran dengan saya.

Saya melakukan sedikit penelitian arkeologi untuk menemukan referensi untuk Minggu Terbaik minggu ini. Ini adalah karakter saya di Loadout, penembak arena third-person tentang kustomisasi senjata yang rumit. Senjata utama saya adalah meriam pulsa listrik yang disebut "Kill-a-Watts" dan cadangan adalah LMG yang berapi-api bernama "Roast Beef."

@JugglingWithEggs at least in my friend circle mobile phones not uncommon from early 90s, but they cost a *lot* to call from a landline (so if you were living at home your parents would discourage it), and until 1995-1999 were insecure, anyone with a radio scanner could (and often did) listen to them.
Whilst radio scanners were out of the price range of youths, many older folk had them, and until late 90s were often the kind of radio enthusiast who was a Tory bootlicker and supported the Police and other Establishment organisations, so you if discussing anything subversive on a mobile phone you risked being grassed up..
Ironically the tide turned by late 90s when scanners became affordable, and the Police were still on analogue radios 😁

@JugglingWithEggs by late 1990s everyone had a mobile phone and calls were cheaper (often with a good amount of free minutes) but SMS messages were unreliable and initially didn't even work across networks - people actually talked to each other on them!
One difference was access to physical spaces wasn't as heavily controlled as today - even though there was still CCTV and locals would call old bill on youths "hanging around", there was neither sufficient boots on the ground nor interconnected CCTV (a real security guard had to watch the footage locally, and property owners generally didn't want to pay for these folk at evenings and weekends.
There were also fewer cops on duty in outer suburbs during nights/weekends - they were all deployed into the town centres)

@vfrmedia
I remember texts sometimes taking hours to come through in the early noughties - so not always great for making on the fly arrangements.
Living in market town definitely meant less cctv and coppers back in 90’s. Remember difference when heading out into Bournemouth or Norwich of an evening. But young people having fun wasn’t frowned upon like it is now. My earlier post about facial recognition was about area where there has been uptick in teens just hanging out.
hypothesis:
@JugglingWithEggs setidaknya di lingkaran pertemanan saya, telepon seluler bukan hal yang aneh sejak awal 90-an, tetapi biayanya *sangat* mahal untuk menelepon dari telepon rumah (jadi jika Anda tinggal di rumah, orang tua Anda akan melarangnya), dan hingga tahun 1995-1999 tidak aman, siapa pun dengan pemindai radio dapat (dan sering kali) mendengarkannya.
Meskipun pemindai radio berada di luar jangkauan harga kaum muda, banyak orang yang lebih tua memilikinya, dan hingga akhir 90-an seringkali merupakan tipe penggemar radio yang penjilat Tory dan mendukung Polisi dan organisasi Pemerintah lainnya, jadi jika Anda membahas sesuatu yang subversif di telepon seluler, Anda berisiko dilaporkan.
Ironisnya, keadaan berbalik pada akhir 90-an ketika pemindai menjadi terjangkau, dan Polisi masih menggunakan radio analog 😁

@JugglingWithEggs pada akhir tahun 1990-an semua orang memiliki telepon seluler dan panggilan lebih murah (seringkali dengan banyak menit gratis) tetapi pesan SMS Tidak dapat diandalkan dan awalnya bahkan tidak berfungsi lintas jaringan - orang-orang benar-benar berbicara satu sama lain melalui jaringan tersebut!
Salah satu perbedaannya adalah akses ke ruang fisik tidak dikontrol seketat sekarang - meskipun masih ada CCTV dan penduduk setempat akan memanggil polisi jika ada pemuda yang "berkeliaran", tidak ada cukup petugas di lapangan maupun CCTV yang saling terhubung (seorang petugas keamanan sungguhan harus menonton rekaman secara lokal, dan pemilik properti umumnya tidak ingin membayar orang-orang ini di malam hari dan akhir pekan.
Juga ada lebih sedikit polisi yang bertugas di pinggiran kota pada malam hari/akhir pekan - mereka semua ditempatkan di pusat kota)

@vfrmedia
Aku ingat pesan teks kadang butuh berjam-jam baru masuk di awal 2000‑an – jadi nggak selalu cocok buat ngatur rencana dadakan.
Tinggal di kota pasar berarti CCTV dan polisi jauh lebih sedikit dulu di era 90‑an. Ingat beda suasana pas keluar sore hari ke Bournemouth atau Norwich. Tapi anak muda bersenang‑senang dulu nggak dianggap salah kayak sekarang. Postingan sebelumnya tentang face recognition sebenarnya soal daerah yang belakangan ini makin banyak remaja nongkrong.

painting with bazkie! 🧵 a (slow) thread [1/x]
I figured it'd be fun to share the whole process that goes into making a painting a custom scene. could be useful to some, and entertaining to others :)
👩‍🦱 ~ EVE & ADAM ~ 🧔‍♂️
as you all know, I'm a deeply religious person 🛐 so..
the scene: we're in the garden of eden. adam is eating apples from the forbidden tree, because of course he is. eve is having none of his shit, grabs an unfortunate unsuspecting nearby serpent, and is about to whip the shit out of adam. 🐍
#painting

painting with bazkie! 🧵 a (slow) thread [2/x]
so, we're gonna need reference photos. I want eve to be in the process of swinging the serpent around; so then I figured a baseball batter would be a good fit.
so wading through the AI slop, I found this actual photo that has a nice pose and good lighting.

painting with bazkie! 🧵 a (slow) thread [3/x]
I want adam to be in a protective stance, while also holding a forbidden apple, and all this, seen from the side/back. also, the lighting has to come from the same side as the batter. so all and all, it's pretty hard to find a proper reference pic for this, so I am posing for this one myself.
took about 20 pics with slightly different in stances etc., and decided on this one. (the right hand is going to hold the apple)
hypothesis:
Lukisan dengan Bazkie! 🧵 benang (yang lambat) [1/5] Saya pikir akan menyenangkan untuk berbagi seluruh proses pembuatan lukisan skenario khusus ini. Bisa berguna bagi beberapa orang dan menghibur bagi yang lain :) 👩🦱 ~ Hawa & Adam ~ 🧔♂️ Seperti yang kalian ketahui, saya adalah seorang yang sangat beragama 🛐 jadi.. Skena: Kita berada di Taman Eden. Adam sedang makan apel dari pohon terlarang karena tentunya dia melakukannya. Hawa tidak mau mendengar omong kosongnya itu, mengambil ular tak bersalah yang ada di dekatnya, dan hampir saja memukul Adam dengan keras. #Lukisan --- Lukisan dengan Bazkie!

melukis bareng bazkie! 🧵 sebuah thread (lambat) [2/x]
Jadi, kita butuh foto referensi. Aku ingin Eve dalam proses memutar-mutar ular; makanya aku pikir pemain bisbol bakal cocok.
Sambil menyaring tumpukan AI, akhirnya ketemu foto nyata dengan pose bagus dan pencahayaan oke.

melukis bareng bazkie! 🧵 sebuah thread (lambat) [3/x]
Aku mau Adam dalam posisi melindungi, sambil memegang apel terlarang, semua dilihat dari samping/belakang. Terus pencahayaannya harus datang dari sisi yang sama dengan pemukul. Jadi secara keseluruhan, susah banget nemuin foto referensi yang pas, makanya aku pose sendiri buat ini.
Mengambil sekitar 20 foto dengan sedikit variasi pose, terus pilih satu ini. (tangan kanan akan pegang apel)

Good Morning Worlds!
We are going to the tip this morning. It will clear some of the stuff we sorted yesterday from the drive. I don't think we can clear it all unless we took the trailer, but the trailer is full of steel for weighing in.
Later I might carry on packing tote crates.
#GoodMorningWorlds

Tip trip done, and another car load cleared out.
I have taken the new trailer axle, and trailer drive motor system, out of the scrap metal trailer load. That means we can get more scrap metal in there and also not accidentally weigh in the parts I want to keep.
I think, next, I will start moving the scrap steel from the back garden into the trailer so that it is ready to go.
Scrap steel prices are not very high at the moment but better than nothing, if I take enough of it in one go.
Still have to sort the non-ferrous scrap.

That thing when you are taking the rotten tyres off small, wide lawn tractor wheels....
Huge effort to unmount one side of the tyre, but it was really badly rusted tight on the other side of the rim.
In the time it took me to break the bead free, I'd forgotten I had already done the other side, and ended up with the rim free but completely inside the tyre!
I had to remount the tyre that side, and then work around it to get the rim out.
I had to cut up the inner tube to get that out too!
I wonder how many more tyres I need to unmount? Four done so far.

Selamat pagi dunia!
Pagi ini kita mau ke TPS. Lumayan buat ngangkut beberapa barang yang udah kita sortir kemarin dari jalan masuk rumah. Kayaknya sih nggak bakal bisa ngangkut semuanya kalau nggak bawa trailer, tapi trailernya lagi penuh besi buat ditimbang.
Nanti aku mungkin lanjut ngemas keranjang.
#SelamatPagiDunia

Udah kelar ke TPS, dan satu mobil penuh rongsokan udah berhasil diangkut.
Aku udah mindahin as trailer baru sama sistem motor penggerak trailernya dari muatan besi rongsok di trailer. Jadi kita bisa muat lebih banyak besi rongsok di sana, plus nggak bakal ketukar nimbangin onderdil yang mau aku simpan.
Kayaknya selanjutnya, aku mau mulai mindahin besi rongsok dari kebun belakang ke trailer biar siap berangkat.
Harga besi rongsok sih lagi nggak terlalu tinggi sekarang, tapi lumayanlah daripada nggak dapet sama sekali, asal aku bawa sekalian banyak.
Masih harus nyortir rongsokan logam non-besi juga.

Pernah ngerasain nggak sih pas lagi ngelepasin ban busuk dari roda traktor rumput yang kecil tapi lebar....
Susah payah ngelepasin satu sisi ban, tapi sisi velg satunya karatan parah dan nempel banget.
Saking lamanya ngotot ngelepasin pinggiran bannya, aku lupa kalau sisi satunya udah beres, eh ujung-ujungnya velgnya lepas tapi malah masuk utuh ke dalam ban!
Jadinya aku harus masang lagi ban di sisi itu, terus ngakalin dari sisi lain buat ngeluarin velgnya.
Aku juga harus motong-motong ban dalam biar bisa keluar!
Kira-kira berapa ban lagi ya yang harus aku lepas? Baru empat yang kelar nih.

project move out, spring break relay
day 1:
Cleared main bedroom closet
& contents of boxes on one wall.
I'm surveying all my belongings. Pulling out a small percentage to save. Sentimental items. Practical pieces for putting together a new life. At this stage I know I'm selecting more than I need, probably more than I can carry; but the amount that I'm leaving behind is far greater. Deciding what to keep & where comes after the survey. All the rest will be turned over to "scavengers."
#moverR

Day 2, midday break, Monday.
Today is harder than yesterday. I'm uncovering far more "sentimental" stuff. The challenge: these saved memories are a physical drag that impair rather than contribute anything practically to my future AND I feel integrated looking at them. There's a strong general condemnation, I feel, of holding onto sentimental items. Yet I know that they are powerful. But hey, I'm an artist. Even wistful, sad memories are valuable to me. I'm proceeding as before, retaining less+

+than I'm tossing, while knowing that I am keeping "too much." The next phase will be the actual moving & storing phase when more might be cut. This phase is the pre-screen before turning the cleared items over to others who will take everything away.
File under: how to move out of a home of 12 years & a home town of 45 years, with family roots here (& artifacts) from 150 years. I'm finally leaving, in search of a culture that suits my values.
#moverR

proyek pindahan, estafet liburan musim semi
hari 1:
Beresin lemari kamar tidur utama
& isi kardus-kardus di satu sisi dinding.
Aku lagi meriksa semua barangku. Misahin sebagian kecil buat disimpan. Barang-barang penuh kenangan. Barang-barang praktis buat menata hidup baru. Di tahap ini, aku tahu aku milih lebih banyak dari yang kubutuhin, mungkin lebih dari yang sanggup kubawa; tapi jumlah yang kutinggalin jauh lebih banyak. Keputusan soal apa yang mau disimpan & di mana bakal dipikirin setelah selesai meriksa. Sisanya bakal dikasih ke "pemulung".
#pindahanR

Hari 2, istirahat siang, Senin.
Hari ini lebih berat dibanding kemarin. Aku nemu jauh lebih banyak barang "penuh kenangan". Tantangannya: memori-memori yang disimpan ini jadi beban fisik yang malah ngehambat, bukannya ngebantu masa depanku secara praktis, DAN aku merasa utuh pas ngeliat barang-barang itu. Kayaknya ada pandangan negatif yang kuat tentang menyimpan barang-barang penuh kenangan. Tapi aku tahu barang-barang itu punya kekuatan tersendiri. Tapi ya namanya juga seniman. Bahkan kenangan yang sendu dan sedih pun berharga buatku. Aku lanjut kayak sebelumnya, nyimpen lebih sedikit+

+dari yang kubuang, padahal aku tahu aku masih nyimpen "kebanyakan". Tahap berikutnya baru deh proses pindahan & penyimpanan yang sebenarnya, di mana mungkin bakal ada barang yang dikurangin lagi. Tahap ini tuh semacam penyaringan awal sebelum nyerahin barang-barang yang udah dipilah ke orang lain yang bakal ngangkut semuanya.
Kategori: cara pindah dari rumah yang udah ditempatin selama 12 tahun & kampung halaman selama 45 tahun, dengan akar keluarga di sini (& barang peninggalan) sejak 150 tahun lalu. Akhirnya aku pergi juga, demi nyari budaya yang cocok sama nilai-nilai hidupku.
#pindahanR

(1/?)
@lorry
> Bumble is dire at Trust and Safety
Care to expand on that or link me?
> Whitney (Bumble) [is] a billionaire anyway, so what does she care?
I presume she didn't found Bumble by herself, maybe wasn't even part of the original group (as with Melon Husk and Tesla). What about the rest of them?
@screwlisp

(2/?)
@lorry
> I imagine there's still space for going back to the old model
There's plenty of new models to be tried that would be a huge improvement over playing hashtag roulette, either on DataFarms or decentralised social networks. One idea I saw was online dating as a group-based social experience. This is a handwave in the right direction. As is @cy's idea about matchmakers in another branch of this thread.

(3/?)
Speaking of roulette, what about a Chat Roulette style speed-dating app?
The app could;
* perform some basic T&S vetting (to minimise unsolicited dick-cam, etc), including confirming what general area you're in (ask me how!)
* throw you into a round of realtime speed dating with others in your area (text? Voice? Video? see 4/4).
* As with normal speed dating, if you both Favourite each other after talking, you get each others' contacts
#OnlineDating #ChatRoulette

@strypey I nearly joined #Chatroulette, but then Covid and the Ukraine war started, so that never went anywhere. I had a different direction I wanted to take them, though.
#Bumble #TrustAndSafety ? Well, the industry isn't exactly full of dating site whistleblowers, but safety workers in the industry do talk to me. I know more than I would ever want to know about the inside workings of most dating sites, and sadly. It's not really an amazing revelation that Bumble is as bad as the rest, though.
None of the dating sites puts more than a veneer of effort into T&S. They weigh the cost of litigation against the cost of actually doing the work, and so far, litigation costs have always been lower.

@lorry
> he industry isn't exactly full of dating site whistleblowers
Any particular reason for that?
> They weigh the cost of litigation against the cost of actually doing the work, and so far, litigation costs have always been lower
Huh. The Fight Club principle at work. Sad. We deserve better from our digital matchmaking tools.
hypothesis:
(1/?)
@lorry
> Bumble parah banget soal Trust and Safety (Kepercayaan & Keamanan)
Ada penjelasan lebih lanjut atau bisa kasih link buat aku?
> Whitney (Bumble) kan sudah jadi miliarder, jadi dia peduli apa?
Kayaknya dia bukan pendiri Bumble sendirian, mungkin malah bukan bagian dari tim awal (kayak Melon Husk dan Tesla). Terus gimana dengan yang lainnya?
@screwlisp

(2/?)
@lorry
> Aku rasa masih ada peluang buat balik ke model lama
Banyak banget model baru yang bisa dicoba dan bakal jauh lebih oke daripada main "hashtag roulette", baik di DataFarms maupun jaringan sosial terdesentralisasi. Ada satu ide yang pernah kulihat, yaitu kencan online sebagai pengalaman sosial berbasis kelompok. Ini langkah awal yang cukup menjanjikan. Sama juga dengan ide @cy soal mak comblang di cabang lain dari utas ini.

(3/?)
Ngomong-ngomong soal roulette, gimana kalau ada aplikasi kencan kilat ala Chat Roulette?
Aplikasinya bisa:
* melakukan pemeriksaan dasar Trust & Safety (untuk meminimalkan kiriman video alat kelamin tanpa izin, dll), termasuk memastikan area umum tempatmu berada (tanya aku caranya gimana!)
* mempertemukanmu dalam sesi kencan kilat secara real-time dengan orang lain di sekitarmu (via teks? Suara? Video? lihat poin 4/4).
* Seperti kencan kilat biasa, kalau kalian sama-sama saling kasih "Favorite" setelah ngobrol, kalian bisa saling tukar kontak.
#KencanOnline #ChatRoulette

@strypey Aku hampir gabung #Chatroulette, tapi terus muncul Covid dan perang Ukraina, jadi rencana itu nggak pernah terlaksana. Padahal aku punya arah berbeda yang pengen aku terapkan di sana.
#Bumble #TrustAndSafety? Yah, industri ini nggak banyak punya pelapor pelanggaran (whistleblower) dari situs kencan, tapi para pekerja keamanan di industri ini sering ngobrol sama aku. Aku tahu lebih banyak hal yang sebenarnya nggak pengin aku tahu soal cara kerja sebagian besar situs kencan, dan sayangnya... Nggak terlalu mengejutkan juga kalau Bumble ternyata sama buruknya kayak yang lain.
Nggak ada satu pun situs kencan yang benar-benar serius menangani Trust & Safety; mereka cuma kasih tampilan seolah-olah peduli. Mereka menimbang biaya tuntutan hukum dibanding biaya buat benar-benar melakukan pekerjaan itu, dan sejauh ini, biaya tuntutan hukum selalu lebih murah.

@lorry
> Industri ini nggak banyak punya pelapor pelanggaran dari situs kencan
Ada alasan khusus kenapa begitu?
> Mereka menimbang biaya tuntutan hukum dibanding biaya buat benar-benar melakukan pekerjaan itu, dan sejauh ini, biaya tuntutan hukum selalu lebih murah
Hah. Prinsip Fight Club lagi berlaku di sini. Sedih banget. Kita berhak dapat alat perjodohan digital yang lebih baik.

My brother in He-Who-Shall-Not-Be-Named, what you are describing is a consequence of _misogyny_, not "misandry."

I desperately need men to realize that just because it's directed at them and an actual serious problem doesn't mean it is "misandry."
Just saw someone describe being discriminated against _for being considered effeminate_ as "misandry" and I just.

It's not that you aren't experiencing something real. You very well may be. But it isn't "misandry." Because "misandry" doesn't exist.
Yes, this applies to trans men as well. "Transmisandry" _also_ isn't a thing and just contributes to anti-feminist narratives. It treats itself as a mirror of transmisogyny, but transmisogyny is _intersective_: we experience transphobia _and_ we experience misogyny _and_ we experience this unholy thing that happens when the two interact. It's not a subset, even an exclusive subset, it's an intersection.
But the following all are absolutely problems that can be talked about!
* Transphobia/Transmisia
* Antitransmasculity
* Transemasculation
* Misogyny
It sucks to be discriminated against, but the language that we use is so, so important here.
hypothesis:
Sumpah ya bro demi Dia-Yang-Namanya-Tak-Boleh-Disebut, yang lu ceritain itu tuh akibat dari _misogini_, bukan "misandri."

Gue butuh banget cowok-cowok pada sadar kalo cuma karena sesuatu itu ditujuin ke mereka dan emang beneran masalah serius, bukan berarti hal itu namanya "misandri."
Baru aja liat ada yang nyebut kalau didiskriminasi _gara-gara dianggap feminin_ itu sebagai "misandri" dan gue kayak.

Bukannya yang lu alamin itu nggak nyata. Bisa jadi lu emang ngalamin itu. Tapi itu bukan "misandri." Karena "misandri" tuh nggak ada.
Ya, ini juga berlaku buat cowok trans. "Transmisandri" itu _juga_ nggak ada dan cuma ngedukung narasi anti-feminis. Konsep ini seolah-olah jadi cerminan dari transmisogini, padahal transmisogini itu _intersektif_: kita ngalamin transfobia _dan_ kita ngalamin misogini _dan_ kita ngalamin hal kacau yang kejadian waktu dua hal ini gabung. Ini bukan subset, bahkan bukan subset eksklusif, tapi ini persimpangan.
Tapi semua hal di bawah ini tuh bener-bener masalah yang bisa banget diomongin!
* Transfobia/Transmisia
* Anti-transmaskulinitas
* Transemaskulasi
* Misogini
Emang ngeselin banget didiskriminasi, tapi bahasa yang kita pake itu penting, penting banget di sini.

I'm doing a eekly 1hr meeting where I'm going over with a director of engineering my soap box on managing a product management organization and actually it's coming out to be a pretty good episodic thing

Topics have been
- different types of product managers and the basic skill sets in developing requirements
- how product managers ensure an ongoing cadence for an engineering team
- dealing with product managers with varying backgrounds (engineering, data analyst, operational SME, consulting etc)
what's been fun is that this Director and I worked at a previous company with product managers that I didn't manage and I'm able to reference "hey remember that person? that person was awesome and here's why."

so in various email chains and slack threads I'll forward them to said director (if he's already not in there) and be like "ok a GOOD product manager would do THIS" and a "BAD product maanger would do THAT" rememember when so and so did THIS? that was good.
hypothesis:
Gue lagi ngadain meeting mingguan 1 jam sama seorang direktur engineering, isinya gue ceramah soal gimana ngelola organisasi manajemen produk, dan ternyata jadinya kayak serial yang lumayan oke.

Topik-topiknya udah mencakup:
- macem-macem tipe product manager dan skill dasar buat nyusun requirements
- gimana caranya product manager menjaga ritme kerja yang stabil buat tim engineering
- ngadepin product manager dari berbagai latar belakang (engineering, data analyst, SME operasional, konsultan, dll)
yang seru tuh, si Direktur ini sama gue pernah kerja bareng di perusahaan sebelumnya, di mana gue nggak ngemanage para PM-nya, jadi gue bisa ngomong, "eh, inget nggak sama si itu? orang itu keren banget, nih alasannya."

jadi di berbagai rangkaian email atau thread Slack, gue bakal terusin ke si direktur itu (kalau dia belum ada di situ) dan bilang, "oke, product manager yang BAGUS bakal ngelakuin INI" dan "product manager yang JELEK bakal ngelakuin ITU". inget nggak waktu si anu ngelakuin INI? nah, itu bagus.

Tinkering with my stereo system this week has got me thinking about an oddity that I've never been able to get to the bottom of...let's see if the Mastodon hive mine can help.
The amp is a Philips FA454 and the CD Player is a Philips CD150.
According to the amp manual I can connect the units with a "8-pole DIN to 5-pole DIN + 2 x single-pole CINCH" cable."
I take this to mean an 8 pin din to a 5 pin + stereo RCA cable...which sounds cursed.
Never been able to find one. Can anyone make one?

The service manual for the amp is nice and clear (picture 2 in above toot), but I can't find anything as nice for the CD player. I've attached a picture (picture 4 in the above toot) from the service manual that I *think* is the relevant section.
Currently I have the CD player hooked up with just the RCA cables and it all works fine, but if I could find/make the correct Din to Din + RCA cable then I could use some additional functionality and free up the only RCA stereo inputs on my amp.

There's a repair café this weekend in the town where I live...if I'm still puzzling over it all by then I might take it all along there and see if they can help me hack together a cable.
hypothesis:
Minggu ini aku lagi ngoprek sistem stereo dan jadi mikirin satu hal aneh yang nggak pernah ketemu jawabannya... coba deh lihat kalau warga Mastodon bisa bantu.
Amplinya Philips FA454 dan CD Player-nya Philips CD150.
Menurut manual amplinya, aku bisa nyambungin kedua alat ini pakai kabel "8-pole DIN to 5-pole DIN + 2 x single-pole CINCH".
Maksudnya kayaknya kabel DIN 8 pin ke 5 pin + RCA stereo... yang kedengerannya aneh banget.
Nggak pernah nemu yang kayak gitu. Ada yang bisa bikinin nggak?

Buku panduan servis buat amplinya sih jelas dan gampang dipahami (gambar 2 di toot atas), tapi aku nggak nemu yang sebagus itu buat CD Player-nya. Aku lampirin gambar (gambar 4 di toot atas) dari buku panduan servis yang *kayaknya* bagian yang relevan.
Sekarang CD Player-nya aku sambungin cuma pakai kabel RCA dan semuanya jalan normal, tapi kalau aku bisa nemu atau bikin kabel DIN ke DIN + RCA yang bener, aku bisa pakai fitur tambahan dan ngosongin satu-satunya input RCA stereo di ampliku.

Akhir pekan ini ada repair café di kotaku... kalau sampai nanti aku masih pusing mikirin ini, mungkin aku bawa aja semuanya ke sana dan lihat apa mereka bisa bantu ngakalin bikin kabelnya.

And being one of the weirdo, we just frequently get attacks here and there. Either online, offline, or even from your closest people. Those attacks usually stem from homophobia, transphobia, or sometimes just, don't like how weird we are and how weird we act, especially furries that do deeper immersions like roleplaying and therianthropy.

Hence some of us got safety by not needing to tell who we are and where we were from. Some of us got safety by only revealing ourselves to our friends or close friends. Face/body reveal is a culture that most of the furries did at least once in a private post, whether it be "delete soon" kind of post or in story.

Despite being so, we're still open for social interactions offline. We do furmeets—a personal meeting between furries, be it in a group or personal, be it in an event or just casually—and sometimes making a con/fur on, such as MWFF, IWAG, PAWAI, FURUM, and so on. It's fun to meet them offline, get to know each other, be able to see them in person as most of us have never seen each other's faces, take a photo to keep personally and censor publicly, laugh together and discuss similar interests, and so on. It's fun, social, and warm.

Although, things don't feel the same today. As people start trying to strip anonymity of people, attack furries, therian, LGBTQIA, and dox them, as how also our community participate and stir the dramas inside, things has been a little more chaotic, less warm, and less feeling like community or family. It's not the same anymore.

Part of me hopes things can return to how it feels in the 2000s and 2010s, but, I'll just let God do the rest. I'm a little hopeless in society and humans. I'm tired of how things get worse and meant to attack and divide small communities into a hopeless being. I don't like how society is now no longer respecting and being in unity.
hypothesis:
Dan menjadi salah satu orang aneh, kita sering dapat serangan di mana-mana. Baik secara daring, luring, atau bahkan dari orang terdekat. Serangan‑serangan itu biasanya berakar pada homofobia, transfobia, atau kadang cuma karena tidak suka betapa anehnya kita dan cara kita bertindak, terutama para furry yang melakukan imersi mendalam seperti roleplay dan therianthropy.

Karena itu, beberapa dari kami merasa aman dengan tidak perlu mengungkap siapa kami dan asal kami. Ada juga yang hanya memperlihatkan diri kepada teman atau sahabat dekat saja. Reveal wajah/tubuh sudah jadi budaya bagi kebanyakan furry setidaknya sekali dalam posting pribadi, entah itu posting “hapus segera” atau di story.

Meskipun begitu, kami tetap terbuka untuk interaksi sosial secara luring. Kami ngadain furmeet—pertemuan pribadi antar furry, baik dalam grup maupun satu‑on‑one, di acara atau sekadar nongkrong—dan kadang bikin kon/fur on seperti MWFF, IWAG, PAWAI, FURUM, dll. Seru banget ketemu mereka langsung, kenalan lebih akrab, bisa lihat muka mereka karena kebanyakan dari kami belum pernah melihat wajah satu sama lain, foto bareng buat disimpan pribadi dan sensor publik, ketawa bersama serta bahas minat yang sama, dan sebagainya. Itu menyenangkan, bersosial, dan hangat.

Tapi sekarang rasanya beda. Karena orang mulai mencoba mencoret anonimitas orang lain, menyerang furry, therian, LGBTQIA, serta doxing mereka—sementara komunitas kami sendiri juga ikut terlibat dan memicu drama—semuanya jadi agak kacau, kurang hangat, dan terasa jauh dari rasa kebersamaan atau keluarga. Tidak lagi seperti dulu.

Bagian dari diriku berharap semuanya kembali ke nuansa tahun 2000‑an hingga 2010‑an, tapi aku serahkan saja pada Tuhan. Aku agak putus asa terhadap masyarakat dan manusia. Aku lelah melihat keadaan makin memburuk serta terus diserang dan dipisahkan sehingga komunitas kecil jadi tak ada harapan. Aku nggak suka kalau kini masyarakat tak lagi menghormati dan bersatu.

I wish alcohol wasn't such a normal gift in society 😅 My employer sent me a bottle of eggnog but the only alcohol we like is in alcohol markers

I guess "not liking it" is kinda poor wording, I just think it's weird how casual we are with this stuff and we somehow just assume that all adults love this shit when there's people who shouldn't be touching it ever, and frankly I think the world would be better off if I poured it into the toilet than even gifting it to someone

@doombloomart
I have had US Big Corp required sensitivity training that reminds people not everyone wants alcohol and it's inappropriate to ask why. Seems like that should be more common

@elithebearded Yeah, that's mostly what I wish for too. I get that with sending random shit to a whole corporation will never be inoffensive to everyone, but 1. don't send random shit to a whole corporation maybe and 2. alcohol just rubs me wrong in the way that many who shouldn't touch it may touch it when it randomly shows up at the doorstep. 😅
hypothesis:
Andai saja alkohol tidak dianggap sebagai hadiah yang biasa diberikan dalam masyarakat… 😅 Atasan saya mengirimkan saya sebotol eggnog, tapi satu-satunya jenis alkohol yang kami sukai hanyalah yang digunakan dalam spidol alkohol saja.

Kurasa ungkapan “tidak menyukainya” agak kurang tepat. Menurutku, aneh sekali bagaimana kita begitu santai terhadap hal ini; kita menganggap semua orang dewasa menyukainya, padahal ada orang-orang yang seharusnya sama sekali tidak boleh menyentuhnya. Sejujurnya, menurutku dunia akan lebih baik jika saya membuangnya ke toilet daripada memberikannya kepada siapa pun.

@doombloomart
Gue pernah ikut pelatihan sensitivitas wajib dari Perusahaan Besar AS yang ngingetin orang-orang kalau nggak semua orang mau alkohol dan nggak pantas nanya kenapa. Harusnya hal kayak gitu lebih umum sih

@elithebearded Iya, itu juga yang aku harapkan. Aku ngerti sih, ngirim barang acak ke seluruh perusahaan pasti bakal menyinggung beberapa orang, tapi 1. mungkin jangan kirim barang acak ke seluruh perusahaan, dan 2. alkohol bikin aku nggak nyaman karena banyak orang yang nggak boleh menyentuhnya mungkin bakal menyentuhnya kalo tiba-tiba muncul di depan pintu. 😅

$partner has a video consult with Ikea to quote for a fitted kitchen. It's a fascinating glimpse into the ecosystem of online services for boomers.
1. They send link for video consult, three weeks ago. It uses Ikea's proprietary videoconf solution
2. They request the designs & 3D renders for the new kitchen
3. they send an email saying "thanks for sending through the design
4. We dial in today, they start the call with "our system blocked your files, let's design your kitchen together"
1/x

5. Partner asks if there's any way to share the (very detailed, took us like a full man week to put together) designs, but the Ikea salesdrone is on a script, and isn't having a bar of it.
6. The next step in the script is "laboriously do the design from scratch over the phone with the client, hunting and pecking on the keyboard and not fast using the UI of their design software"
2/x

7. They cannot share their screen, so it's a clown show of repeated misunderstanding about which part of which image is being referred to

8. the clock has just ticked past what should have been the full consult, and they're 35% the way thru getting the required measurements.

9. So far there's been literally 8 minutes of salesdrone laboriously inputting the measurements supplied
hypothesis:
$partner punya konsultasi video dengan Ikea buat minta penawaran kitchen set. Ini beneran sekilas pandang yang menarik ke ekosistem layanan online buat para boomer.
1. Mereka kirim tautan untuk konsultasi video, tiga minggu lalu. Pakai solusi konferensi video milik Ikea sendiri
2. Mereka minta desain & render 3D untuk dapur baru
3. mereka kirim email bilang "makasih sudah mengirimkan desainnya
4. Kami masuk panggilan hari ini, mereka mulai dengan "sistem kami memblokir file kamu, ayo kita desain dapurnya bareng"
1/x

5. Partner nanya apa ada cara buat membagikan desainnya (yang sangat detail, bikinnya makan waktu kayak seminggu kerja penuh), tapi salesdrone Ikea cuma ngikutin skrip, dan nggak mau tahu sama sekali.
6. Langkah berikutnya di skrip adalah "desain ulang dari nol dengan susah payah lewat telepon bareng klien, ngetik pelan-pelan di keyboard dan nggak cepat pakai UI software desain mereka"
2/x

7. Mereka nggak bisa berbagi layar, jadi ini jadi pertunjukan badut penuh salah paham berulang soal bagian mana dari gambar mana yang sedang dibahas

8. waktunya baru saja lewat dari durasi yang seharusnya untuk konsultasi penuh, dan mereka baru 35% jalan untuk mendapatkan ukuran yang dibutuhkan.

9. Sejauh ini secara harfiah sudah ada 8 menit salesdrone memasukkan ukuran yang diberikan dengan susah payah

right, so, as i was saying, i dmed this very well known and very friendly seeming artist-type person and gave em the usual spiel:
- how bridge works
- how to bridge
- please do so because i want to follow you and reblog some of your stuff that i like
- if you don't want to, that's fine
and they responded "not doing that" which is all well and good but then they blocked me???
just like, for absolutely no fucking reason

not naming any names because i do NOT dislike anybody involved and i certainly do not want to incite any brigading, but this has happened with several people now, including people who have REBLOGGED AND LIKED BRIDGED POSTS FROM THIS ACCOUNT (my main), which is WHY I WANTED TO FOLLOW THEM

if they had just said "no thanks" they would have gotten an "ok, perfectly understandable! :)" or the like from me, but now everyone has to put up with my confused ranting instead. i'm not even angry, i'm just *genuinely baffled*

bsky people, is this a genuine issue over on your platform (because it's one i've almost *never* had over here on this side of the bridge) or am i just running into bad apple after bad apple

I honestly don't know what people's general feelings are about enabling the Bridgy Fed here, because that's just not a topic that ever comes up tbh (unfortunately)… But there's definitely some subset of people here who are super trigger-happy about the block button, I'm not a fan of this either.

- gimana cara nge-bridge
- tolong lakuin dong soalnya gue pengen nge-follow lo dan nge-reblog beberapa karya lo yang gue suka
- kalau lo nggak mau, ya nggak apa-apa
terus mereka bales "nggak mau ngelakuin itu" yang mana ya oke-oke aja sih tapi abis itu mereka nge-block gue???
kayak, bener-bener tanpa alasan sama sekali anjir

nggak nyebut nama siapa-siapa ya soalnya gue TIDAK benci sama siapa pun yang terlibat dan gue jelas nggak mau mancing serbuan netizen, tapi ini udah kejadian sama beberapa orang sekarang, termasuk orang-orang yang udah NGE-REBLOG DAN NGE-LIKE POSTINGAN YANG DI-BRIDGE DARI AKUN INI (akun utama gue), yang mana itu ALASAN KENAPA GUE PENGEN NGE-FOLLOW MEREKA

Ironing the lightweight green corduroy for my first try at the Sachi's Studio Newsboy Cap pattern. I don't know how I feel about the recommendation to use interfacing but it probably does want something to stiffen and thicken it a bit.
#millinery

Sachi's newsboy cap pattern advises to cut the crown pieces diagonal to the weave ("on the bias") to allow more stretch around the circumference but that will make the corduroy rows run aslant, where I prefer them vertical.
We shall see. This is the test cookie to get a feel for the pattern. I like corduroy for texture but green wouldn't be my first choice, and this fabric is lightweight enough that I should add a layer, whether interfacing or what-have-you from the stash.

On a second look, my fabric isn't corduroy at all, it's just velvet, so I can cut at 45° to the fabric weave like Sachi suggests in the Newsboy Cap pattern and it won't look strange.
#millinery
hypothesis:
Lagi menyetrika korduroi hijau tipis buat percobaan pertama pola Topi Newsboy dari Sachi's Studio. Aku belum yakin soal rekomendasi pakai kain pelapis, tapi kayaknya memang butuh sesuatu buat bikin agak lebih kaku dan tebal.
#pembuatanTopi

Pola topi newsboy Sachi menyarankan memotong bagian mahkotanya diagonal terhadap arah tenunan kain ("bias") supaya lebih lentur di sekeliling lingkarnya, tapi itu bakal bikin garis-garis korduroinya jadi miring, padahal aku lebih suka kalau vertikal.
Kita lihat saja nanti. Ini uji coba dulu buat ngerasain polanya. Aku suka korduroi karena teksturnya, tapi hijau bukan pilihan pertamaku, dan kain ini cukup tipis jadi aku sebaiknya nambah satu lapisan, entah kain pelapis atau apa pun yang ada di stok.

Setelah dilihat lagi, kainku ternyata bukan korduroi sama sekali, cuma beludru, jadi aku bisa potong 45° terhadap arah tenunan kain seperti saran Sachi di pola Topi Newsboy dan hasilnya nggak bakal kelihatan aneh.
#pembuatanTopi

metadata.selection: cESA document selection with segment repair

source:
This morning while walking to work I had a thought: is it possible that the reason why the perception of the #replyGuy problem being worse on #Mastodon (and the #Fediverse in general) is due to sheer (lack of) numbers?
So I came up with a simplified model to check if this was indeed sufficient to explain the phenomenon.
Let's assume that, similarly to Mario Cipolla's Basic Laws of Human Stupidity, the fraction of reply guys in a population is a given constant ρ.
1/n
#maths

Let's also assume for simplicity that reply guys operate mechanically, i.e. do not use some kind of automation to find posts to reply to. This puts an upper limit to the total number of posts a reply guy can reply to in the course of a single day. Let's call this D.
We can also assume that on average a single non-reply-guy will generally post P < D posts per day.
Ignoring for a moment larger timeframes than a single day (but the discussion is similar if we extend the observation period) …
2/n

 … and assuming replyguys select randomly the posts to reply to (i.e. they don't specifically target a person for any particular reason), can we calculate what is the probability that a given person will see at least one reply from a reply guy?
Before doing the actual math, let's look at some practical example. Let's say that 1 in 10 users are reply guys, a reply guy goes through 100 posts per day, and a regular user posts 10 messages per day.
3/n

If there are 10 users in the network, 9 are regular users and 1 is a reply guy. There are 90 regular posts per day, and the the single reply guy will see ALL of them (because they can read 100 posts per day, so they see all the posts made on that network on that day.
However, if there are 100 users in the network, 10 of which are reply guys, the network will produce 900 posts in a day, but reply guys will NOT necessarily see all of them!
4/n

In the second scenario, each reply guy will see 100 random posts of the 900. Even if there are 10 reply guys, this does NOT mean that each post will be found by a reply guy! There may be posts that are seen by multiple reply guys, and posts that will not be seen by any reply guy!
So how do we compute the probability for a post to be seen by a reply guy in this case?
One way to do this is to compute the probability of NOT being seen by ANY reply guy, and taking the complement.
5/n

Now, since each reply guy sees 100 of the 900 posts, each post has a 1/9 probability of being seen by any particular reply guy, i.e. an 8/9 probability of NOT being seen by that particular reply guy. The probability of not being seen by ANY reply guy is thus 8/9 for each reply guy and assuming that the probabilities are independent, this means that the probability of not being seen by any of the 10 reply guys is (8/9)^10, which is 0.30794....
6/n

This means that the probability for each post to be seen by AT LEAST ONE reply guy is 1-(8/9)^10 or approximately 69%.
Of course, if someone posts 10 posts per day, then the probability for them to come across a reply guy is higher than that, because it will be the probability of at least on their post being seen by at least one reply guy!
Again assuming that for each post the probabilities are independent, the math is only slightly more complex:
6/n

each post has a (8/9)^10 probability of not being seen, but for the probability for ALL posts not being seen, that has to be further elevated to the number of posts made by the same person, which is 10, so (8/9)^100, and the probability of AT LEAST ONE POST being seen by AT LEAST ONE reply guys becomes 1 - (8/9)^100 = 0.99999233… which is not 100% but very close to it.
This was the case of a network 100 people, 10 of which are reply guys. Let's do one more and then go general.
7/n

Let's now assume the network has 100K users, still with the same 10% of reply guys (90K regular users, 10K reply guys).
Each reply guy still reads 100 posts per day, and the regular users still produce 10 posts per day.
This means that in a single day the regular users produce 900K posts, and each reply guys reads 100 of those 900K posts!
Still under the randomness assumption, this means that a single reply guy will only see 100/900K posts!
8/n
hypothesis:
Pagi ini, saat aku berjalan ke kantor, aku bertanya-tanya: apakah mungkin alasan mengapa persepsi masalah #replyGuy lebih buruk di #Mastodon (dan #Fediverse secara umum) adalah karena kurangnya jumlah pengguna?
Akhirnya, aku membuat model sederhana untuk menguji apakah hal ini memang cukup untuk menjelaskan fenomena tersebut.
Bayangkan, seperti Hukum Dasar Kebodohan Manusia Mario Cipolla, bahwa proporsi reply guys dalam suatu populasi adalah konstanta tertentu, yaitu ρ.
1/n
#matematika

Sebagai penyederhanaan, mari kita asumsikan juga bahwa reply guys beroperasi secara mekanis, yaitu tidak menggunakan otomatisasi untuk mencari postingan yang akan dibalas. Hal ini membatasi jumlah total postingan yang dapat dibalas oleh seorang reply guy dalam satu hari. Mari kita sebut batasan ini D.
Kita juga dapat berasumsi bahwa rata-rata seorang non-reply-guy biasanya memposting P < D postingan per hari.
Untuk sementara, abaikan rentang waktu yang lebih besar dari satu hari (namun diskusi akan serupa jika kita memperpanjang periode pengamatan) …
2/n

 … dan dengan asumsi bahwa reply guys memilih postingan secara acak untuk dibalas (yaitu mereka tidak secara khusus menargetkan seseorang karena alasan tertentu), apakah kita dapat menghitung probabilitas bahwa seorang individu tertentu akan melihat setidaknya satu balasan dari seorang reply guy?
Sebelum melakukan perhitungan, mari kita lihat beberapa contoh praktis. Misalkan bahwa 1 dari 10 pengguna adalah reply guys, seorang reply guy membaca 100 postingan per hari, dan pengguna biasa memposting 10 pesan per hari.
3/n

Jika ada 10 pengguna dalam jaringan, 9 di antaranya adalah pengguna biasa dan 1 adalah reply guy. Ada 90 postingan biasa per hari, dan reply guy tunggal tersebut akan melihat SEMUANYA (karena mereka dapat membaca 100 postingan per hari, sehingga mereka melihat semua postingan yang dibuat di jaringan tersebut pada hari itu).
Namun, jika ada 100 pengguna dalam jaringan, 10 di antaranya adalah reply guys, jaringan akan menghasilkan 900 postingan dalam sehari, tetapi reply guys TIDAK akan melihat semuanya!
4/n

Dalam skenario kedua, setiap reply guy akan melihat 100 postingan acak dari 900. Meskipun ada 10 reply guys, ini TIDAK berarti bahwa setiap postingan akan ditemukan oleh seorang reply guy! Mungkin ada postingan yang dilihat oleh beberapa reply guys, dan postingan yang tidak akan dilihat oleh reply guy mana pun!
Lalu, bagaimana kita menghitung probabilitas bahwa suatu postingan akan dilihat oleh seorang reply guy dalam kasus ini?
Salah satu cara adalah dengan menghitung probabilitas untuk TIDAK dilihat oleh reply guy mana pun, dan mengambil komplemennya.
5/n

Nah, karena setiap reply guy melihat 100 dari 900 postingan, setiap postingan memiliki probabilitas 1/9 untuk dilihat oleh seorang reply guy tertentu, yaitu probabilitas 8/9 untuk TIDAK dilihat oleh reply guy tertentu tersebut. Jadi, probabilitas untuk tidak dilihat oleh reply guy mana pun adalah 8/9 untuk setiap reply guy. Dengan asumsi bahwa probabilitas-probabilitas tersebut independen, probabilitas untuk tidak dilihat oleh salah satu dari 10 reply guys adalah (8/9)^10, yang bernilai 0.30794....
6/n

Ini berarti bahwa probabilitas setiap postingan untuk dilihat oleh SETIDAKNYA SATU reply guy adalah 1-(8/9)^10 atau sekitar 69%.
Tentu saja, jika seseorang memposting 10 postingan per hari, probabilitas mereka untuk bertemu dengan seorang reply guy lebih tinggi dari itu, karena itu akan menjadi probabilitas bahwa setidaknya satu dari postingan mereka dilihat oleh setidaknya satu reply guy!
Lagi-lagi, dengan asumsi bahwa probabilitas-probabilitas tersebut independen untuk setiap postingan, perhitungannya hanya sedikit lebih kompleks:
6/n

setiap postingan memiliki probabilitas (8/9)^10 untuk tidak dilihat, tetapi probabilitas bahwa SEMUA postingan tidak dilihat harus ditingkatkan lebih lanjut ke jumlah postingan yang dibuat oleh orang yang sama, yaitu 10, sehingga (8/9)^100. Probabilitas bahwa SETIDAKNYA SATU POSTINGAN dilihat oleh SETIDAKNYA SATU reply guy menjadi 1 - (8/9)^100 = 0.99999233… yang bukan 100% tetapi sangat dekat dengan itu.
Inilah kasus jaringan dengan 100 orang, 10 di antaranya adalah reply guys. Mari kita lakukan satu lagi dan kemudian buat generalisasi.
7/n

Mari kita asumsikan sekarang bahwa jaringan memiliki 100 ribu pengguna, masih dengan 10% reply guys (90 ribu pengguna biasa, 10 ribu reply guys).
Setiap reply guy masih membaca 100 postingan per hari, dan pengguna biasa masih menghasilkan 10 postingan per hari.
Ini berarti bahwa dalam satu hari, pengguna biasa menghasilkan 900 ribu postingan, dan setiap reply guy membaca 100 dari 900 ribu postingan tersebut!
Masih dengan asumsi acak, ini berarti bahwa seorang reply guy tunggal hanya akan melihat 100 dari 900 ribu postingan tersebut!
8/n

I expected to love Project Hail Mary, I LOVED Project Hail Mary, it also destroyed me in a particularly unique way as the wife of a science teacher after a year of watching all science teaching be relentlessly attacked and defunded. People love this movie, which I'm sure will be a success, and they hate my wife's work and destroy her programs and want us to lose our careers. How is it possible for all this to be true at once.

She left at 7am to go teach the hands on labs that she teaches where they handle cells, where they've increased class sizes and reduced TAs, she spends more contact hours with students in lab basements than any other class on the campus. She created a program for community college transfer students to get funded jobs in labs, opening up STEM pathways for those who never would've gotten the chance. For all her above and beyond work she's demonized as "doing DEI in science" which they call illegal

But you know, I guess if she were a white male software engineer writing fanfic about science teaching.... she'd be safe.

@grimalkina the same roots are already in Hail Mary tbh. I like Andy Weir a lot and I don't think he meant it, but the whole "bureaucracy and cooperation are truly the barrier to getting things done, and when shit hits the fan we get a powerful anti-bureaucrat to forego diplomacy and strongarm everyone into doing the project, ethics or what the participants want be damned" struck me as a very American individualism power fantasy, and I would guess an American wrote it if I didn't know

@jcachada @grimalkina
For what it's worth, the book contains this passage that didn't make it to the movie.
---
“I’m curious,” I say to Stratt. “Once we launch Hail Mary. What will you do then?”
“Me?” she said. “Doesn’t matter. Once the Hail Mary launches, my authority ends. I’ll probably be put on trial by a bunch of pissed-off governments for abuse of power. Might spend the rest of my life in jail.”
“I’ll be in the cell next to you,” said Leclerc.
“Are you at all concerned about that?”
She shrugged. “We all have to make sacrifices. If I have to be the world’s whipping boy to secure our salvation, then that’s my sacrifice to make.”
---
Is she better or worse if she thinks she's sacrificing herself?
hypothesis:
Aku emang udah ngira bakal suka Project Hail Mary, tapi aku SUKA BANGET sama Project Hail Mary, dan ini juga bikin aku terpukul banget dengan cara yang unik sebagai istri dari seorang guru sains setelah setahun ngelihat pengajaran sains terus-menerus diserang dan dipotong anggarannya. Orang-orang suka sama film ini, yang aku yakin bakal sukses, tapi mereka benci sama kerjaan istriku, ngehancurin program-programnya, dan pengen kami kehilangan pekerjaan. Kok bisa-bisanya semua hal ini terjadi di waktu yang bersamaan sih.

while watching i wondered why the earth needed to be in peril, and if the other two members of the multicultural crew dying to leave the White Man in charge was some kind of an anti-woke statement; but in light of some of the book author andy weir's 'most media literate libertarian' comments about how star trek should be just about spaceships going pew-pew, at least to him the answer is yes to the latter and 'fascism' to the former

@esvrld I read the book a little while back and I may have given him too much credit, especially given his recent decision to open his mouth, but I took the death of the international crew to strand the white boy as an understanding that his second book failed because he is not any good at writing people interacting with each other and his only skill is creating clever little puzzles for his self-insert to solve in complete isolation. Giving him an alien buddy was a good move because it opens the possibility of character interaction without requiring it to resemble the way humans relate to one another

dan bukan film yang jelek — ada bagian yang terlihat spektakuler — tapi film ini juga sepenuhnya dibangun dari film‑film lain yang lebih bagus dan temanya lebih kohesif. jadi ada nuansa 2001, The Three‑Body Problem, Arrival, Wall‑E sedikit, tapi juga kayak Quips Sexyman Saves The World Part XVII dan pada akhirnya tidak begitu banyak.

saat nonton aku mikir kenapa Bumi harus dalam bahaya, dan apakah dua anggota kru multikultural yang mati demi membiarkan Orang Putih memimpin itu semacam pernyataan anti‑woke; tapi mengingat beberapa komentar penulis buku Andy Weir tentang “libertarian paling melek media” yang bilang Star Trek seharusnya cuma soal pesawat luar angkasa yang pew‑pew, setidaknya baginya jawabannya ya untuk hal kedua dan “fasisme” untuk hal pertama.

Peringatan ini ditujukan kepada Areej, saya merasa perundungan siber mereka di atas keputusan yang sudah ada yang menguntungkan mereka adalah tindakan yang tidak pantas.
Saya terutama merasa Areej membocorkan informasi pribadi (doxxing) komite/mediator keadilan restoratif SELAMA proses tersebut merupakan tindakan pelecehan aktif.
Saya secara khusus memperingatkan tentang kemungkinan korban Areej melakukan tindakan menyakiti diri sendiri sebagai risiko nyata.

Ate a little more chicken and had a wash. Also had a little more fight when I made her take her fluids last.
We phoned the vet at 830 this morning to ask if they looked under her soft pallet while she was sedated, as she has major ear polyps. Was told the vet would call back. They didn't, rang just now (1645 local) and was told the vet wasn't in today. I was a bit annoyed and said "we paid you over £600 yesterday, you said phone if we have questions, we have questions you're not answering!"
"I don't like your tone, sir "
"It's not your fault personally, but when I pay the better part of a grand I expect a level of service that you're not providing"
"I'll get a vet from the other branch to ring you"

Seeing vet at other practise at half seven for more anti nausea medicine. They're not going to charge out of hours rate as we rang first thing.
Just got another 10ml of rescue fluids into her.

Back. Anti nausea jab, gabapentin, and she's home. Ate some chicken and some cheese.
Got more gabapentin in pill form for her, too

Won't stop eating. Having to slow her down to prevent her from vomiting. She's also absolutely, completely, totally, off her tits. Mullered. Stoned. Caned. Fully in the yellow submarine.
Vet says this'll reset her appetite, or, when we stop giving her painkillers, show it's pain stopping her eating, which would mean medical imaging time.

She's eating a bit, and even played a little, but she's still on the medications so it might be that. Still giving her recovery fluids, which she's still not fighting as she would normally.

Valencia has decided we are all Suspicious. Won't come when called, runs if you go to her. Still comes on her own terms, so it's fine, she's just seen her adoptive sister repeatedly wrapped in a towel and made to drink Stuff, and she wants none of that, thank you very much.

Ming update: she's a little more active, but still floppy and sleeping a lot. She's on two lots of painkillers still, so she's probably fairly stoned.
She IS eating, little and often, and finished off the last of her rescue fluids from a saucer by herself. She's washing, but she hasn't slapped valencia in ages, and she's still not right. Hoping it's the painkillers, and that when we withdraw them, her appetite remains.

Ming has finished the course of painkillers and is showing determined desire to go out, which we're not allowing yet. She's eating, playing, but it'll be a few days until the drugs are cleared from her system and we'll then see how she is.
Cautiously optimistic.
hypothesis:
Udah makan ayam agak banyakan dan udah jilat-jilat bersihin diri. Pas terakhir dicekokin cairan, dia juga udah mulai agak ngelawan.
Tadi pagi jam 8.30 kami telepon dokter hewan buat nanya apa mereka meriksa bagian bawah langit-langit mulutnya pas dia dibius, soalnya dia punya polip telinga yang parah. Katanya dokternya bakal telepon balik. Tapi mereka enggak telepon, pas barusan kami telepon (16.45 waktu setempat), katanya dokternya hari ini enggak masuk. Aku agak kesal terus bilang, "Kami bayar kalian lebih dari £600 kemarin, kalian bilang telepon aja kalau ada pertanyaan, sekarang kami punya pertanyaan tapi enggak kalian jawab!"
"Saya tidak suka nada bicara Anda, Pak "
"Ini bukan salah Anda secara pribadi, tapi kalau saya bayar hampir seribu pound, saya mengharapkan tingkat pelayanan yang tidak Anda berikan"
"Saya akan minta dokter hewan dari cabang lain buat telepon Bapak"

Nanti jam setengah delapan mau ketemu dokter di klinik cabang satunya buat minta obat anti-mual lagi. Mereka enggak bakal ngenain tarif luar jam kerja karena kami udah telepon dari pagi-pagi.
Barusan berhasil masukin 10ml cairan pemulihan lagi ke dia.

Udah balik. Udah disuntik anti-mual, dikasih gabapentin, dan sekarang dia udah di rumah. Udah makan ayam sama keju dikit.
Dapat tambahan gabapentin bentuk pil juga buat dia

Makan mulu enggak mau berhenti. Harus agak ngerem dia biar enggak muntah. Dia juga bener-bener, asli, total teler banget. Mabok. Nge-fly. Halu. Benar-benar lagi di "yellow submarine".
Kata dokter ini bakal nge-reset nafsu makannya, atau, pas kita stop kasih obat pereda nyeri, bakal kelihatan apa rasa sakit yang bikin dia enggak mau makan, yang artinya harus mulai pemindaian medis.

Dia udah makan dikit, bahkan sempat main bentar, tapi karena dia masih minum obat jadi mungkin gara-gara itu. Masih tetap dikasih cairan pemulihan, dan dia masih belum ngelawan kayak biasanya.

Valencia kayaknya menganggap kita semua Mencurigakan. Dipanggil enggak mau datang, kalau dideketin malah kabur. Tapi dia masih mau ngedeket kalau dia lagi pengen sendiri sih, jadi ya enggak apa-apa. Dia cuma habis ngelihat saudara angkatnya berkali-kali dibuntel handuk terus dicekokin Sesuatu, dan dia ogah banget digituin, makasih banyak.

Update tentang Ming: dia udah agak lebih aktif, tapi masih lemes dan banyak tidur. Dia masih minum dua jenis obat pereda nyeri, jadi kayaknya dia lumayan teler.
Dia EMANG makan, dikit-dikit tapi sering, dan dia ngabisin sisa cairan pemulihannya sendiri langsung dari piring kecil. Dia udah jilat-jilat bersihin diri, tapi udah lama banget dia enggak ngeplak Valencia, dan dia masih belum bener-bener pulih. Semoga aja ini karena efek obat pereda nyerinya, dan pas obatnya dihentikan, nafsu makannya tetap ada.

Ming udah selesai minum semua obat pereda nyerinya dan kelihatan pengen banget keluar rumah, tapi belum kami bolehin. Dia udah mau makan, main, tapi butuh beberapa hari sampai obatnya benar-benar hilang dari sistem tubuhnya, baru nanti kita lihat gimana kondisinya.
Optimis tapi tetap waspada.

source:
@kagan Just use anything, even the cashier receipts from your grocery shopping - whatever you want. A friend of mine who exhibits a lot put a sheet of toilet roll from every place he's exhibiting in his scrapbook another friend got injured while hanging her frames and eventually used the cast from the injury and some gouache to stamp patters on the pages. Hence: everything's involved you want involved.

@aurora And then you... take all these things, and glue, staple, or otherwise attach them into a book? Is that it?
I'm unclear on what happens next, or why.
Honestly, I may just not be a scrapbooking person.

@kagan Yes, that's exactly the way to go! Intentionally spill your coffee, drop an ink cartridge... whatever suits you. One just needs to get all these fancy ideas shown on pinterest or whatever out of one's head. It's about documenting the process instead of being a visual dainty. Use it like a wrecking journal if that suits. It's totally up to the person who makes it.
hypothesis:
@kagan Pake apa aja, bahkan struk kasir dari belanja groceries kamu - terserah kamu mau apa. Temen gue yang sering pameran nempelin selembar tisu toilet dari setiap tempat dia pameran di scrapbook-nya, temen gue yang lain cedera waktu lagi gantungin bingkainya dan akhirnya pake gips dari cederanya sama gouache buat ngestempel pola di halaman-halamannya. Jadi: semua yang mau kamu masukin ya masukin aja.

@aurora Terus kamu... ambil semua barang-barang itu, terus dilem, distaples, atau ditempelin ke buku gitu? Gitu doang?
Gue kurang paham abis itu ngapain, atau kenapa.
Jujur, gue mungkin emang bukan orang yang cocok buat scrapbooking.

@kagan Iya, emang gitu caranya! Sengaja tumpahin kopi, jatuin kartrid tinta... terserah kamu aja. Yang penting buang dulu semua ide-ide fancy yang ditunjukin di pinterest atau apalah dari kepala. Ini soal mendokumentasikan prosesnya, bukan soal bikin sesuatu yang cantik secara visual. Pake kayak wrecking journal kalau itu cocok buat kamu. Semuanya terserah orang yang bikin.

Progress after a while off. I got the sewing machine out to do the bill and a crown seam. Half the crown sewn plus the bill, resting atop the paper form made from the pattern. I had to rip and re-sew the machine stitch because I pinned along instead of across the seam and went off track. I might re-do the bill if I want a little more depth.
#millinery

Eight crown panels and two bill panels assembled into three pieces and pinned for general shape. Sachi's Studio Newsboy Cap pattern in green velvet. Mostly machine stitched.
The pattern calls for topstitching along the seams of the crown panels, which might suggest either matching or contrasting thread.
#millinery

Top view before I sew the crown halves together. Reviewing the how-to video. I see Sachi is using a few tiny spring clips during sewing instead of pinning the whole seam.

A bit of a messy join on the eight panels coming together at the peak of the newsboy cap, so I am thinking a larger button may be in order to disguise the seams.

Crown fully pieced, with cloth covered.button at peak. Raw edges loosely tucked under. Seams neither pressed nor topstitched.
#millinery
hypothesis:
Progress setelah beberapa waktu istirahat. Aku mengeluarkan mesin jahit untuk mengerjakan bagian paruh dan jahitan mahkota. Setengah bagian mahkota sudah dijahit, ditambah bagian paruh, dan diletakkan di atas bentuk kertas yang dibuat dari pola. Aku harus merobek dan menjahit ulang jahitan mesin karena aku menyematkan jarum di sepanjang jahitan, bukan di seberangnya, dan akhirnya keluar jalur. Aku mungkin akan mengulang bagian paruh jika ingin sedikit lebih dalam.
#millinery

Delapan panel mahkota dan dua panel paruh dirakit menjadi tiga bagian dan disematkan untuk membentuk bentuk umumnya. Pola topi newsboy Sachi's Studio terbuat dari beludru hijau. Sebagian besar dijahit dengan mesin.
Pola ini menyarankan untuk menjahit di sepanjang jahitan panel mahkota, yang mungkin menyarankan penggunaan benang yang serasi atau kontras.
#millinery

Tampilan dari atas sebelum aku menjahit dua bagian mahkota bersama-sama. Aku sedang menonton video tutorial. Aku melihat Sachi menggunakan beberapa klip pegas kecil selama menjahit alih-alih menyematkan seluruh jahitan.

Sambungan pada delapan panel yang bertemu di puncak topi newsboy sedikit berantakan, jadi aku berpikir untuk menggunakan kancing yang lebih besar untuk menyamarkan jahitannya.

Mahkota sudah sepenuhnya dirakit, dengan kancing yang dilapisi kain di puncaknya. Pinggiran mentah dilipat longgar ke bawah. Jahitan tidak disetrika maupun dijahit ulang.
#millinery
