source:
@JugglingWithEggs at least in my friend circle mobile phones not uncommon from early 90s, but they cost a *lot* to call from a landline (so if you were living at home your parents would discourage it), and until 1995-1999 were insecure, anyone with a radio scanner could (and often did) listen to them.
Whilst radio scanners were out of the price range of youths, many older folk had them, and until late 90s were often the kind of radio enthusiast who was a Tory bootlicker and supported the Police and other Establishment organisations, so you if discussing anything subversive on a mobile phone you risked being grassed up..
Ironically the tide turned by late 90s when scanners became affordable, and the Police were still on analogue radios 😁

@JugglingWithEggs by late 1990s everyone had a mobile phone and calls were cheaper (often with a good amount of free minutes) but SMS messages were unreliable and initially didn't even work across networks - people actually talked to each other on them!
One difference was access to physical spaces wasn't as heavily controlled as today - even though there was still CCTV and locals would call old bill on youths "hanging around", there was neither sufficient boots on the ground nor interconnected CCTV (a real security guard had to watch the footage locally, and property owners generally didn't want to pay for these folk at evenings and weekends.
There were also fewer cops on duty in outer suburbs during nights/weekends - they were all deployed into the town centres)

@vfrmedia
I remember texts sometimes taking hours to come through in the early noughties - so not always great for making on the fly arrangements.
Living in market town definitely meant less cctv and coppers back in 90’s. Remember difference when heading out into Bournemouth or Norwich of an evening. But young people having fun wasn’t frowned upon like it is now. My earlier post about facial recognition was about area where there has been uptick in teens just hanging out.
hypothesis:
@JugglingWithEggs 적어도 내 친구들 사이에서는 90년대 초반부터 휴대폰이 드물진 않았어, 하지만 유선전화로 걸면 요금이 *엄청* 비쌌지 (그래서 부모님이랑 같이 살면 부모님이 못 걸게 하셨어), 그리고 1995-1999년까지는 보안이 취약해서, 무전기 스캐너만 있으면 누구나 도청할 수 있었고(실제로 많이들 그랬고).
무전기 스캐너가 젊은 애들이 사기엔 너무 비쌌지만, 나이 든 사람들은 많이 갖고 있었어, 그리고 90년대 후반까지만 해도 경찰이나 다른 기득권 조직을 지지하는 보수당 앞잡이 같은 무전기 덕후들이 많았거든, 그래서 휴대폰으로 뭔가 불온한 얘기를 하면 밀고당할 위험이 있었지..
아이러니하게도 90년대 후반에 스캐너 가격이 만만해지면서 상황이 역전됐는데, 그때도 경찰은 여전히 아날로그 무전기를 쓰고 있었거든 😁

@JugglingWithEggs 1990년대 후반쯤엔 다들 휴대폰이 있었고 통화료도 더 저렴해졌어 (무료 통화 시간이 꽤 많이 제공되는 경우도 흔했지) 하지만 문자는 불안정했고 처음엔 다른 통신사끼린 아예 보내지지도 않았어 - 사람들이 실제로 폰으로 서로 대화를 나눴지!
한 가지 다른 점은 물리적 공간에 대한 접근이 지금처럼 심하게 통제되지 않았다는 거야 - 여전히 CCTV가 있었고 동네 사람들이 "배회하는" 젊은 애들을 경찰에 신고하긴 했지만, 현장 인력도 충분하지 않았고 CCTV가 서로 연결되어 있지도 않았어 (진짜 경비원이 현장에서 직접 영상을 봐야 했는데, 건물주들은 보통 저녁이나 주말에 이 사람들한테 돈을 주려 하지 않았거든.
또 밤/주말에는 외곽 주택가에 근무하는 경찰 수도 적었어 - 다들 시내 중심으로 배치됐거든)

@vfrmedia
2000년대 초반에는 문자가 도착하는 데 몇 시간씩 걸리기도 했던 기억이 나 - 그래서 즉흥적으로 약속을 잡기엔 항상 좋은 건 아니었지.
90년대에 지방 소도시에 산다는 건 확실히 CCTV랑 경찰이 적다는 뜻이었어. 저녁에 본머스나 노리치로 나갈 때 그 차이가 났던 게 기억나. 하지만 젊은 애들이 노는 걸 지금처럼 눈총 주진 않았어. 안면 인식에 대해 내가 아까 썼던 글은 10대들이 그냥 몰려다니며 노는 일이 많아진 지역에 관한 거였어.

I figured it'd be fun to share the whole process that goes into making a painting a custom scene. could be useful to some, and entertaining to others :)

as you all know, I'm a deeply religious person 🛐 so..
the scene: we're in the garden of eden. adam is eating apples from the forbidden tree, because of course he is. eve is having none of his shit, grabs an unfortunate unsuspecting nearby serpent, and is about to whip the shit out of adam. 🐍
#painting

painting with bazkie! 🧵 a (slow) thread [2/x]
so, we're gonna need reference photos. I want eve to be in the process of swinging the serpent around; so then I figured a baseball batter would be a good fit.
so wading through the AI slop, I found this actual photo that has a nice pose and good lighting.

painting with bazkie! 🧵 a (slow) thread [3/x]
I want adam to be in a protective stance, while also holding a forbidden apple, and all this, seen from the side/back. also, the lighting has to come from the same side as the batter. so all and all, it's pretty hard to find a proper reference pic for this, so I am posing for this one myself.
took about 20 pics with slightly different in stances etc., and decided on this one. (the right hand is going to hold the apple)

source:
project move out, spring break relay
day 1:
Cleared main bedroom closet
& contents of boxes on one wall.
I'm surveying all my belongings. Pulling out a small percentage to save. Sentimental items. Practical pieces for putting together a new life. At this stage I know I'm selecting more than I need, probably more than I can carry; but the amount that I'm leaving behind is far greater. Deciding what to keep & where comes after the survey. All the rest will be turned over to "scavengers."
#moverR

Day 2, midday break, Monday.
Today is harder than yesterday. I'm uncovering far more "sentimental" stuff. The challenge: these saved memories are a physical drag that impair rather than contribute anything practically to my future AND I feel integrated looking at them. There's a strong general condemnation, I feel, of holding onto sentimental items. Yet I know that they are powerful. But hey, I'm an artist. Even wistful, sad memories are valuable to me. I'm proceeding as before, retaining less+

+than I'm tossing, while knowing that I am keeping "too much." The next phase will be the actual moving & storing phase when more might be cut. This phase is the pre-screen before turning the cleared items over to others who will take everything away.
File under: how to move out of a home of 12 years & a home town of 45 years, with family roots here (& artifacts) from 150 years. I'm finally leaving, in search of a culture that suits my values.
#moverR
hypothesis:
이사 나가기 프로젝트, 봄방학 릴레이
1일 차:
안방 옷장 비움
& 한쪽 벽에 쌓아둔 상자들 내용물 정리.
내 물건을 전부 훑어보는 중. 남겨둘 건 아주 조금만 골라내고 있어. 추억이 담긴 물건들. 새 삶을 꾸리는 데 실용적으로 필요한 것들. 이 시점에서 이미 필요보다 더 많이 고르고 있다는 건 알아. 아마 들고 갈 수 있는 것보다도 많을 거야; 그래도 두고 가는 양이 훨씬 더 많아. 뭘 남길지 & 어디에 둘지는 다 훑어본 다음에 결정. 나머지는 전부 "주워 갈 사람들"에게 넘길 예정.
#moverR

2일 차, 한낮에 잠깐 쉬는 중, 월요일.
오늘은 어제보다 더 힘들어. "추억템"이 훨씬 더 많이 나오고 있어. 문제는: 이렇게 간직해온 기억들이 내 미래에 실질적으로 뭔가 보탬이 되기는커녕 오히려 발목을 잡는 물리적인 짐이라는 것, 그리고 동시에 그걸 보고 있으면 내가 온전해지는 느낌이 든다는 것. 추억이 담긴 물건을 붙들고 있는 걸 세상은 대체로 꽤 세게 비난하는 것 같아. 그래도 난 그런 물건들의 힘이 얼마나 큰지 알아. 뭐, 난 예술가잖아. 아련하고 슬픈 기억마저도 나한텐 가치가 있어. 전처럼 계속하고 있어, 버리는 것보다는 적게+

+챙기고 있지만, 내가 "너무 많이" 챙기고 있다는 것도 알고 있어. 다음 단계는 실제 이사 & 보관 단계고, 그때 더 줄일 수도 있어. 지금 단계는 정리해낸 물건들을 싹 가져가 줄 사람들에게 넘기기 전에 하는 사전 선별이야.
분류: 12년 살던 집 & 45년 살아온 고향, 150년 전부터 이어진 가족의 뿌리(& 유물들)가 있는 이곳을 떠나는 법. 드디어 떠나, 내 가치관에 맞는 문화를 찾아서.
#moverR

source:
My brother in He-Who-Shall-Not-Be-Named, what you are describing is a consequence of _misogyny_, not "misandry."

I desperately need men to realize that just because it's directed at them and an actual serious problem doesn't mean it is "misandry."
Just saw someone describe being discriminated against _for being considered effeminate_ as "misandry" and I just.

It's not that you aren't experiencing something real. You very well may be. But it isn't "misandry." Because "misandry" doesn't exist.
Yes, this applies to trans men as well. "Transmisandry" _also_ isn't a thing and just contributes to anti-feminist narratives. It treats itself as a mirror of transmisogyny, but transmisogyny is _intersective_: we experience transphobia _and_ we experience misogyny _and_ we experience this unholy thing that happens when the two interact. It's not a subset, even an exclusive subset, it's an intersection.
But the following all are absolutely problems that can be talked about!
* Transphobia/Transmisia
* Antitransmasculity
* Transemasculation
* Misogyny
It sucks to be discriminated against, but the language that we use is so, so important here.
hypothesis:
이름을-말해선-안-될-그분 안의 형제야, 네가 지금 말하는 건 _여성혐오_의 결과지, "남성혐오"가 아니야.

난 진짜 남자들이 제발 좀 깨달았으면 좋겠어. 그 일이 자기들을 향해 있고 실제로 심각한 문제라고 해서 그게 "남성혐오"인 건 아니라는 걸 말이야.
방금 어떤 사람이 _여성스럽게 여겨진다는 이유로_ 차별받는 걸 "남성혐오"라고 표현하는 걸 봤는데 나 진짜.

네가 겪는 일이 진짜가 아니라는 게 아니야. 충분히 진짜일 수 있지. 하지만 그건 "남성혐오"가 아니야. 왜냐하면 "남성혐오"는 존재하지 않으니까.
응, 이건 트랜스 남성들에게도 똑같이 적용돼. "트랜스 남성혐오" _또한_ 없는 개념이고 그냥 안티페미니스트 서사에 힘을 실어줄 뿐이거든. 그건 스스로를 트랜스 여성혐오의 거울처럼 여기지만, 트랜스 여성혐오는 _교차적_이야. 우리는 트랜스혐오를 겪고, _그리고_ 여성혐오를 겪고, _그리고_ 이 두 가지가 맞물릴 때 벌어지는 이 끔찍한 일도 겪어. 그건 부분집합도 아니고, 독점적인 부분집합도 아니며, 하나의 교차점이야.
하지만 다음은 모두 우리가 분명하게 이야기할 수 있는 문제들이야!

I'm doing a eekly 1hr meeting where I'm going over with a director of engineering my soap box on managing a product management organization and actually it's coming out to be a pretty good episodic thing

- different types of product managers and the basic skill sets in developing requirements
- how product managers ensure an ongoing cadence for an engineering team
- dealing with product managers with varying backgrounds (engineering, data analyst, operational SME, consulting etc)
what's been fun is that this Director and I worked at a previous company with product managers that I didn't manage and I'm able to reference "hey remember that person? that person was awesome and here's why."

so in various email chains and slack threads I'll forward them to said director (if he's already not in there) and be like "ok a GOOD product manager would do THIS" and a "BAD product maanger would do THAT" rememember when so and so did THIS? that was good.
hypothesis:
개발 디렉터 한 분이랑 매주 1시간씩 미팅하면서 PM 조직 관리에 대한 내 개똥철학을 털어놓고 있는데, 이게 생각보다 꽤 괜찮은 시리즈물이 되어가고 있어.

지금까지 다룬 주제는
- 다양한 유형의 PM과 요구사항 정의에 필요한 기본 스킬셋
- PM이 개발 팀의 지속적인 업무 템포를 보장하는 방법
- 다양한 배경(개발, 데이터 분석, 현업 전문가, 컨설팅 등)을 가진 PM들을 상대하는 법
특히 재밌는 건, 이 디렉터랑 나랑 전 직장에서 같이 일한 적이 있어서 그때 내가 직접 관리하지는 않았던 PM들을 예로 들면서 "야, 그 사람 기억나? 그 사람 진짜 일 잘했잖아, 왜 그랬냐면 말이지..." 하고 얘기할 수 있다는 거야.

그래서 여러 이메일이나 슬랙 스레드를 보다가 그 디렉터한테 전달해 주면서(그 사람이 아직 안 들어가 있으면) "봐봐, 일 잘하는 PM은 이럴 때 '이렇게' 하고," "일 못하는 PM은 '저렇게' 하거든. 예전에 아무개가 '이렇게' 했던 거 기억나? 그게 진짜 잘한 거야." 라고 하곤 해.

if they had just said "no thanks" they would have gotten an "ok, perfectly understandable! :)" or the like from me, but now everyone has to put up with my confused ranting instead. i'm not even angry, i'm just *genuinely baffled*

bsky people, is this a genuine issue over on your platform (because it's one i've almost *never* had over here on this side of the bridge) or am i just running into bad apple after bad apple

Ironing the lightweight green corduroy for my first try at the Sachi's Studio Newsboy Cap pattern. I don't know how I feel about the recommendation to use interfacing but it probably does want something to stiffen and thicken it a bit.
#millinery

Sachi's newsboy cap pattern advises to cut the crown pieces diagonal to the weave ("on the bias") to allow more stretch around the circumference but that will make the corduroy rows run aslant, where I prefer them vertical.
We shall see. This is the test cookie to get a feel for the pattern. I like corduroy for texture but green wouldn't be my first choice, and this fabric is lightweight enough that I should add a layer, whether interfacing or what-have-you from the stash.

On a second look, my fabric isn't corduroy at all, it's just velvet, so I can cut at 45° to the fabric weave like Sachi suggests in the Newsboy Cap pattern and it won't look strange.
#millinery
hypothesis:
Sachi's Studio의 뉴스보이 캡 패턴으로 처음 만들어 보려고 얇은 초록색 코듀로이 원단을 다리는 중. 심지를 쓰라는 추천은 좀 긴가민가하지만, 그래도 힘을 좀 받고 도톰하게 만들려면 뭔가를 덧대긴 해야 할 것 같아.
#모자만들기

Sachi의 뉴스보이 캡 패턴에서는 둘레가 잘 늘어나도록 크라운 조각을 결의 사선 방향("바이어스")으로 재단하라고 권하네. 하지만 그렇게 하면 코듀로이 골이 사선으로 흐르게 되잖아. 난 세로로 떨어지는 게 좋은데 말이지.
일단 두고 봐야겠어. 이건 패턴 감을 익히기 위한 테스트용이니까. 코듀로이 질감은 좋아하지만 초록색이 내 첫 번째 선택은 아니었어. 게다가 이 원단은 꽤 얇아서 심지든 뭐든 쟁여둔 것 중에서 한 겹 더 대야 할 것 같아.

다시 자세히 보니 내 원단은 코듀로이가 전혀 아니고 그냥 벨벳이네! 그러니까 Sachi가 뉴스보이 캡 패턴에서 제안한 대로 원단 결의 45도 방향으로 재단해도 전혀 이상해 보이지 않겠어.
#모자만들기

This morning while walking to work I had a thought: is it possible that the reason why the perception of the #replyGuy problem being worse on #Mastodon (and the #Fediverse in general) is due to sheer (lack of) numbers?
So I came up with a simplified model to check if this was indeed sufficient to explain the phenomenon.
Let's assume that, similarly to Mario Cipolla's Basic Laws of Human Stupidity, the fraction of reply guys in a population is a given constant ρ.
1/n
#maths

Let's also assume for simplicity that reply guys operate mechanically, i.e. do not use some kind of automation to find posts to reply to. This puts an upper limit to the total number of posts a reply guy can reply to in the course of a single day. Let's call this D.
We can also assume that on average a single non-reply-guy will generally post P < D posts per day.
Ignoring for a moment larger timeframes than a single day (but the discussion is similar if we extend the observation period) …
2/n

 … and assuming replyguys select randomly the posts to reply to (i.e. they don't specifically target a person for any particular reason), can we calculate what is the probability that a given person will see at least one reply from a reply guy?
Before doing the actual math, let's look at some practical example. Let's say that 1 in 10 users are reply guys, a reply guy goes through 100 posts per day, and a regular user posts 10 messages per day.
3/n

If there are 10 users in the network, 9 are regular users and 1 is a reply guy. There are 90 regular posts per day, and the the single reply guy will see ALL of them (because they can read 100 posts per day, so they see all the posts made on that network on that day.
However, if there are 100 users in the network, 10 of which are reply guys, the network will produce 900 posts in a day, but reply guys will NOT necessarily see all of them!
4/n

In the second scenario, each reply guy will see 100 random posts of the 900. Even if there are 10 reply guys, this does NOT mean that each post will be found by a reply guy! There may be posts that are seen by multiple reply guys, and posts that will not be seen by any reply guy!
So how do we compute the probability for a post to be seen by a reply guy in this case?
One way to do this is to compute the probability of NOT being seen by ANY reply guy, and taking the complement.
5/n

Now, since each reply guy sees 100 of the 900 posts, each post has a 1/9 probability of being seen by any particular reply guy, i.e. an 8/9 probability of NOT being seen by that particular reply guy. The probability of not being seen by ANY reply guy is thus 8/9 for each reply guy and assuming that the probabilities are independent, this means that the probability of not being seen by any of the 10 reply guys is (8/9)^10, which is 0.30794....
6/n

This means that the probability for each post to be seen by AT LEAST ONE reply guy is 1-(8/9)^10 or approximately 69%.
Of course, if someone posts 10 posts per day, then the probability for them to come across a reply guy is higher than that, because it will be the probability of at least on their post being seen by at least one reply guy!
Again assuming that for each post the probabilities are independent, the math is only slightly more complex:
6/n

each post has a (8/9)^10 probability of not being seen, but for the probability for ALL posts not being seen, that has to be further elevated to the number of posts made by the same person, which is 10, so (8/9)^100, and the probability of AT LEAST ONE POST being seen by AT LEAST ONE reply guys becomes 1 - (8/9)^100 = 0.99999233… which is not 100% but very close to it.
This was the case of a network 100 people, 10 of which are reply guys. Let's do one more and then go general.
7/n

Let's now assume the network has 100K users, still with the same 10% of reply guys (90K regular users, 10K reply guys).
Each reply guy still reads 100 posts per day, and the regular users still produce 10 posts per day.
This means that in a single day the regular users produce 900K posts, and each reply guys reads 100 of those 900K posts!
Still under the randomness assumption, this means that a single reply guy will only see 100/900K posts!
8/n

각 게시물에 대한 확률이 독립적이라는 가정을 다시 적용하면, 계산은 아주 살짝 더 복잡해져:
6/n

이건 100명의 유저 중 10명이 훈수충인 네트워크의 경우였어. 딱 하나만 더 예시를 들어보고 일반화해 볼게.

이제 훈수충 비율은 똑같이 10%로 유지한 채 네트워크 유저 수가 10만 명이라고 가정해보자 (일반 유저 9만 명, 훈수충 1만 명).
여전히 훈수충은 하루에 100개의 글을 읽고, 일반 유저도 하루에 10개의 글을 써.
이러면 하루 동안 일반 유저들은 총 90만 개의 글을 만들어내고, 각 훈수충은 그 90만 개의 글 중에서 100개만 읽게 돼!
여전히 무작위로 글을 본다는 가정하에, 이건 훈수충 한 명이 100/90만 개의 게시물만 보게 된다는 뜻이야!
8/n

source:
I expected to love Project Hail Mary, I LOVED Project Hail Mary, it also destroyed me in a particularly unique way as the wife of a science teacher after a year of watching all science teaching be relentlessly attacked and defunded. People love this movie, which I'm sure will be a success, and they hate my wife's work and destroy her programs and want us to lose our careers. How is it possible for all this to be true at once.

She left at 7am to go teach the hands on labs that she teaches where they handle cells, where they've increased class sizes and reduced TAs, she spends more contact hours with students in lab basements than any other class on the campus. She created a program for community college transfer students to get funded jobs in labs, opening up STEM pathways for those who never would've gotten the chance. For all her above and beyond work she's demonized as "doing DEI in science" which they call illegal

But you know, I guess if she were a white male software engineer writing fanfic about science teaching.... she'd be safe.

@grimalkina the same roots are already in Hail Mary tbh. I like Andy Weir a lot and I don't think he meant it, but the whole "bureaucracy and cooperation are truly the barrier to getting things done, and when shit hits the fan we get a powerful anti-bureaucrat to forego diplomacy and strongarm everyone into doing the project, ethics or what the participants want be damned" struck me as a very American individualism power fantasy, and I would guess an American wrote it if I didn't know

@jcachada @grimalkina
For what it's worth, the book contains this passage that didn't make it to the movie.
---
“I’m curious,” I say to Stratt. “Once we launch Hail Mary. What will you do then?”
“Me?” she said. “Doesn’t matter. Once the Hail Mary launches, my authority ends. I’ll probably be put on trial by a bunch of pissed-off governments for abuse of power. Might spend the rest of my life in jail.”
“I’ll be in the cell next to you,” said Leclerc.
“Are you at all concerned about that?”
She shrugged. “We all have to make sacrifices. If I have to be the world’s whipping boy to secure our salvation, then that’s my sacrifice to make.”
---
Is she better or worse if she thinks she's sacrificing herself?
hypothesis:
프로젝트 헤일메리를 정말 좋아할 거라고 예상했고, 실제로 진짜 너무 좋았어. 근데 과학 교사인 내 아내 입장에선, 지난 1년 동안 모든 과학 교육이 무자비하게 공격받고 예산이 삭감되는 걸 지켜봐 왔기에 이 영화가 나를 아주 독특한 방식으로 무너뜨리더라고. 사람들은 이 영화를 사랑하고 분명 성공하겠지. 그런데 정작 내 아내의 일은 싫어하고, 그녀의 프로그램들을 파괴하며 우리가 직업을 잃길 바라잖아. 어떻게 이 모든 게 동시에 가능한 거지?

아내는 세포를 다루는 실습 수업을 가르치기 위해 오전 7시에 집을 나섰어. 학급 규모는 늘었는데 조교 수는 줄었지. 그녀는 캠퍼스의 그 어떤 수업보다 더 많은 시간을 실험실 지하에서 학생들과 보내고 있어. 커뮤니티 칼리지 편입생들이 실험실에서 유급 일자리를 얻을 수 있는 프로그램을 만들어서, 기회조차 없었을 사람들에게 STEM 분야의 길을 열어줬어. 이렇게 온갖 노력을 다했는데도, 그녀는 소위 불법이라 부르는 '과학계의 DEI(다양성·형평성·포용성) 활동'를 한다는 이유로 악마 취급을 받아.

뭐, 만약 그녀가 과학 교육에 대해 팬픽을 쓰는 백인 남성 소프트웨어 엔지니어였다면... 안전했겠지.

@grimalkina 솔직히 헤일메리 안에도 이미 같은 뿌리가 있어. 앤디 위어를 정말 좋아하고 그가 의도했다고 생각하진 않지만, "관료주의와 협력이 일을 처리하는 데 진정한 장벽이며, 상황이 최악으로 치달으면 강력한 반관료주의자가 나타나 외교 따윈 무시하고 윤리든 참여자의 의사든 상관없이 모두를 강압적으로 밀어붙여 프로젝트를 완수한다"는 설정이 굉장히 미국식 개인주의적 권력 판타지로 느껴졌어. 몰랐다면 미국인이 썼을 거라고 추측했을 거야.

@jcachada @grimalkina
참고삼아 말하자면, 책에는 영화에 나오지 않은 이런 구절이 있어.
---
"궁금하네요," 내가 스트랫에게 말했다. "헤일메리를 발사하고 나면 당신은 뭘 할 건가요?"
"나?" 그녀가 말했다. "상관없어. 헤일메리가 발사되면 내 권한은 끝나니까. 아마 권력 남용으로 화가 난 여러 정부들에 의해 재판을 받게 되겠지. 남은 생을 감옥에서 보낼지도 몰라."
"제가 옆방에 있을게요," 르클레르가 말했다.
"그게 전혀 걱정되지 않으세요?"
그녀는 어깨를 으쓱했다. "우리 모두 희생해야 해. 인류의 구원을 확보하기 위해 내가 세상의 희생양이 되어야 한다면, 그건 내가 감당해야 할 희생이야."
---

while watching i wondered why the earth needed to be in peril, and if the other two members of the multicultural crew dying to leave the White Man in charge was some kind of an anti-woke statement; but in light of some of the book author andy weir's 'most media literate libertarian' comments about how star trek should be just about spaceships going pew-pew, at least to him the answer is yes to the latter and 'fascism' to the former

@esvrld I read the book a little while back and I may have given him too much credit, especially given his recent decision to open his mouth, but I took the death of the international crew to strand the white boy as an understanding that his second book failed because he is not any good at writing people interacting with each other and his only skill is creating clever little puzzles for his self-insert to solve in complete isolation. Giving him an alien buddy was a good move because it opens the possibility of character interaction without requiring it to resemble the way humans relate to one another
hypothesis:
그리고 이 영화가 나쁜 건 아니야 — 어떤 부분은 진짜 눈부시게 화려하거든 — 근데 완전히 다른, 더 낫고 주제 의식도 더 탄탄한 영화들로 짜깁기한 영화이기도 해. 그러니까 2001 스페이스 오디세이, 삼체, 컨택트, 월-E 살짝, 그런 것도 있고, 또 '입담 좋은 섹시남이 세상을 구한다 파트 17' 같은 거라 결국은 별로야.

보다가 궁금했어, 왜 굳이 지구가 위기에 빠져야 했는지, 그리고 다문화 승무원 두 명이 죽어서 백인 남자가 지휘를 맡게 되는 게 일종의 안티 워크 발언인 건지; 근데 원작 작가 앤디 위어가 '미디어 문해력 최고인 리버테리언'을 자처하며 스타트렉은 그냥 우주선이 퓽퓽 쏘는 것만 나오면 된다고 한 말을 생각해 보면, 적어도 작가 본인에게 답은 후자는 '그렇다'이고 전자는 '파시즘'인 모양이더라.

@esvrld 나 예전에 그 책 읽었었는데, 내가 작가한테 좀 과분하게 점수를 줬나 봐, 특히 요즘 그 사람이 입을 열기로 한 거 보면 더 그렇고. 근데 나는 다국적 승무원들이 죽어서 백인 남자애 혼자 남겨지는 전개를 보고, 그게 작가가 두 번째 책에서 실패한 이유가 사람들끼리 상호작용하는 걸 쓰는 데 완전 쥐약이라서 그렇고, 자기 투영 캐릭터가 완전히 고립된 상태에서 똑똑한 퍼즐 풀기나 하는 게 유일한 재주라는 걸 인정한 거라고 이해했어. 외계인 친구를 붙여준 건 진짜 좋은 수였어, 왜냐하면 그게 인간끼리 관계 맺는 방식을 꼭 닮지 않아도 되는 캐릭터 간 상호작용의 가능성을 열어줬으니까.

@kagan Just use anything, even the cashier receipts from your grocery shopping - whatever you want. A friend of mine who exhibits a lot put a sheet of toilet roll from every place he's exhibiting in his scrapbook another friend got injured while hanging her frames and eventually used the cast from the injury and some gouache to stamp patters on the pages. Hence: everything's involved you want involved.

@aurora And then you... take all these things, and glue, staple, or otherwise attach them into a book? Is that it?
I'm unclear on what happens next, or why.
Honestly, I may just not be a scrapbooking person.

@kagan Yes, that's exactly the way to go! Intentionally spill your coffee, drop an ink cartridge... whatever suits you. One just needs to get all these fancy ideas shown on pinterest or whatever out of one's head. It's about documenting the process instead of being a visual dainty. Use it like a wrecking journal if that suits. It's totally up to the person who makes it.

Local trainer Noel Mayfield-Smith is hoping to have a lucrative day at Sunday's Coffs Harbour meeting with four runners stepping out for the stable on the six-race card.

The Group 1-winning horseman will start his day in the second event of the day when Ausbred Yahoo contests the Komatsu Country Boosted Benchmark 58 Handicap (1605m) with two-kilogram claiming apprentice Ella Drew taking the ride.

Racing returns to Coffs Harbour on Sunday.

Ausbred Yahoo has been racing in good form with a third placing at Kempsey three starts ago being followed by two successive seconds at Coffs Harbour, the latest when beaten by Sunday's rival Caledonian.

Mayfield-Smith links with another apprentice, three-kilogram claimer Leanne Boyd, when Never Island starts in the Insurance Advisernet Australia Pink Silks F&M Benchmark 58 Handicap (1305m).

A winner of three of her 15 starts, Never Island will carry 59.5 kilograms after Boyd's allowance. Never Island was beaten less than a length when second behind Montgomery at Grafton and backed that up with a last-start fifth at Coffs Harbour behind In The Fine Print when again beaten less than a length.

Raymond Spokes takes the ride on the Mayfield-Smith-prepared Monte Cruise in the O'Brien Plumbing Relining Wayne Glenn Pink Silks Cup Benchmark 82 Handicap (1205m).

Monte Cruise is also a three-time winner from just the nine starts. She hasn't raced since July when finishing last of eight at Eagle Farm and has had two trials at this track in preparation for her return, finishing second behind Saturday's Wyong winner Petticoat before winning the latest of them.

Mayfield-Smith rounds out the day when he again links with Boyd when she rides Cardsharp in the Key Community Group C,G&E Benchmark 58 Handicap (1305m).
hypothesis:
Scuaia locale a ponta à fâ cascia à Coffs con quattro concorrenti

L'allenatô locale Noel Mayfield-Smith o spera d'avei unna giornâ de guägno pe-a regatta da pròscima domenega à Coffs Harbour, con quattro cavalli in corsa pe-a scuaia into programma da sëi corse.

O cavaggeo ch'o guägnià o Gruppo 1 o comensià a seu giornâ inta segonda preuva do giorno, quande Ausbred Yahoo o parteçipià a-o Komatsu Country Boosted Benchmark 58 Handicap (1605m), con l'apprendista Ella Drew in sciâ sella, ch'a corrià con un abbon de doî chilli.

Domenega torna e corse à Coffs Harbour.

Ausbred Yahoo o l'à corso in boña forma, con un terso pòsto à Kempsey guägno inte træ regatte passæ; dòppo l'é vegnuo doî segondi pòsti stæti guägni da-a fia à Coffs Harbour, l'urtimo di quæ quand'o l'é stæto battuo da l'avversäio da domenega passâ, Caledonian.

Mayfield-Smith a spera oua inte unn'atra apprendista, Leanne Boyd, con un abbon de trei chilli, quande Never Island o l'anià in sciâ pista inte l'Insurance Advisernet Australia Pink Silks F&M Benchmark 58 Handicap (1305m).

Dòppo avei guägno træ de chinze regatte ch'o l'à zugou, Never Island o portià 59,5 chillogrammi dòppo l'abbon de Boyd. Never Island a l'é stæta battua de meno de unna longhessa quand'a l'é arrivâ segonda derê à Montgomery à Grafton e a l'à confermou d'ëse in forma con un quinto pòsto inte l'urtima regatta à Coffs Harbour derê à In The Fine Print, quand'a l'é stæta torna battua pe meno de unna longhessa.

Raymond Spokes o montià Monte Cruise, allenou da Mayfield-Smith, inte l'O'Brien Plumbing Relining Wayne Glenn Pink Silks Cup Benchmark 82 Handicap (1205 m).

Anche Monte Cruise o l'à guägno træ vòtte inte solo che neuve regatte ch'o l'à zugou. O no core ciù da-o luggio passou, quand'a l'é arrivâ urtima in sce eutto à Eagle Farm e a l'à zugou doe preuva in sce sto percorso pe inandiâse a-o seu retorno; a l'é coscì finia segonda derê à Petticoat, ch'a l'à guägno à Wyong o sabbo passou, avanti de guägnâ l'urtima de ste regatte.

Mayfield-Smith a særa a giornâ quande a s'ascianca torna à Boyd, ch'o montià Cardsharp into Key Community Group C,G&E Benchmark 58 Handicap (1305m).

Melbourne Renegades host Glenn Maxwell and the Melbourne Stars at Marvel Stadium in BBL15 after Usman Khawaja and Brisbane Heat host Sydney Thunder

Sam Harper dominated with 82 not out off 51 balls and Glenn Maxwell recalled the feeling of ball on bat in a subdued innings of 20 not out off 17 balls, which included one massive six. He has not lost his ability and would have enjoyed the chance to spend time in the middle.

The crowd of 42,846 was not given the contest they hoped for as the Stars won the match by eight wickets with 25 balls remaining.

It keeps Melbourne Stars in contention as they break a three-match losing sequence and makes life hard for Melbourne Renegades. Marcus Stoinis bowled well to take 3-33 and was on a hat-trick at one stage while Harper is in great form having hit 356 runs at a strike rate of 159 for the tournament. He was man-of-the-match.

Tom Rogers bounced back with a fast 50 against Melbourne Renegades

But it was all over once Tom Rogers helped himself to 50 off 19 balls to start the innings with an opening partnership of 84 with Harper.

"They outplayed us at the "G so it was nice to get our fifth win," Harper told Fox Cricket.

Most interesting were the comments from the Fox Cricket commentary box where former England captain Michael Vaughan made it clear how disappointed he was with the way the English hierarchy handled a nightclub incident involving Harry Brook in New Zealand before they arrived in Australia for The Ashes.

Melbourne Stars veteran Peter Siddle said "it was a good turnaround" with the win pushing the team back into second spot on the BBL table.

It's starting to heat up with three games remaining for Melbourne Renegades and two matches for Melbourne Stars.

There is still plenty of cricket left this summer so keep tuning in. Thanks for following. Can the Stars finally win the title?
hypothesis:
I Melbourne Renegades òspitan Glenn Maxwell e i Melbourne Stars into Marvel Stadium inta BBL15, dòppo che Usman Khawaja e i Brisbane Heat an ospitou i Sydney Thunder

Sam Harper o l'à dominou con 82 ponti sensa vegnî eliminou in sce 51 balloin, tanto che Glenn Maxwell o l'à retrovou o gusto do contatto co-o ballon inte un inning discreto da 20 ponti, sensa vegnî eliminou in sce 17 palle, donde o l'à portou à cà un sëi spettacolare. O no l'à perso a seu abilitæ e de seguo o l'avieiva apprexou a poscibilitæ de passâ do tempo in sciô campo.

I 42.846 spettatoî no an ascistio a-a partia che ghe saieiva stæto cao vedde, da-o momento che i Stars an guägno a partia pe eutto wicket con 25 balloin ancon da zugâ.

Sto resultato o mantëgne in corsa i Melbourne Stars, che interrompan unna fia de træ desfæte uña dòppo l'atra e rendan diffiçile a vitta a-i Melbourne Renegades. Marcus Stoinis o l'à tiou ben e o l'à realizzou 3 wicket pe 33 ponti, e à un çerto ponto o l'ea à un passo da l'hat-trick, tanto che Harper o l'é in forma mäveggiosa, de za ch'o l'à totalizzou 356 ponti con un strike rate de 159 into torneo. O l'é stæto nominou l'òmmo da partia.

Tom Rogers o s'é repiggiou con un 50 spedio contra i Melbourne Renegades

Ma a partia a l'ea za zugâ quande Tom Rogers o l'à totalizzou 50 ponti in sce 19 balloin, avuo comensou l'innings con unna partnership d'avertua d'84 con Harper.

"N'an dæto o riso co-a natta a-o G, donca l'é stæto bello ottegnî a nòstra quinta vittöia", o l'à dito Harper à Fox Cricket.

I commenti ciù interessanti en vegnui da-a gabiña de commento de Fox Cricket, donde l'ex capitanio de l'Inghiltæra, Michael Vaughan, o l'à ascciæio quant'o l'é stæto deluso da comme i dirizzenti ingreixi an gestio un açidente inte locale da neutte ch'o l'à avuo da fâ con Harry Brook in Neuva Zelanda avanti do seu arrivo in Australia pe The Ashes.

O veteran di Melbourne Stars Peter Siddle o l'à dito che "a l'é stæta unna bella inverscion de tendensa", co-a vittöia ch'a l'à portou torna a squaddra a-o segondo pòsto inta clascifica da BBL.

A scituaçion a vëgne delongo ciù açeisa, con træ partie ancon da zugâ pe-i Melbourne Renegades e doe pe-i Melbourne Stars.

Gh'é ancon ben ben do cricket da vedde sta stæ ch'a vëgne, donca no stæve à perdive e nòstre misse à giorno. Graçie pe l'attençion. Arriescian in sciâ fin i Stars à guägnâse o titolo?

High Noon review - Billy Crudup brings classic Hollywood western back with a bang

How do you turn a classic Hollywood western into West End musical fare? Add songs, many of Bruce Springsteen's in this case, along with a few rounds of line dancing and a sizzling star in Billy Crudup. Still, it's an odd experience initially as Thea Sharrock's production switches from one brief filmic scene to the next, and the endeavour seems as wooden as the clapboard saloon-bar slats that comprise the handsome set.

As a piece of theatre, it finds its flow. As a debate play, though, it gathers a locomotive energy as it travels towards the showdown between Frank Miller (James Doherty), who is returning to this "dirty little village in the middle of nowhere," and the marshal Will Kane (Crudup) who put him behind bars. That is mostly because of the uncanny and urgent relevance of this 1952 film about a community working out (or rather, squirming out of) its civic responsibilities around institutional wrongdoing.

Originally an allegory of McCarthyism (its screenwriter, Carl Foreman, was blacklisted), the story sets the cowardice of the many against the courage of the few - in this case, the lone, heroic Kane, who mobilises his defence against Miller and his henchmen after being let down by the townsfolk. The film was blasted by John Wayne as un-American for its critical portrait of the community; the production comes to life in its arguments on collective in/action and seems to speak directly about the dilemmas facing the cowboy country of Trump's America (the shooting in Minneapolis just the latest example). Eric Roth's script uses many lines from Foreman's screenplay but fleshes out the debates on the ethical stance of a community in the face of wrongdoing and misguided American myths around immigration.

Cowardice of the many, courage of the few ... cast of High Noon. Photograph: Johan Persson

There is also the joint talent of Crudup and the ever agile Denise Gough who play the central couple on their wedding day. She is Amy Fowler, a Quaker who abhors the actions of violent men; he is the marshal who has just given up his "tin star" to start over as a shopkeeper. That is, until news reaches town that Miller is arriving on the noon train.

Gary Cooper made the role entirely his own, his integrity comparable only to Gregory Peck's Atticus in To Kill a Mockingbird. So Crudup has his long shadow to evade. He manages to hold up the part on stage as an upstanding, earnest and increasingly desperate man. Gough makes her part grittier and more modern than that of her film counterpart, Grace Kelly. The pair are convincing as a couple although their narrow characterisation hems in the full scale of their abilities.

Several other characters seem too flimsy, from Billy Howle's deputy marshal, Harvey Pell, to Rosa Salazar's Mexican businesswoman, Helen, although the affinity between her and Amy is refreshing, and Roth gives more voice and texture to these women as a whole.

Several of Springsteen's songs bring their own American politics (from the frontier optimism of Land of Hope and Dreams to The Rising, written in response to 9/11). Some are sung a cappella, mostly by Gough, who is a strong singer, her voice emanating desolation, but she reprises I'm on Fire one too many times.

It seems like a reluctant musical at times, the songs short and thin but the percussive music and sound design are always arresting, as is the lighting, designed by Neil Austin, which brings emotional clarity and intrigue. A clock is central to Tim Hatley's set design, counting down to the train's thrilling arrival and the subsequent showdown, which manages to contain tension and drama, despite the difficulty of staging a cross-town shootout.

For all its early stiffness, it builds in momentum and there are moving moments. Ultimately, the political message speaks loudest, harnessing the McCarthyist fear of then and the Trumpian terror of today.
hypothesis:
Reçenscion de High Noon - Billy Crudup o pòrta torna in sveuga o clascico wester hollywoodian con un gran resultato

Comme se trasforma un clascico do western hollywoodian inte unna comedia muxicale do West End? Con l'azzonzighe de cansoin, inte sto caxo ben ben de quelle de Bruce Springsteen, insemme à quarche gio de ballo de gruppo e à un attô famosiscimo comme Billy Crudup. E sciben, a-o comenso a l'é unn'esperiensa strania, dæto che a produçion de Thea Sharrock a passa da unna breve scena cinematografica à l'atra, e l'impreisa a pâ redena comme e töe de legno do saloon-bar che compoñan a bella scenografia.

Comme tutte e euvie de tiatro, a l'attreuva o seu ritmo. Comme pièce de debattito, però, a l'attreuva unn'energia ch'a sommerze o spettatô tanto ch'a s'inandia verso a reisa di conti tra Frank Miller (James Doherty), ch'o l'é apreuvo à vegnî torna inte sto "sucido paisetto perduo into ninte", e o sceriffo Will Kane (Crudup), ch'o l'à mandou derê a-e sbare. Cösa dovua ciù che tutto à l'attualitæ urgente e straordinäia de sta pellicola do 1952 in sce unna communitæ ch'a l'affronta (ò, pe dîghe megio, a se retrae) da-e seu responsabilitæ çiviche de fronte à un atto istituçionale ch'o va contra a-a lezze.

À l'origine unn'allegoria do maccartiximo (o seu sceneggiatô, Carl Foreman, o l'é stæto misso in lista neigra), a stöia a mette a codardia di tanti contra o coraggio di pöchi - inte sto caxo, o solo e eròico Kane, ch'o se defende da-o Miller e da-i seu sordatti dòppo ëse stæto deluso da-e gente do paise. O cine o l'é stæto criticou da-o John Wayne comme antiamerican pe-o seu retræto critico da communitæ; a produçion a piggia vitta inte seu discuscioin in sce l'intervento/açion collettiva e pâ parlâ direttamente di dilemmi do paise cowboy de l'America do Trump (e riprese à Minneapolis son solo l'urtimo exempio). A sceneggiatua do Eric Roth a l'addeuvia tante righe da-a sceneggiatua do Foreman, ma a l'approfondisce e discuscioin in sciâ poxiçion etica de unna communitæ de fronte a-e iniquitæ e a-i miti americhen sbaliæ in sce l'inmigraçion.

Viltæ de tanti, coraggio de pochi ... cast de High Noon. Fotografia: Johan Persson

Gh'é dapeu o talento conzonto do Crudup e da delongo lesta Denise Gough, che interpretan a cobbia protagonista into giorno do seu sposaliçio. Lê a l'é Amy Fowler, unna quacchera ch'a l'aborrisce e açioin di òmmi violenti; lê o l'é o sceriffo ch'o l'à tòsto renonçiou a-a seu "stella de lamma" pe recomensâ torna da-o ninte comme butegâ. Questo, a-o manco, fin à quande in çittæ arriva a neuva che Miller o l'é apreuvo à arrivâ co-o treno de mëzogiorno.

Gary Cooper o l'à fæto a parte do tutto seu, a seu integritæ a se peu paragonâ solo à quella de Atticus do Gregory Peck inte To Kill a Mockingbird. Coscì o Crudup o l'à a seu longa ombra da schivâ. O l'arriësce à tegnî a parte in sciô parco comme un òmmo onesto, serio e delongo ciù despiou. A Gough a fa a seu parte ciù ardia e moderna de quella da seu omologa do cine, Grace Kelly. A cobbia a l'é convinçente comme cobbia, sciben che a seu caratterizzaçion streita a mette a-o de là de tutta a scâ de seu capaçitæ.

Diversci atri personaggi pan tròppo inconscistenti, da-o viçesceriffo de Billy Howle, Harvey Pell, a-a dònna d'affari mescicaña de Rosa Salazar, Helen, ben che l'affinitæ tra lê e Amy a referesca, e Roth o conferisce ciù tanta voxe e spessô à ste doe dònne inte l'insemme.

Ciù de unna canson de Springsteen pòrtan con sé a seu politica americaña (da l’ottimiximo da frontea de Land of Hope and Dreams à The Rising, scrito in respòsta a-o 11 de settembre). Dötræ son cantæ a cappella, pe-o ciù da Gough, ch’a l’é unna cantante fòrte, con a seu voxe ch’a pòrta desolaçion, ma a repiggia I'm on Fire unna vòtta de tròppo.

À træti o pâ un muxical ch'o va avanti mävoentea, con de cansoin curte e scarse, ma a muxica percusciva e o sound desing en delongo accattivanti, coscì comme l'illuminaçion, stæta progettâ da Neil Austin, ch'o conferisce ciæessa emotiva e intrigo. Un releuio o l'é çentrale inta scenografia de Tim Hatley, ch'o marca o conto a-a reversa pe l'emoscionante arrivo do treno e a reisa di conti ch'a ven dòppo, ch'a l'arriësce à contegnî tenscion e drammatiçitæ, à despeto de difficoltæ de mette in scena unna sparatöia in gio pe-a çittæ.

Con tutta a seu rigiditæ iniçiale, o guägna slancio e gh’é di momenti commoventi. A-a fin, o messaggio politico o parla ciù fòrte, addeuviando a poia maccartista d’aloa e o terrô trumpian d’ancheu.

O l'arriësce à tegnî a parte in sciô parco comme un òmmo onesto, serio e delongo ciù despiou. A Gough a fa a seu parte ciù ardia e moderna de quella da seu omologa do cine, Grace Kelly. A cobbia a l'é convinçente comme cobbia, sciben che a seu caratterizzaçion streita a mette a-o de là de tutta a scâ de seu capaçitæ.

Diversci atri personaggi pan tròppo inconscistenti, da-o viçesceriffo de Billy Howle, Harvey Pell, a-a dònna d'affari mescicaña de Rosa Salazar, Helen, ben che l'affinitæ tra lê e Amy a referesca, e Roth o conferisce ciù tanta voxe e spessô à ste doe dònne inte l'insemme.

Ciù de unna canson de Springsteen pòrtan con sé a seu politica americaña (da l’ottimiximo da frontea de Land of Hope and Dreams à The Rising, scrito in respòsta a-o 11 de settembre). Dötræ son cantæ a cappella, pe-o ciù da Gough, ch’a l’é unna cantante fòrte, con a seu voxe ch’a pòrta desolaçion, ma a repiggia I'm on Fire unna vòtta de tròppo.

À træti o pâ un muxical ch'o va avanti mävoentea, con de cansoin curte e scarse, ma a muxica percusciva e o sound desing en delongo accattivanti, coscì comme l'illuminaçion, stæta progettâ da Neil Austin, ch'o conferisce ciæessa emotiva e intrigo. Un releuio o l'é çentrale inta scenografia de Tim Hatley, ch'o marca o conto a-a reversa pe l'emoscionante arrivo do treno e a reisa di conti ch'a ven dòppo, ch'a l'arriësce à contegnî tenscion e drammatiçitæ, à despeto de difficoltæ de mette in scena unna sparatöia in gio pe-a çittæ.
Con tutta a seu rigiditæ iniçiale, o guägna slancio e gh’é di momenti commoventi. A-a fin, o messaggio politico o parla ciù fòrte, addeuviando a poia maccartista d’aloa e o terrô trumpian d’ancheu.

"An utterly miserable day": Kempton Park meeting marred by death of three horses

The Lanzarote Hurdle card at Kempton Park was marred by the death of three horses, including the Grade One-winning Kalif Du Berlais, whose loss Paul Nicholls described as "a big kick in the teeth" and a "sad day."

Kalif Du Berlais - whose ownership group includes Sir Alex Ferguson - unseated Harry Cobden in the four-runner Coral Silviniaco Conti Chase and landed lame, with the broken shoulder he sustained proving untreatable and he was euthanised by the veterinary team on Saturday.

Nicholls said: "It's a sad day when you lose horses like that, it's hard on the whole team. It's a big kick in the teeth for everyone, the owners, the poor girl who looks after him - you hate to see that happen. He was just showing his class today, he jumped and travelled well and sadly now he will never be able to show the potential we thought he had.

"I can say as much as I like, but it's just a shame for the whole team. Harry was extremely upset and is missing his ride in the last as he doesn't feel great about it. He's a big, bold horse who attacks his fences and those horses, when they do that, can end up having a bad fall.

"He was enthusiastic today and travelling beautifully and we'll never know where we would have ended up, we've always had a lot of faith in him. These things happen, sadly, and we'll have to try to pick ourselves up and move forward. These horses get the best of everything, there's not much you can say to make it better at this point.

"It never gets any easier when these things happen and it's a big old blow."

In the Coral Daily Rewards Shaker Handicap Chase, Jonjo and AJ O'Neill's Peso was pulled up on the flat with an injury that could not be treated, leaving racecourse vets with no choice but to euthanise him.

Harry Derham saddled Wertpol for the juvenile hurdle and the horse looked to be running a huge race before falling at the last and sustaining a life-ending injury. Derham said on his X account: "An utterly miserable day at Kempton Park today losing Wertpol who we only had the good fortune of having in our yard for a short period of time.

"It's a sad day when you lose horses like that, it's hard on the whole team. It's a big kick in the teeth for everyone," said Paul Nicholls. Photograph: Alan Crowhurst/Getty Images

"He was a bright talent who was fresh and happy doing his work every day, often playing around and expressing himself. He loved his job and I am so sad for his Heart Of The South syndicate, who are the most wonderful group of people. Racing can at times be a painful sport and today has been a tough day for a number of connections. A day to forget."

A spokesperson for Kempton Park said: "All of us at Kempton Park care deeply about the welfare of all racehorses, as do the thousands of racing staff who provide them with world-class levels of care at home every day. Our heartfelt condolences are with the connections of all three horses."

"Unna giornâ tristiscima": a giornâ de Kempton Park marcâ da-a mòrte de trei cavalli

A giornâ do Lanzarote Hurdle a Kempton Park a l'è stæta segnâ da-a morte de trei cavalli, compreso o Kalif Du Berlais, vincitou de Grado Un, a cui perdita Paul Nicholls a l'ha descrita comme "un gran còrpo inti denti" e "'na giornâ triste."

Kalif Du Berlais - into gruppo de proprietæ do quæ o figura anche Sir Alex Ferguson - o l'ha disarçionou Harry Cobden into Coral Silviniaco Conti Chase, con quattro partenti, ed o l'é atterrou zoppo; a frattua a-a spalla ch'o s'ea procurou a s'é dimostrâ non curabile e o cavallo o l'é stæto soppresso da l'équipe veterinaria sabbo.

O Nicholls o l'à dito: O l'é un giorno triste quande se perde di cavalli coscì, l'é diffiçile pe tutta a squaddra. O l'é un gran cäso inti denti pe tutti, i padroin, a pövea figgia ch'a ghe stà apreuvo, no se veu vedde. O mostrava giusto ancheu a seu classe, o l'à sätou e o l'à viægiou ben e purtròppo oua o no porrià mai mostrâ o potençiale che se creddeivimo ch'o l'avesse.

Pòsso dî quello che veuggio, ma o l'é solo che un peccou pe tutta a squaddra. Harry o l'ea sciätou comme tutto e o perde o seu gio inte l'urtimo perché o no se sente guæi ben. O l'é un cavallo gròsso e ardio ch'o l'attacca e seu cioende e quelli cavalli, quande ô fan, peuan finî pe avei unna gramma cheita.

Ancheu o l'ea entuxasta e o viægiava beniscimo e no saviemo mai donde saiëscimo anæti à finî, emmo sempre avuo tanta confiansa in lê. Ste cöse succedan, pe desgraçia, e doviemo çercâ de tiâse sciù e anâ avanti. Sti cavalli piggian o megio de tutto, no gh'é guæi da dî pe fâ megio à sto ponto.

"No vëgne mai ciù façile quande succede ste cöse e o l'é un corpo duo."

Into Coral Daily Rewards Shaker Handicap Chase, Peso, de propietæ de Jonjo e AJ O'Neill, o l'é stæto arretiou perché o no poeiva vegnî cuou, e i veterinäi de l'ippòdromo no an avuo atra poscibilitæ che de sopprimilo.

O Harry Derham o l'à sellao o Wertpol pe-a preçipitaçion di zoeni e o cavallo o paiva fâ unna corsa gròssa avanti de cazze à l'urtimo e piggiâ un açidente ch'o l'à portou a-a fin da vitta. O Derham o l'à dito in sciô seu conto X: Un giorno tristiscimo à Kempton Park ancheu pe avei perso o Wertpol che emmo avuo a fortuña d'avei into nòstro cortî pe pöco tempo.

"A l'é unna giornâ triste quande se perde di cavalli à sto mòddo, a l'é dua pe tutta a squaddra. O l'é un corpo duo pe tutti", o l'à dito Paul Nicholls. Fotografia: Alan Crowhurst/Getty Images

"O l'ea un talento brillante, fresco e contento de fâ o seu travaggio tutti i giorni, tante vòtte zugando e fando di versci pe esprimmise. O l'ammava o seu travaggio e son assæ triste pe-o seu scindicato Heart Of The South, ch'o l'é compòsto da un gruppo de persoñe mäveggiose. L'ippica de vòtte o peu ëse un sport doso e ancheu a l'é stæta unna giornâ diffiçile pe tante persoñe. Unna giornâ da ascordâse."

Un portavoxe de Kempton Park o l'à deciarou: "À tutti niatri à Kempton Park ne stà in sciô cheu o benstâ de tutti i cavalli da corsa, coscì comme e miggiæa de louanti de corse che tutti i giorni ghe dan unn'ascistensa de livello mondiale. E nòstre condolianse ciù sentie van a-e gente ligæ à tutti trei i cavalli."

Relentless Clan power past Steelers in statement home win

The Clan got off to a strong start with Joe Hazeldine slamming a first-time shot into the Sheffield net after some nice slip passing between Hugo Roy and Deven Sideroff.

Despite some strong defensive play from Glasgow, the Steelers found a breakthrough via Brien Diffley's sharp shooting through traffic before Mikko Juusola gave the visitors the lead with a deflected shot from right wing.

In the second period, the Clan saw momentum swing their way with Steven Seigo slipping a tidy finish from close-range past Matthew Greenfield to tie the game up.

Shortly after, Rylan Schwartz grabbed a go-ahead goal with a bullet from the backdoor after some luck with the Clan avoiding a too many men call.

Sheffield forced their way back into the game with Ryan Tait driving on net and backhanding a shot which Brine saved but didn't keep hold of as Kevin Tansey poked a third goal over the line for the visitors.

With the score line tied going into the final frame, the noise peaked inside Braehead and Glasgow gained control of the game.

Tristin Langan saw retribution for the ongoing battle he had to put up with throughout the game with Mitchell Heard as he cracked the bar with a beautiful finish to give his side the lead.

A holding penalty on Miihkali Teppo applied pressure to the hosts' advantage late on with the Steelers pulling their netminder for the extra attacker.

Langan grabbed his second of the game on the empty net though to round off the night with a well-earned and much-needed two points for the Clan on home ice.

Glasgow Clan head coach, Corey Neilson said after the game: "We were the better team. Our forecheck was excellent, that's something we've worked on all week and it was relentless tonight. The identity we were looking for is starting to show. It was really enjoyable to coach with full lines and take advantage of a team that's playing short, because usually we're on the other side of that."

Sheffield Steelers head coach, Aaron Fox, said: "I thought we were pretty good for the majority of the game. Glasgow jumped on us early, but our bounce back was good. Our guys were gassed by the end, we only had three lines but we were in the battle all game, I can't fault the compete level of our guys."
hypothesis:
O Clan o l'arreversa i Steelers con unna netta vittöia in casa

O Clan o l'à comensou in gran stile con Joe Hazeldine ch'o l'à infiou a ræ do Sheffield con un tio a-o xeuo dòppo unna fia de passaggi tra Hugo Roy e Deven Sideroff.

Sciben che o Glasgow o l'aiva unna bella defeisa, i Steelers an trovou o mòddo de marcâ a ræ graçie à un tio esatto de Brien Diffley into mezo do trafego, avanti che Mikko Juusola o portesse i òspiti in avvantaggio con tio deviou in sce l'aa de drita.

Into segondo periodo, o Clan o l'à avuo l'asbrio co-o Steven Seigo ch'o l'à fæto un bello finale da-a distansa curta davanti a-o Matthew Greenfield e o l'à pareggiou a partia.

No guæi apreuvo, Rylan Schwartz o l'à marcou a ræ de l'avvantaggio con un tio potentiscimo da-a pòrta derea, dòppo che o Clan o l'à avuo a fortuña de schivâ unna penalitæ pe "tròppi òmmi in sciô campo".

O Sheffield o l'é tornou inta partia con Ryan Tait ch'o s'é asbrivou verso a pòrta e o l'à tiou de reversa; Brine o l'à parou ma o no l'é riescio à ottegnî o ballon, e Kevin Tansey o l'à sponciou a tersa ræ ciù in là da linea di òspiti.

Co-i ponti in paritæ a l'intrâ into tempo finale, o rumô o l'à toccou o culmine drento de Braehead e o Glasgow o l'à piggiou o contròllo da partia.

Tristin Langan o l'à avuo a seu rivincita pe-o duello continuo ch'o l'à dovuo sopportâ pe tutta a partia con Mitchell Heard, quande o l'à corpio a traversa con unna concluxon splendida pe portâ a seu squaddra in avvantaggio.

Unna penalitæ pe trattegnua inflita à Miihkali Teppo a l'à misso prescion à avvantaggio di padroin de casa into finale, co-i Steelers che an levou o portê pe mette un attaccante in de ciù.

Langan, però, o l'à misso à segno a seu segonda ræ da partia co-a pòrta veua, e o l'à serrou a seiaña con doî ponti meitæ e ben ben neçessäi pe-o Clan in sciâ giassa de casa.

L'allenatô do Clan de Glasgow, Corey Neilson, o l'à dito dòppo a partia: Eivimo a squaddra ciù boña. O nòstro precontròllo o l'é stæto eccellente, a l'é unna cösa in sciâ quæ emmo travaggiou tutta a settemaña e a l'é stæta sensa pösa staseia. L'identitæ che çercavimo a comensa à mostrâse. L'é stæto pròpio bello allenâ co-e righe piñe e piggiâ vantaggio de unna squaddra ch'a zeuga curta, perché pe-o sòlito semmo da l'atra parte.

L'allenatô di Sheffield Steelers, Aaron Fox, o l'à deciarou: "Penso che semmo stæti assæ bravi pe-a ciù parte da partia. O Glasgow o n'à aggivou subito, ma a nòstra reaçion a l'é stæta boña. I nòstri figgeu in sciâ fin ean esausti, aivimo solo che træ linee ma semmo stæti in zeugo pe tutta a partia, no pòsso criticâ o livello de competitivitæ di nòstri figgeu".

source:
Falkirk strengthen top six hopes with away win at St Mirren

Miller then made sure of the points just after the hour mark as he capitalised on some static St Mirren defending to race on to his own blocked shot before dinking the ball over George.

It was an afternoon to forget for St Mirren, who lost Liam Donnelly, Killian Phillips and George to injury as they slipped to a third straight defeat.

Falkirk had the first opening in the 18th minute when Barney Stewart laid the ball off to Dylan Tait, whose curling effort from just outside the box took a slight deflection before cannoning off the top of the crossbar.

St Mirren finally threatened just after the half-hour mark when Mikael Mandron shot from a tight angle, forcing Falkirk goalkeeper Scott Bain into a smart stop with his feet.

Falkirk then raced down the other end and the lively Miller was released and allowed to shoot from a similar angle but George comfortably saved.

The match was finally coming to life and Dan Nlundulu was the next to fire at goal in the 36th minute after the Bairns had given up possession cheaply, but it was a routine stop at the near post by Bain.

Nlundulu then got in behind and slid the ball home, though the cheers from the home fans were short-lived as the assistant referee raised his flag for what appeared to be a clear offside.

The hosts had already lost Donnelly to injury midway through the first half and they suffered a further blow when Phillips, who appeared to hurt his shoulder in the opening period, came off at the interval.

The match was crying out for a moment of quality and it came 10 minutes into the second half through Yeats.

Tait's perfect through ball released Miller, and although George came racing out of his goal and timed his challenge well, the loose ball fell invitingly for Yeats, who curled a stunning first-time finish into the top corner of the unguarded St Mirren goal.

It got even better for the away side just after the hour mark as the Bairns doubled their lead.

Miller's initial shot from the edge of the box was blocked by Scott Tanser but, as the home defence hesitated, Miller reacted first to run on to the loose ball and lift a right-footed shot over the onrushing George.

St Mirren suffered yet another blow shortly after as the keeper was forced off to be replaced by Ryan Mullen.

The enforced changes and the quickfire goals seemed to rock the hosts and they never threatened a comeback, with their afternoon summed up in the 89th minute when Tanser completely mis-kicked his attempted volley from six yards out.
hypothesis:
O Falkirk o raffòrsa e speransa d'intrâ inta top six co-a vittöia in trasferta contra o St Mirren

Dapeu o Miller o s'é asseguou di ponti giusto dòppo o segno de l'oa tanto ch'o capitalizzava in sce quarche defeisa statica do St Mirren pe anâ avanti a-o seu corpo bloccou avanti d'acciantâ o ballon in sciô George.

O l'é stæto un poidisnâ terribile pe-o St Mirren, ch'o l'à perso Liam Donnelly, Killian Phillips e George apreuvo à un açidente e o l'à patio a tersa desfæta da-a fina.

O Falkirk o l'à fæto a primma avertua a-o menuto 18 quande o Barney Stewart o l'à dæto o ballon a-o Dylan Tait, che o l'à fæto un pittin de curling da feua da-a cascetta, avanti de cannonâ in sciâ croxe.

O St Mirren, dòppo tanto, o l'é vegnuo un reisego pe-i avversäi pöco dòppo a mez'oa de zeugo, quande Mikael Mandron o l'à tiou da un canto streito, constrenzendo o portê do Falkirk Scott Bain à unna bella parâ co-i pê.

O Falkirk, dapeu, o s'é asbrivou inte un contropê e o sghissante Miller, ch'o s'é liberou da-e seu ciöte, o l'à posciuo tiâ da unn'angolaçion scimile, ma George o l'à fermou o ballon con façilitæ.

Nlundulu, dapeu, o s'é inserio a-e spalle da defeisa e o l'à insaccou o ballon, ma l'exultansa di tifoxi de casa a l'é duâ pöco, perché o guardalinie o l'à tiou sciù a bandeta pe quello ch'o paiva un ciæo feua de zeugo.

Arthur Okonkwo's penalty shootout heroics causes FA Cup shock as Wrexham beat Nottingham Forest

Wrexham won an FA Cup third-round thriller in front of Hollywood owner Ryan Reynolds as Nottingham Forest were dumped out of the competition on penalties after a 3-3 draw.

Arthur Okonkwo was the Wrexham hero with stops from Igor Jesus and Omari Hutchinson giving them a 4-3 victory on spot-kicks after Josh Windass, Callum Doyle, George Thomason and Jay Rodriguez had converted from the spot.

First-half goals from Liberato Cacace and Oliver Rathbone gave Wrexham early control and had Reynolds trading high fives and hugs from his vantage point in the main stand.

Jesus cut the deficit before Dominic Hyam's diving header restored Wrexham's two-goal advantage with 16 minutes remaining.

Forest looked dead and buried but substitute Callum Hudson-Odoi produced two outstanding finishes, the equaliser coming in the 89th minute.

Wrexham have won three successive promotions to go from non-league to the Championship, but this was the first time since being taken over by Reynolds and fellow actor Rob Mac nearly five years ago they had met Premier League opposition.

Forest made eight changes after beating West Ham on Tuesday, with goalkeeper Matz Sels, Jesus and Hutchinson remaining and Wales international Neco Williams on a stacked bench at his local club.

Callum Hudson-Odoi came off the bench and scored twice to force the match to penalties (REUTERS)

Kieffer Moore was not risked after injury as Wrexham sought to extend a four-game winning streak that had taken them a point from the Championship play-off places.

Forest started on the front front with Jesus shooting over and Douglas Luiz found the net after 17 minutes.

Referee Paul Tierney initially awarded the goal, but then ruled it out after deciding Luiz had controlled the ball with his arm before volleying home.

Wrexham had been tidy in possession without a cutting edge but that was to change in the final 10 minutes of the first half.

Ollie Rathbone doubled Wrexham's lead after Liberato Cacace's opener (REUTERS)

Sam Smith dragged wide before Cacace took advantage after 37 minutes to drive home his maiden Wrexham goal from 20 yards aided by the faintest of deflections off Morato's heel.

Wrexham smiles were even wider three minutes later as Rathbone broke through Morato's challenge to fire in his third goal in four games.

It should have been three - and possibly contest over - when Smith scampered through the Forest half unchecked but failed to beat Sels" outstretched leg.

Forest boss Sean Dyche made a triple substitution at half-time with Williams, Morgan Gibbs-White and Nicolas Dominguez sent on to salvage the situation.

Okonkwo saved the decisive penalty to deny Omari Hutchinson in the shootout (Martin Rickett/PA Wire)

The visitors were instantly more fluid as Okonkwo tipped over Luiz's free-kick and kept out Nicolo Savona's strike.

Sels saved well from Broadhead but Forest were in the ascendancy and struck when Savona set up the leaping Jesus for a header that hit the post and just about crossed the line.

The drama rose as Hyam headed in a superb George Dobson free-kick and Hudson-Odoi swept home 60 seconds later to set up a grandstand finish.

Hudson-Odoi took the tie into extra time in fantastic fashion, taking a touch on his chest and lofting a perfect volley over Okonkwo, but Wrexham were not to be denied their first top-flight FA Cup scalp for 26 years.

Sean Dyche made eight changes to the Forest side and called on his first choice players but couldn't get over the line (Martin Rickett/PA Wire)

Elsewhere in the FA Cup, Oxford United advanced to the fourth round with a 4-3 penalty shootout win over MK Dons and Port Vale defeated Fleetwood 1-0.

Wigan Athletic also progressed after a superb display at Deepdale saw the League One side beat Championship play-off chasers Preston North End 1-0 as well.

L'eroiximo do penalty do Arthur Okonkwo o l'à caxonou o shock da Coppa de l'Inghiltæra, co-o Wrexham ch'o l'à guägno o Nottingham Forest

O Wrexham o l’à guägno un incontro emoscionante do terso turno de FA Cup davanti a-o proprietäio de Hollywood Ryan Reynolds, quande o Nottingham Forest o l’é stæto eliminou da-a competiçion a-i penalty dòppo unna patta 3-3.

Arthur Okonkwo o l’é stæto l’eröe do Wrexham, con e paradde in sce Igor Jesus e Omari Hutchinson che an regallou a-a squaddra unna vittöia 4-3 a-i penalty, dòppo che Josh Windass, Callum Doyle, George Thomason e Jay Rodriguez aivan trasformou da-o dischetto.

E ræ into primmo tempo do Liberato Cacace e Oliver Rathbone an dæto a-o Wrexham o contròllo da partia fin da-o comenso, con Reynolds ch'o se scangiava battue de moen e abbrassi da-o seu pòsto privilegiou inta tribuña prinçipâ.

O Jesus o l'à taggiou a mancansa avanti che o proiettile de Dominic Hyam o restituisse o vantaggio de doe ræ a-a Wrexham quande mancava 16 menuti.

Paiva che o Forest o l'avesse perso, ma Callum Hudson-Odoi, ch'o l'é introu à quello ponto, o l'à misso à segno doe ræ ecceçionale, marcanto a patta a-o menuto 89.

O Wrexham o l'à conquistou træ promoçioin da-a fia, passando da-a serie no profescionistica a-a Championship, ma sta chì a l'é stæta a primma vòtta, da quande o l'é stæto rilevou da Reynolds e da-o collega attô Rob Mac che l'é tòsto çinqu'anni, ch'o l'à affrontou un avversäio da Premier League.

O Forest o l'à apportou eutto cangi dòppo avei battuo o West Ham mätesdì passou, co-o portê Matz Sels, Jesus e Hutchinson stæti confermæ in campo e o naçionale galleise Neco Williams in sciâ banca into seu club locale.

Callum Hudson-Odoi o l’é introu da-a banchiña e o l’à marcou doe vòtte pe portâ a partia a-i penalty (REUTERS)

Kieffer Moore o no l'é stæto misso in campo apreuvo à un açidente, tanto che o Wrexham o çercava de prolongâ unna serie de quattro vittöie da-a fia ch'a l'aiva portou à un ponto da-i pòsti pe-i play off da Championship.

O Forest o l'à comensou in avvantaggio con un tio erto de Jesus e Douglas Luiz o l'à trovou a ræ dòppo 17 menuti.

L'arbitro Paul Tierney a-o comenso o l'aiva validou a ræ, ma dapeu o l'à annullâ dòppo avei stabilio che Luiz o l'aiva manezzou o ballon co-o brasso avanti de tiâ a-o xeuo co-o pê.

O Wrexham o l'aiva gestio ben o ballon sensa ëse incisivo, ma a scituaçion a l'é cangiâ inti urtimi dexe menuti do primmo tempo.

Ollie Rathbone o l'à raddoggiou l'avvantaggio do Wrexham dòppo a ræ de Liberato Cacace (REUTERS)

Sam Smith o l'à tiou feua primma che Cacace o ne profittesse a-o 37eximo menuto pe marcâ a seu primma ræ co-o Wrexham da 20 iarde, aggiuttou da unna deviaçion assæ legio in sciô tallon de Morato.

I fattorixi do Wrexham en vegnui ancon ciù gròsci trei menuti apreuvo, quande Rathbone a l'é passâ avanti a-o contrasto de Morato pe marcâ a seu tersa ræ in sce quattro partie.

O l'avieiva posciuo ëse a tersa ræ - e a partia fòscia a l'avieiva posciuo serrâse - quande Smith o l'à attraversou a meitæ do campo do Forest sensa ëse marcou, ma o no l'é riescio à passâ avanti a-a gamba teisa de Sels.

L’allenatô do Forest Sean Dyche o l’à fæto unna treggia sostituçion à l’intervallo e o l’à inserio Williams, Morgan Gibbs-White e Nicolas Dominguez pe remediâ a-a scituaçion.

Okonkwo o l'à affermou o penalty decisivo pe denegâ a Omari Hutchinson o gol inta serie di penalty (Martin Rickett/PA Wire)

I òspiti son stæti de ficco ciù fluidi intanto che Okonkwo o l'à deviou in çimma a-a traversa a puniçion de Luiz e o l'à affermou o tio de Nicolo Savona.

O Sels o l'à sarvou ben da-o Broadhead ma o Forest o l'ea in ascendensa e o l'à corpio quande o Saña o l'à inandiou o Gexù ch'o sata pe un header ch'o l'à corpio o palo e o l'à tòsto passou a linia.

A tenscion a l'é montâ quande Hyam o l'à marcou de testa in sce unna mäveggiosa battua de puniçion de George Dobson e Hudson-Odoi o l'à insaccou 60 segondi apreuvo, preparando unna fin da rigoî.

Hudson-Odoi o l'à portou a partia a-i tempi azzontivi à unna mainea fantastica, controllando de peto e battendo co-o pê a-o xeuo à un mòddo perfetto in sce Okonkwo, ma o Wrexham o no s'é fæto scappâ a seu primma vittöia inta FA Cup contra unna squaddra de mascima serie dòppo 26 anni.

O Sean Dyche o l'à fæto eutto cangiamenti inta squaddra do Forest e o l'à ciammou i seu zugoei de primma çernia ma o no l'é arriescio à passâ a linia (Martin Rickett/PA Wire)

Da unn'atra parte da FA Cup, l'Oxford United o l'é avansou a-o quarto round con unna vittöia pe 4-3 in scî MK Dons e o Port Vale o l'à guägno o Fleetwood pe 1-0. O Wigan Athletic o l'é anæto avanti ascì dòppo unna exibiçion stramesuâ à Deepdale ch'a l'à visto a squaddra da Liga Un guägnâ pe 1-0 ascì i inseguitoî di play-off do Campionato Preston North End.

The hosts took the lead in the 26th minute via the prolific Diaz as the Real Madrid player showed his scoring instinct.

Achraf Hakimi's corner was headed goalwards by Ayoub El Kaabi and Diaz deflected the ball in from close range.

He has now scored in each of Morocco's five games and extends his own record for most goals by a Moroccan at a single Cup of Nations finals, but left the field late on with a heavily strapped thigh that will be a concern for coach Walid Regragui.

Chances were hard to come by for both sides, but Abde Ezzalzouli headed narrowly over the crossbar from another Hakimi corner, while the latter laid on a headed chance for Saibari that was spurned.

Cameroon were unfortunate not to get a penalty kick when Mbeumo was caught in the box as Mauritanian referee Dahane Beida waved play on, while Georges-Kevin Nkoudou headed wide at the back post with the Indomitable Lions' best chance of the game.

Morocco made it 2-0 minutes later to kill off the contest when Saibari was left unmarked at the back post and had time to control the ball and fire low into the far corner of the net.

Ismael Saibari gave Morocco breathing space against Cameroon (REUTERS)

In Friday's other quarter-final, Iliman Ndiaye scored the only goal as Senegal booked an Afcon semi-final berth for the third time in the last four tournaments, beating 10-man Mali 1-0.

Ndiaye netted after 27 minutes, taking advantage of a goalkeeping howler to put Senegal ahead in a tense derby against their west African neighbours.

Mali were reduced to 10 men for the second half after captain Yves Bissouma was sent off for a second caution on the stroke of halftime.

He was booked first for a clumsy challenge in the 25th minute and was dismissed after a needless foul on Idrissa Gana Gueye.

Mali were down to 10 men from the 26th minute of their previous clash against Tunisia and still managed to squeeze through on penalties but there was no recovery this time around against a polished Senegalese outfit.

I padroin de casa en passæ in avvantaggio a-o menuto 26 graçie a-o prolifico Diaz, ch'o l'à dæto preuva do seu instinto da goleador.

O corner do Achraf Hakimi o l'é stæto pontou da-o Ayoub El Kaabi e o Diaz o l'à desviou o ballon da-a vexin.

Oua o l'à segnou inte tutte e çinque partie do Maròcco e o l'estende o seu record pe-i ciù tanti gol de un marrocchin inte unna sola finale da Coppa de Naçioin, ma o l'à lasciou o campo tardi con unna coscia ben ben ligâ ch'a saià unna preoccupaçion pe-o coach Walid Regragui.

E occasion son stæte poche pe tutte e doe e squaddre, ma Abde Ezzalzouli l'à mandòu de testa appena sorvia a traversa da un atro corner de Hakimi, mente quest'urtimo o gh'à servîo a Saibari un'occasion de testa che no l'é stæta sfruttâ.

O Camerun o l'é stæto desgraçiou de no avei ottegnuo un penalti quande o Mbeumo o l'é stæto piggiou inte l'area tanto che l'arbitrou mauritan Dahane Beida o l'à fæto anâ avanti, tanto che o Georges-Kevin Nkoudou o l'à tiou sciù a testa in sciô pòsto de derê co-a megio occaxon di Lion Indomitabili da partia.

O Maròcco o l'à portou o resultato in sciô 2-0 pöchi menuti apreuvo e o l'à serrou de fæto a partia, quande Saibari, stæto lasciou libero in sciô segondo pâ, o l'à avuo o tempo de controllâ o ballon e de batte un cäso rasotæra verso o canto ciù lontan da ræ.

Ismael Saibari o l'à dæto scanfio a-o Maròcco contra o Camerun (REUTERS)

Inte l'atro quarto de finale de venardì, o Iliman Ndiaye o l'à marcou l'unico gòl into momento che o Senegal o l'à marcou a semifinale de l'Afcon pe-a tersa vòtta inti urtimi quattro tornei, battuo o Mali de 10 zugoei pe 1-0.

Ashley Barnes at the double as Burnley claim welcome win over Millwall

Ashley Barnes bagged a brace as Burnley put their Premier League worries on hold to cruise into the fourth round of the FA Cup with a 5-1 win over Millwall.

The 36-year-old scored his first goal of the season early on and added his second midway through the second half as the blundering Lions gifted a confident home side the most emphatic of wins.

Boss Scott Parker made eight changes to the side that started in Wednesday's 2-2 draw with Manchester United and they did not disappoint, as further goals from Loum Tchaouna and Jaidon Anthony put them out of sight by half-time.

Substitute Jaydon Banel added Burnley's fifth on the stroke of 90 minutes before the shell-shocked Lions, who had completely capitulated, netted an added-time consolation through Josh Coburn.

Burnley dominated the opening exchanges and grabbed the lead in the 11th minute when Jacob Bruun Larsen squared for Barnes to sweep home past visiting goalkeeper Steven Benda.

The Lions mustered little in response, with Aidomo Emakhu booting their best chance straight at Burnley keeper Max Weiss after being released down the left by Joe Bryan.

But the visitors slowly grew into the game and should have levelled when Jake Cooper got his head on Alfie Doughty's cross from deep on the left but was denied by a brilliant over-arm save from Weiss.

The keeper saved again from Cooper on the half-hour as Millwall threatened a leveller but the visitors were undone by two defensive errors that put the game beyond their grasp.

Tchaouna was allowed to thread his left-foot shot from the edge of the box past a static Benda on 35 minutes and shortly before the break the Millwall keeper's poor clearance ultimately gifted Anthony the chance to slide home his side's third.

Millwall looked livelier at the start of the second half and Thierno Ballo should have done better when he found space to get a shot off in the left side of the box, but the home side were clearly in cruise control.

Tchaouna came close to his second when he rifled a shot against the outside of Benda's right-hand post and the increasingly inevitable fourth arrived on 65 minutes when Kamarl Grant made a hash of clearing Anthony's right-wing cross and a delighted Barnes mopped up.

Hunting for a hat-trick, Barnes flashed a header straight at Benda as the linesman's flag was raised, but it was Banel who completed the rout from close range before Coburn's confident finish in stoppage time.

O 36enne o l'à marcou o seu primmo gòl da saxon a-a primma e o l'à azzonto o seu segondo à meitæ do segondo tempo, tanto che i Lions sbaliæ regallavan à unna squaddra de cà segua a ciù fòrte de vittöie.

O baccan Scott Parker o l'à apportou eutto cangi a-a formaçion ch'a l'aiva zugou pe-a primma vòtta inta patta pe 2-2 de mäcordì contra o Manchester United e i zugoei no an deluso e aspëtative, con de atre ræ stæte misse à segno da Loum Tchaouna e Jaidon Anthony che an portou o zeugo in sciô seguo za into primmo tempo.

Jaydon Banel, ch'o l'é introu dòppo, o l'à marcou a quinta ræ a-o scazze di 90 menuti, primma che i Lions, scioccæ e za arreixi do tutto, marchessan a ræ da bandea inti menuti de repiggio con Josh Coburn.

O Burnley o l'à dominou i primmi menuti do zeugo e l'à piggiou o commando a-o menuto unze, quande Jacob Bruun Larsen o l'à servio Barnes, ch'o l'à superou o portê òspite Steven Benda.

I Lions an replicou pöco, con l'Aidomo Emakhu ch'o l'à dæto a seu megio occaxon drita contra o portê do Burnley Max Weiss dòppo ëse stæto mollou da-a manciña da-o Joe Bryan.

Ma i vixitatoî son cresciui cian cianin inta partia e avieivan dovuo fâ o livello quande o Jake Cooper o l'à misso a testa in sciô cross do Alfie Doughty da-o fondo in sciâ manciña ma o l'é stæto refuou da un brillante arrembo in sciô brasso do Weiss.

O portê o l'à sarvou torna da-o Cooper inta mezz'oa quande o Millwall o l'à menassou un livellatô ma i vixitatoî en stæti desfæti da doî erroî de defeisa che an misso a partia a-o de là da seu capaçitæ.

A-o 35' Tchaouna o l'à posciuo infiâ con un tio de scinistro da-o limite de l'area un Benda inmòbile, e pöco avanti da pösa unna pescima respinta do portê do Millwall a l'à finio pe regallâ à Anthony l'occaxon pe marcâ a tersa ræ da seu squaddra con un tio à tæra.

O Millwall o l'é parsciuo ciù vivaçe a-o comenso do segondo tempo e Thierno Ballo o l'avieiva posciuo fâ de megio quande o l'à attrovou o spaçio pe tiâ da-a manciña de l'area, ma se veddeiva ciæo che a squaddra de casa a l'aiva o contròllo da partia.

Tchaouna o l'é anæto vexin à raddoggiâ con un tio ch'o l'à corpio l'esterno do pâ drito de Benda; a quarta ræ, incangio, ch'a no se poeiva ciù schivâ, a l'é arrivâ a-o 65' quande Kamarl Grant o l'à sbaliou a respinta in sce un cross da-a drita de Anthony e un Barnes contento comme tutto o l'à insaccou.

A-a reçerca da tripletta, Barnes o l'à tiou de testa drito in sce Benda, tanto che l'avvardalinee o tiava sciù a bandeta; ma o l'é stæto Banel à completâ a ræ da distansa ravvexinâ, avanti da ræ segua de Coburn missa à segno inti tempi de repiggio.

source:
Robin Roefs" penalty saves secures Sunderland's spot in FA Cup fourth round

Get the Adam Clery Football Column. A newsletter that unpacks the absurdities and oddities of the beautiful game

The ACFC newsletter: unpacking football's absurdities

Unpack football's oddities with the ACFC newsletter

Robin Roefs was Sunderland's hero as Everton's FA Cup hopes came to a premature end once again after three woeful penalties in a shootout saw the Black Cats reach round four.

David Moyes" threadbare squad looked like exiting in normal time until James Garner's 89th-minute spot-kick cancelled out Enzo Le Fee's brilliant first-half strike.

But extra time was the last thing the hosts, down to just 12 senior players, needed and when the shootout came around Garner, Thierno Barry and Beto all saw their efforts saved by Roefs.

Le Fee, Granit Xhaka and Luke O'Nien confidently scored their first three attempts to help Sunderland into the fourth round for only the second time in 11 seasons.

It was a hammer blow to Everton, who were dragged back into the game by Adam Aznou, a £7.8million signing from Valladolid in the summer who had not had a sniff of first-team action.

The teenager's only senior football was two appearances in the EFL Trophy back in September and October and his 86th-minute introduction for Merlin Rohl was only because Moyes had little to no option.

But the Spanish-born Moroccan showed more drive in the four minutes of regulation time than many of his battle-weary team-mates had in the preceding 86 - particularly fellow 19-year-old and summer arrival Tyler Dibling, who cost five times as much.

Within three minutes he won an admittedly soft penalty after a shoulder-to-shoulder challenge by Trai Hume allowing Garner to equalise.

Replays of the foul on the big screens at full-time enraged Xhaka, who hurled his water bottle into the turf and raged at the perceived injustice to anyone in earshot, but the Black Cats" captain was soon celebrating.

It is rare for Sunderland, promoted from the Championship last season, to be favourites in any game but the fact Regis Le Bris was able to make five changes and still have the likes of Dan Ballard, Brian Brobbey, Omar Alderete and Wilson Isidor in reserve swung the odds in their favour.

Injuries, the Africa Cup of Nations and suspensions for Michael Keane and Jack Grealish were compounded by Tim Iroegbunam's hamstring problem which took the absences to nine.

Barry, the one senior player he left out, accounted for 23 of the 27 first-team appearances among the substitutes with five of six academy players not having previously featured at all.

After Harrison Armstrong sliced wide their only first chance of the first half, Sunderland took control and should have been comfortably ahead by the interval.

Their first shot resulted in the opener - and what a goal.

Everton failed to deal with a long throw and Eliezer Mayenda teed up Le Fee to send a cushioned right-footed volley curling past Jordan Pickford.

Moyes had a face like thunder and his demeanour was not improved as Pickford clawed away a Nordi Mukiele overhead kick and tipped away, at full-stretch, Romaine Mundle's strike from distance.

Surprisingly, the Everton boss did not make the only change available to him and sacrifice one of his five midfielders for Barry at the start of the second half, but they did not come to life until Mayenda rolled an angled shot just wide with less than half an hour remaining.

Beto's appeal for a penalty for a shirt pull by Hume was waved away but referee John Brooks obliged when Aznou went down and Garner equalised.

Unfortunately for Everton their subsequent penalties were not as confident, with Barry and Beto's stuttering run-ups far from convincing, as Roefs saved all three.
