O boletìn de l'ACFC: spiegâ e asurditæ do balón

Descrovî e stranesse do ballon co-a newsletter de l'ACFC

O Robin Roefs o l'é stæto l'eröe do Sunderland quande e speranse de l'Everton pe-a FA Cup son arrivæ torna à unna fin tempoia dòppo trei penali triste inte unna sparâ ch'an visto i Black Cats arrivâ a-o quarto round.

A reusa, za in sciô ponto de cazze sfinia, de David Moyes a paiva destinâ à l'eliminaçion inti tempi regolamentari, fintanto che o penarchi trasformou da James Garner à l'89' o no l'à annullou a ræ brillante stæta marcâ da Enzo Le Fee into primmo tempo.

Ma o tempo extra o l'ea l'urtima cösa ch'a serviva òspiti, restæ solo 12 zugoei ciù esperti, e quande l'é arrivou o scontro pe-o Garner, o Thierno Barry e o Beto an visto tutti i seu sfòrsci sarvæ da-o Roefs.

O Le Fee, o Granit Xhaka e o Luke O'Nien con confiansa an marcou e seu primme træ tentative pe aggiuttâ o Sunderland a-o quarto gio pe-a segonda vòtta inte 11 stagioin.

O l'é stæto un corpo terribile pe l'Everton, ch'o l'é stæto tiou torna into zeugo da-o Adam Aznou, un contræto da 7,8 mioin de sterliñe da-o Valladolid inta stæ ch'o no l'aiva ancon mai zugou inta primma squaddra.

L'unica esperiensa de ballon à livello profescionistico do zoveno a remonta à doe presense inta EFL Trophy à settembre e ottobre, e a seu intrâ inte l'86eximo menuto a-o pòsto de Merlin Rohl o l'é avvegnuo solo perché Moyes, pratticamente, o no l'aiva de alternative.

Ma o marocchin nasciuo in Spagna, o l'à mostrou ciù grinta inti quattro menuti de tempo regolamentare de quello ch'aivan mostrou tanti di seu compagni de squaddra, ch'ean za stanchi, inti 86 menuti primma; mascime o seu coetaneo de 19 anni e o neuvo accatto da stæ, Tyler Dibling, ch'o l'é costou çinque vòtte tanto.

Into gio de trei menuti o l'à ottegnuo un penarchi, sens'atro dubio, dòppo un contrasto spalla à spalla con Trai Hume, ch'o l'à permisso à Garner d'appattâ o zeugo.

E repetiçioin do foul in scî schermi à tempo completo an fæto arraggiâ o Xhaka, ch'o l'à cacciou a seu bottiggia d'ægua into prou e o s'é arraggiou pe l'ingiustiçia perçepia à chi gh'ea d'arente, ma o capitanio di Black Cats o l'à festezzou fito.

L'é ræo che o Sunderland, promòsso da-a Championship inta stagion passâ, o segge favorio inte tutte e partie, ma o fæto che Regis Le Bris o l'agge posciuo dâ çinque cangi e avei ancon in sciâ banca di zugoei comme Dan Ballard, Brian Brobbey, Omar Alderete e Wilson Isidor o l'à fæto pende a bansa à seu favô.

A-i açidenti, a-a Coppa d'Africa e a-e squalifiche de Michael Keane e Jack Grealish s'é azzonto o problema a-i moscoli ischiocrurali de Tim Iroegbunam, fæto ch'o l'à portou à neuve o numero de assense.

O Barry, l'unico zugou senior ch'o l'à lasciou feua, o l'à fæto 23 de 27 exibiçioin inta primma squaddra tra i sostituti, con çinque di sëi zugoei de l'academia che no aivan zugou pe ninte primma.

Dòppo che Harrison Armstrong o l'à asgreiou l'unica occaxon do primmo tempo, o Sunderland o l'à piggiou o contròllo e o l'avieiva dovuo serrâ o primo tempo con de l'avvantaggio.

O seu primmo tio o l'à portou e ræ de l'1-0: e che ræ!

L'Everton o no l'é riescio à gestî unna remissa longa e Eliezer Mayenda o l'à servio Le Fee, che con un tocco de trito o l'à battuo a-o botto, mandando o ballon à gio ciù in là de Jordan Pickford.

Moyes o l'aiva unn'esprescion scua e o seu umô o no l'é vegnuo ciù bon quande Pickford o l'à refuou unna tiâ de reverso de Nordi Mukiele e o l'à deviou, con cacciâseghe, o tio da-a distansa de Romaine Mundle.

Sorprendentemente, l'allenatô de l'Everton o no l'à fæto o solo cangio ch'o l'aveiva à seu dispoxiçion, sagrificando un di seu çinque centrocampisti pe Barry a l'inìçio do segondo tempo, ma l'Everton o no s'é risvegiou fin quande Mayenda o l'à arrigoelou un tio angolou de pòco a-o scianco con manco de meza oa a-o termine.

A domanda de Beto pe un penarchi pe un fallo de Hume a l'é stæta ignorâ, ma l'arbitro John Brooks o l'à concesso o penarchi quande Aznou o l'é cheito e Garner o l'à appattou o zeugo.

Purtròppo pe l'Everton, i penarchi vegnui dòppo no an convinto a-o mæximo mòddo: a corsa exitante de Barry e Beto a no l'à convinto pe ninte, e Roefs o l'à parou tutti trei i tii.

L'Everton o no l'é riescio à gestî unna remissa longa e Eliezer Mayenda o l'à servio Le Fee, che con un tocco de trito o l'à battuo a-o botto, mandando o ballon à gio ciù in là de Jordan Pickford.

Moyes o l'aiva unn'esprescion scua e o seu umô o no l'é vegnuo ciù bon quande Pickford o l'à refuou unna tiâ de reverso de Nordi Mukiele e o l'à deviou, con cacciâseghe, o tio da-a distansa de Romaine Mundle.

Sorprendentemente, l'allenatô de l'Everton o no l'à fæto o solo cangio ch'o l'aveiva à seu dispoxiçion, sagrificando un di seu çinque centrocampisti pe Barry a l'inìçio do segondo tempo, ma l'Everton o no s'é risvegiou fin quande Mayenda o l'à arrigoelou un tio angolou de pòco a-o scianco con manco de meza oa a-o termine.
A domanda de Beto pe un penarchi pe un fallo de Hume a l'é stæta ignorâ, ma l'arbitro John Brooks o l'à concesso o penarchi quande Aznou o l'é cheito e Garner o l'à appattou o zeugo.
Purtròppo pe l'Everton, i penarchi vegnui dòppo no an convinto a-o mæximo mòddo: a corsa exitante de Barry e Beto a no l'à convinto pe ninte, e Roefs o l'à parou tutti trei i tii.

The Case for Impeaching Donald Trump

Bombs over Latin America: It's giving Wag the Dog, if you ask me. The administration, seemingly hot to bring back neoconservative military conquest, soft-launched its latest regime change war in Venezuela by making indiscriminate attacks on boats in the Caribbean and Pacific waters off of Central America. These attacks, all undertaken without a jot of congressional oversight and on the dubious premise that the boats were packed with fentanyl bound for the United States, were murderous on their own. But the news that the military was ordered to strike an already stricken boat in a "double tap" attack to kill any survivors has raised the specter of war crimes - and in a way that even many Republicans don't seem ready to countenance.

Trump's Binance buddy gets a pardon: Changpeng Zhao began this year the disgraced former CEO of Binance, the world's largest cryptocurrency exchange, having done prison time for, as the Biden DOJ put it, "failing to maintain an effective anti-money laundering (AML) program," violating the Bank Security Act, and allowing money to flow freely to a host of bad actors, including "terrorists, cybercriminals, and child abusers." But Zhao, having forfeited the right to run Binance, wanted back in. So he used his connections to Trump's family and inner circle to secure a pardon that would let him run the show again. In return, Zhao showered his attention on World Liberty Financial - using Binance's leverage to enrich Trump's private crypto fund. TNR's Tim Noah was positively apoplectic about the shady arrangement.

Chips to China: Speaking of Tim Noah and apoplexy: It's probably not great that one firm, Nvidia, has come to possess such godlike, market-moving power. Its outsize importance to the global economy had Noah fingering it as one of the major pillars to crumble, when he gamed out a potential Trump stock market crash back in October. Trump's been doing what he can to boost Nvidia's fortunes, however: This year, the president broke with long-standing national security tradition and announced that he was permitting the firm to sell its H200 chips to China. As The New York Times" David Sanger noted, the deal - the fruits of "intense lobbying" from Nvidia CEO and White House gadfly Jensen Huang - raised a basic question: "If the chips that power the most advanced technology can be sold to the United States" chief technological, military and financial competitor, where is the new line drawn?" That's probably the least of Trump's concerns, however: The deal also guaranteed that "25 percent of all the revenues from the sales would go to the United States," in yet another case of this administration's affection for fascist corporatism.

E raxoin pe mette sotta accusa Donald Trump

Bombe in sce l'America latiña: a me pâ franco unna scituaçion a-a Wag the Dog. L'amministraçion, in apparensa piña de voentæ de portâ torna in sveuga e conquiste neoconservatoe militare, a l'à avviou in sordiña a seu urtima guæra pe-o cangio de regimme in Venezuela, corpindo à un mòddo indiscriminou de imbarcaçioin inte ægue di Caraibi e do Paçifico a-o largo de l'America do Çentro. Sti attacchi, stæti fæti tutti sensa nisciun contròllo da-a parte do Congresso e in sciâ base da premissa dubia che e imbarcaçioin ean piñe de fetanil diretto verso i Stati Unii, da pe liatri ean di omiçiddi. Ma a neuva che à l'exerçito l'ea stæto commandou de corpî unn'imbarcaçion za dannezzâ con un attacco "double tap" pe ammassâ di eventuali superstiti a l'à sollevou o fantaxima di crimini de guæra, e à un mòddo che manco tanti repubrichen pan dispòsti à comportâ.

L'amigo de Trump in sce Binance o l'ottëgne a graçia: Changpeng Zhao o l'à comensou st'anno comme ex CEO cheito in desgraçia de Binance, a piattaforma de scangio de criptovalue ciù grande do mondo, dòppo avei scontou unna peña detentiva pe, comm'o l'à affermou o Departamento de Giustiçia de Biden, "no avei mantegnuo un programma antiriçiclaggio (AML) efficaçe", avei violou o Bank Security Act e avei permisso che i dinæ sccioissan sensa contròllo verso unna serie de malemmi, compreiso "terroristi, criminali informatichi e pedòfili". Ma Zhao, avuo renonçiou a-o drito de gestî Binance, o voeiva intrâghe torna. Coscì o l'à deuviou e seu connescioin co-a famiggia de Trump e o seu gio de contatti streiti pe asseguâse unna graçia ch'a ghe permettesse de tornâ a-o commando. In cangio, Zhao o l'à misso tutta a seu attençion in sce World Liberty Financial, e o l'à deuviou l'influensa de Binance pe inricchî o fondo privou de cirptovalue de Trump. Tim Noah de TNR o l'ea in sce tutte e furie pe quell'accòrdio sospetto.

Chip a-a Ciña: à propöxito de Tim Noah e d'indignaçion: probabilmente a no l'é unna boña cösa che unn'açienda solo, Nvidia, a segge arrivâ à avei unna capaçitæ coscì diviña d'influensâ o mercou. A seu enorme importansa pe l'economia do mondo a l'à portou Noah à indicâla comme unna de colònne portante destinæ à derruâ, quande o l'à ipotizzou unna cheita potençiale do mercou açionäio sotta Trump inte l'ottobre passou. Trump, à tutti i mòddi, o l'à fæto tutto quello ch'o l'à posciuo pe favorî o destin de Nvidia: st'anno o prescinde o l'à rotto con unna tradiçion de longa dæta in matëia de seguessa naçionale e o l'à annonçiou ch'o l'avieiva permisso à l'açienda de vende i seu chip H200 a-a Ciña. Comm'o l'à osservou David Sanger do New York Times, l'accòrdio - fruto de unn'"intensa attivitæ de lobbying" da-a parte do CEO de Nvidia e provocatô da Casa Gianca Jensen Huang - a l'à sollevou unna domanda fondamentale: "Se i chip ch'alimentan a tecnologia ciù avansâ peuan ëse vendui a-o prinçipâ concorrente tecnològico, militare e finansiäio di Stati Unii, donde l'é che se peu tiâ unna linea de demarcaçion?". À tutte e mainee, l'é façile che sta chì a segge uña de urtime preoccupaçioin de Trump: l'accòrdio o garantiva ascì che "o 25% de tutti i guägni de vendie o saieiva anæto a-i Stati Unii", inte un neuvo caxo d'affeçion de st'amministraçion pe-o corporativismo fascista.

Celtic hammer Dundee United on O'Neill's return

Normal service resumed at Celtic Park as champions Celtic secured a dominant 4-0 win over Dundee United and their first clean sheet since Martin O'Neill's previous game in charge.

Two first-half goals in five minutes from Yang Hyun-jun and Arne Engels sent Celtic on their way as O'Neill returned to the dugout in style following Wilfried Nancy's brief but disastrous reign.

Substitute Benjamin Nygren grabbed his 11th goal of the season and Daizen Maeda netted on the rebound to equal Celtic's two biggest wins of the league season so far. Both of them were in O'Neill's caretaker spell in charge, which resulted in seven wins from eight games.

Celtic sent for the 73-year-old on Monday after terminating Nancy's contract in the wake of six defeats - and 18 goals against - in eight matches.

The chaos, confusion and defensive fragility that marked Nancy's reign disappeared as the Hoops moved three points off the top of the table.

Nobody in the stadium would have been surprised to see O'Neill restore Celtic's long-standing 4-3-3 formation and the team picked up where they left off under O'Neill, as if they had awoken from a nightmare and got on with life as normal.

Centre-back Liam Scales was back to the consistent form he displayed before suffering in and out of a back three under the Frenchman.

Callum McGregor dictated play again and Celtic's wide players, Yang and Sebastian Tounekti, were given attacking licence after being handed wing-back roles by the former Columbus Crew head coach.

Celtic enjoyed 78 per cent possession, had 22 shots at goal and let United have just three. Their opponents averaged 12 shots during Nancy's tenure and United managed 17 themselves during their 2-1 win over the Hoops at Tannadice less than four weeks ago.

Celtic penned United in from the start, with Kieran Tierney instrumental in creating a series of first-half chances.

The left-back had a shot deflected wide, Yang and Scales threatened from headers and Maeda flicked a low cross of the bar, before the pressure paid off in the 27th minute.

Such was Celtic's dominance that Scales found himself in possession on the edge of the box and rolled a pass to Yang, who drilled home from 20 yards.

Maeda soon mis-kicked a volley before Engels produced a first-time finish from Tierney's pass.

It was not all plain sailing for Celtic in the first half. Mexican right-back Julian Araujo marked his first start with a yellow card for a dangerous challenge on Will Ferry, who was still hobbling when he took the resulting free-kick.

United also had chances and Dario Naamo looked unsure whether to head or volley Craig Sibbald's deep cross and did neither and Owen Stirton twice came close.

The striker was firstly foiled by a goal-saving block from Scales after being gifted possession by Auston Trusty and later shot just wide from 18 yards after the Celtic central defence backed off.

United brought on winger Amar Fatah for holding midfielder Pan Camara at half-time but Celtic were even more dominant in the second half.

Reo Hatate and Maeda missed good chances before Nygren shot high into the net from six yards in the 63rd minute.

Maeda had an easy finish six minutes later after Tounekti's shot was saved.
hypothesis:
O Celtic o l'arreversa o Dundee United a-o retorno de O'Neill

A-o Celtic Park l'é tornou a normalitæ: o Celtic, campion in carrega, o l'à conquistou unna netta vittöia pe 4-0 in sciô Dundee United, e o l'à misso à segno a seu primma partia sensa reçeive de ræ da l'urtima partia ch'o l'à zugou sotta a guidda de Martin O'Neill.

Doe ræ into primmo tempo in çinque menuto de Yang Hyun-jun e Arne Engels an dæto comenso a-a remonta do Celtic, tanto che O'Neill o l'é tornou in sciâ banca in gran stile dòppo o breve ma desastroso regno de Wilfried Nancy.

O sostituto Benjamin Nygren o l'à piggiou o seu 11° gol da saxon e o Daizen Maeda o l'à fæto un gol in sciô rebound pe fâ pægia e doe ciù grende guägne do Celtic da saxon de liga fin oua. Tutti doî ean into periodo de caretaker do O'Neill in carrega, ch'o l'à portou à sette guägne inte eutto partie.

O Celtic o l’à piggiou o 73enne lunesdì dòppo avéi resòlto o contræto de Nancy, apreuvo à sëi desfæte - e 18 gòl patii - inte eutto partie.

L'invexendo, a confuxon e a fragilitæ defensciva che an caratterizzou o regno de Nancy en scentæ, tanto che i Hoops se son portæ à trei ponti da-a çimma da clascifica.

Nisciun into stadio o se saieiva sorpreiso de vedde o O'Neill ch'o l'à repiggiou a formaçion 4-3-3 do Celtic e a squaddra a l'à repiggiou donde a l'ea arrestâ co-o O'Neill, comme s'a se fïse addesciâ da un peson e a l'aise continuou a vitta comme pe-o sòlito.

O defensô çentrale Liam Scales o l'é tornou a-a seu forma costante ch'o l'aiva mostrou avanti de patî à l'interno e à l'esterno de unna defeisa à trei sotta a guidda do franseise.

Callum McGregor o l'à dettou torna o zeugio e a-i zugoei de fascia do Celtic, Yang e Sebastian Tounekti, l'é stæto dæto carta gianca in attacco, dòppo che o vegio allenatô do Columbus Crew o gh'aiva confiou o ròllo de tersin.

O Celtic o l'à gödio do 78% do possesso do ballon, o l'à tiou 22 vòtte in pòrta e o l'à conçesso a-o United solo che trei tii. I seu avversäi aivan unna media de 12 tii durante a gestion de Nancy e o United o n'aiva fæto 17 inta seu vittöia pe 2-1 in scî Hoops à Tannadice, meno de quattro settemañe fa.

O Celtic o l'à serrou o United in area fin da-o comenso, con Kieran Tierney ch'o l'é stæto determinante into creâ unna serie d'occaxoin into primmo tempo.

O tersin da manciña o l'à visto un di seu tii ch'o l'é stæto deviou in de feua, Yang e Scales an dæto leugo à di reiseghi con di corpi de testa e Maeda o l'à sfiorou a traversa con un cross rasotæra, avanti che a prescion a se fesse sentî a-o 27eximo menuto.

O dominio do Celtic o l'ea mai tanto fòrte che Scales o s'é arretrovou co-o ballon a-o limite de l'äia e o l'à servio Yang, ch'o l'à insaccou da 20 iarde de distansa.

Maeda o l'à fito mancou un tio a-o xeuo, avanti che Engels o realizzesse unna ræ a-o primmo tocco graçie a-o passaggio de Tierney.

O primmo tempo o no o l'é stæto tutto reuse pe-o Celtic. O tersin drito mescican Julian Araujo o l'à marcou o seu exòrdio da titolare con un cartellin giano pe un intervento reisegoso in sce Will Ferry, ch'o ranghezzava ancon quand'o l'à tiou a battua de puniçion conseguente.

O United o l'à avuo ascì de occaxoin: Dario Naamo o l'à exitou tra un corpo de testa e un tio a-o xeuo in sce un cross profondo de Craig Sibbald, sensa fâ ni l'un e ni l'atro, tanto che Owen Stirton o l'à tòsto marcou unna ræ pe doe vòtte.

L'attaccante o l'é stæto primma neutralizzou da un intervento sarvifico de Scales dòppo avei reçevuo o ballon da Auston Trusty, dapeu o l'à tiou de pöco à sciando da 18 iarde dòppo che a defeisa çentrale do Celtic a l'ea anæta inderê.

O United o l'à fæto intrâ l'esterno Amar Fatah a-o pòsto do median Pan Camara a l'intervallo, ma o Celtic o l'è stæto ancon ciù dominante into segondo tempo.

Reo Hatate e Maeda an sgreiou de boñe occaxoin avanti che Nygren o tiesse erto inta ræ da sëi iarde a-o 63eximo menuto.

Maeda o l'à marcou co-a pòrta veua sëi menuti apreuvo, dòppo che o tio de Tounekti o l'ea stæto parou.

US bound Thompson stars as Galway reach FBD final

California-bound Matthew Thompson lashed home 2-06 as Galway overcame Leitrim by 11 points in Tuam to book their spot in next week's FBD League decider.

2025 Young Footballer of the Year nominee Thompson will be out of action for the entirety of the league and the early part of the championship, with Padraic Joyce confirming that the Salthill-Knocknacarra players is studying in Berkeley for the upcoming semester.

He was the leading figure on a largely experimental Galway side - which also contained Cian Hernon and Kieran Molloy - as they came from three points down at half-time to beat Leitrim.

Thompson buried a goal in the top corner in the first half but the Connacht champions trailed Leitrim at the break, Killian Gaffney proving effective from placed balls, while Ryan O'Rourke and Jack Kelly also landed points.

Galway manager Padraic Joyce remonstrates with the referee over a decision

However, with Thompson converting a second half penalty, Galway eased home after the interval, with 10 different scorers overall as they ran out 2-19 to 0-14 winners.

After two rounds of the FBD League, the top two progress to next week's final, with Galway facing the winner of tomorrow's Roscommon-Mayo tie.

In Leinster, Westmeath have booked their spot in the O'Byrne Cup final after an 11-point win over Offaly in a goal-fest in Mullingar.

Waiting for them in the decider is a Kildare outfit that defeated Dublin 1-22 to 1-13.

Mark McHugh's Westmeath side advanced ahead of reigning champions Longford following a coin toss last Saturday but they impressed on the field of play on Saturday.

A brace of goals apiece from Danny McCarton and Brandon Kelly, plus another from Senan Baker, saw them run out 5-10 to 2-08 winners.

Ciaran Murphy scored two goals either side of half-time to pull the visitors back into the contest, the margin being briefly reduced to three points 11 minutes into the second half.

However, an unanswered burst of 3-02 over the next 15 minutes saw the hosts settle the contest in an emphatic manner.

Kildare found their feet in the second half against Dublin and now are one game away from a first O'Byrne Cup since 2014.

Harry O'Neill fires to the net for Kildare

Both management teams experimented in Newbridge with Dublin in particular shorn of overly familiar faces, but in the first half it seemed to matter little as they led 1-08 to 0-08 at the break.

Jamie McCarville palmed home their goal but it was Clyde Burke who caught the eye for the travelling support with some brilliant shooting that included two orange flags - the second of which was of the highest quality.

Alex Beirne was racking up the scores for the Lilywhites though and his two-point free early in the second half kick-started a run of 1-05 without reply, Harry O'Neill with the goal in the 43rd minute.

Kildare continued to turn the screw with James Harris' late two-pointer sending them on their way.

O Thompson, candidou pe-o Young Footballer of the Year 2025, o saià feua de zeugo pe tutta a liga e pe-a primma parte do campionou, e o Padraic Joyce o l'à confermou che i zugoei da Salthill-Knocknacarra studian à Berkeley pe-o semestre ch'o vëgne.

O l’ea a figua de spicco d’inta formaçion do Galway pe gran parte sperimentale - ch’a comprendeiva ascì Cian Hernon e Kieran Molloy - quande a l’à remontou trei ponti de svantaggio a l’intervallo pe guägnâ Leitrim.

Thompson o l'à marcou unna ræ into canto erto into primmo tempo, ma i campioin do Connacht ean in desavvantaggio contra o Leitrim durante a pösa, con Killian Gaffney ch'o s'é demostrou bravo in scî cäsci piassæ, tanto che ascì Ryan O'Rourke e Jack Kelly an marcou di ponti.

L'allenatô do Galway Padraic Joyce o protesta con l'arbitro pe unna deçixon.

Però, con Thompson ch’o l’à trasformou un penalty do segondo tempo, o Galway o s’é impòsto dòppo l’intervallo, con dexe marcatoî despægi inte l’insemme, pe 2-19 à 0-14.

Into Leinster, o Westmeath o s'é asseguou un pòsto inta finale da O'Byrne Cup dòppo unna vittöia da 11 ponti in sce l'Offaly inte unna partia piña de ræ à Mullingar.

A î aspeta inta finale a squaddra de Kildare, ch'a l'à guägno Dublin è 1-22 à 1-13.

Sabbo passou a squaddra do Westmeath de Mark McHugh a l'é passâ avanti a-i campioin in carrega do Longford apreuvo à un sorteggio, ma sabbo a l'à imprescionou in sciô campo.

Unna cobbia de gòl pe un da-o Danny McCarton e o Brandon Kelly, ciù un da-o Senan Baker, an portou à guägnâ 5-10 à 2-08.

Ciaran Murphy o l'à marcou doe ræ primma e dòppo a pösa pe portâ torna i òspiti inta partia, e o l'à reduto brevemente o margine à trei ponti à 11 menuti da-o comenso do segondo tempo.

Sciben, unna raffega de 3-02 sensa replica pe-i 15 menuti seguenti a l'à permisso a-i padroin de cà de serrâ a partia à un mòddo netto.

O Kildare o l'à trovou o ritmo giusto into segondo tempo contra o Dublin e oua o l'é à unna partia da-a seu primma O'Byrne Cup do 2014.

Harry O'Neill o va à segno pe-o Kildare

Tutti doî i allenatoî an fæto di esperimenti in Newbridge, con Doblin in particolâ sensa de cee tròppo conosciue, ma into primmo tempo pâiva contâ pöco, scicomme ean in avvantaggio 1-08 a 0-08 à l'intervallo.

O Jamie McCarville o l'à reçevuo o seu gòl ma o l'é stæto o Clyde Burke à fâse nottâ da-o sostegnimento da viægio con un tio de gran qualitæ ch'o l'à compreiso doe bandee cô de çetron, a segonda de quæ a l'ea de mascima qualitæ.

Alex Beirne, però, o l'ammuggiava di ponti pe-i Lilywhites e a seu battua de puniçion da doî ponti a-o comenso do segondo tempo o l'à dæto comenso à unna fia de 1-05 sensa replica, con Harry O'Neill ch'o l'à marcou o ponto a-o menuto quarantetrei.

O Kildare o l'é anæto avanti à stenze a mòrscia co-i doî ponti de James Harris inta finale ch'a l'à asccianou o cammin pe-a vittöia.

The Cloudhorizon Waterproof feels purpose-built for the stop-start rhythm of winter commuting. Its lightweight waterproof upper keeps your feet dry without adding bulk, and the shoe's smooth rocker shape helps you roll forward easily, even when you're layered up and carrying heavy loads.

Underfoot, Helion foam creates a cushioned bounce that softens long walks between stations, while the grippy rubber outsole keeps things steady on wet steps and shiny tiles. The pared-back design gives it a polished, modern look, ideal if you prefer a trainer that handles lousy weather subtly, without shouting its technical credentials.

Reading Gloria Steinem's undercover report on being a Playboy Bunny... finished Part I and damn🤔
Despite being well aware of Playboy being uh... a CORPORATION lol... had no idea how much their entire infrastructure truly served to perpetuate classism in an extremely creepy way while outwardly presenting themselves as the "classy" and thus "more ethical" option compared to say, Hustler

I'll post some screenshots later but to give you the gist, Bunnies (who were cocktail waitresses), had to:
- accept lower (by $200-150, equivalent to today's $2.5K) wages than advertised
- hand over 50% of all their tips
- give their last names to "Number 1 key holders" (ergo, celebrities/elites) if asked
- be subjected to a pelvic exam and blood test but weren't allowed to pick the physician
- be spied on by a private eye
- go out if their way to hide their husbands/bfs

The central point that unites all of this:
Bunnies were STRICTLY NOT ALLOWED TO (penalized by termination) date any other employees or customers... BUT accompanying and dating the "Number 1 key holders" was permitted, if not encouraged. See where this is going?

New recruits were given a "Bunny Bible" to study all those bizarre rules and instructions from.
To mention a few more:
- Bunnies' work performance was assessed by a "merit system" (YES, that exact wording!) instead of being written up. Unsurprisingly, merit was not only judged by a good work ethic but also very specific requirements on looks and attitude.
- there was an incentive system in place that rewarded Bunnies who sold the most liquor and merchandise

Sciben ch'ea ben consapevole che Playboy o l'ea eh... unna CORPORAÇION ahah... no aiva idea de quante tutta a seu infrastruttua a servisse pe in davei à perpetuâ o clascismo à unna mainea ch'a mette angoscia comme tutto, presentandose à l'apparensa comme l'opçion "de classe" e donca "ciù etica" in confronto à, femmo un exempio, Hustler

Ciù avanti pubrichiò de schermæ ma pe dâve l'idea, a-e Coniggette (che ean de camee de cocktail) ghe toccava:
- açettâ di saläi ciù basci (200-150 dòllari, equivalente à 2,5mia dòllari d'ancheu) de quelli promissi inte l'annonçio
- dâ via o 50% de tutte e boñemoen
- dâ i seu nommi de famiggia "a-i detentoî da ciave numero 1" (saiva à dî, celebritæ/membri de l'élite) se ghe ô domandavan
- ëse sottopòste à unn'examme pelvico e à di açertamenti do sangue, sensa poei çerne o mego
- ëse spionezzæ da un inspettô privou
- fâ de tutto pe asconde o fæto d'avei o maio/galante

O ponto çentrale ch'o mette insemme tutto questo:
A-e Coniggette l'ea STREITAMENTE PROIBIO (sotta peña de vegnî liçensiæ) de sciortî con di atri dependenti ò casañe... PERÒ l'accompagnamento e a frequentaçion di "detentoî da ciave numero 1" o l'ea permisso, se no incoraggio. Capî comm'a l'é a cösa?

A-e neuve reclute se ghe dava unna "Bibbia de Coniggette" da studiâ tutte quelle regole e instruçioin strafaläie.
Pe dîne ancon dötræ:
- a prestaçion de travaggio de Coniggette a l'ea valuâ con un scistema de meito (SCÌ, gh'é scrito pròpio coscì!) incangio de relaçioin scrite. Coscì, no fa stranio che o meito o no fïse giudicou solo pe unna boña etica de travaggio, ma ascì pe di requixiti ben ben speçifichi in sce l'apparensa e l'atteggiamento.
- gh'ea un scistema d'inçentivaçion ch'o premmiava e Coniggette che vendeivan ciù tanto licô e mercançia

I just had a very nice #dream that I made friends with Lee Chaeyeon. I just started talking to her nand the next thing I know, I have stayed over her house (like when the French kidnapped me for Christmas) and she is telling me to go up stairs and "shuffle up a little bit" (her English was generally excellent) by which she meant "tidy up a little bit" to show her mom we were ready to eat.
She comes upstairs to "shuffle up" her room and starts making gestures to explain what she means ...
1/

(she was always so excited to see me in this dream) because I was taking my coat off instead of "shuffling up."
Then she indicates this little piece of paper and says she has left me an autograph but in return she wants this little trading card I made in second grade of "50 Spikes," a sonic knock-off, obviously with more spikes. (This card actually exists IRL BTW). I start explaining to her what it is and if she really wants it (she did) I at least needed a picture of her holding it.
2/

Partly because I would miss it, but also, otherwise no one would believe me that she had wanted this thing from me.
It was then I realized we still didn't have each others' phone numbers.
3/3

(a l'ea delongo coscì invexendâ de veddime inte sto seunno) perché mi me levava o cappòtto incangio de "shuffle up".
Dapeu a l'indica sto tocchetto de papê e a dixe ch'a m'à lasciou un autografo ma in cangio a veu sta figuriña ch'ò fæto in segonda de "50 Spikes", unna còpia taròcca de sonic ma con ciù ponziggioin, se capisce. (Sta carta tra l'atro a l'existe pe in davei). Me metto à spiegâghe cös'a l'é e s'a â veu davei (a l'à dito de scì) me ghe voeiva a-o manco unna föto donde a â tegniva inte moen.
2/

In parte perché o me saieiva mancou, ma ascì, perché sedonca nisciun o l'avieiva credduo ch'a l'avesse vosciuo sta cösa da mi.
L'é stæto aloa che me son accòrto che no aveivimo ancon o numero de telefono l'un de l'atra.
3/3

Aggi paçiensa
Mi no ò appixonou ninte in sce quella ciattaforma se poeiva fâ de meno.

L'alveare o l'implica unna regiña.

source:
On a lighter note, just saw someone complaining about when games beg you to switch to easy mode when you fail.
I also hate this.
I love having an easy mode. Hell, I think games should just fuckin' let you cheat, as long as competitions all have agreed-on rules about it.
But every game that's pestered me into easy mode has been an instant put-down. I have plenty of games to play, if you want me to be done faster, congrats, I'm done faster.

This is what makes modern Marios - modern-ish anyway - so impossible for me to play.
"Did you die thwee times mawwio? Here's the golden supersuit of invincibility because you suck! If you don't want it, just carefully avoid ever pressing anything besides "start level yes again no no nothing else just start the level".
This is also why I stopped trying to play Phantom Pain. Whenever I died, it'd offer me the chicken hat and default to "yes", eventually I forgot to manually say "fuck off".

I get it's a retention thing, but it's so disrespectful.
Autoscaling difficulty also pisses me off, because I'll be gearing up for a challenge and then the game will panic and lower it to super easy because I've been "struggling".
I'll die or something, go back to try again, but nope, now the challenge is gone. You succeeded! You made the game go away! Don't worry, those challenges were for someone else. Someone better.
I can't remember if I ever completed a game with autoscaling difficulty.

I guess the basic difference between me and their target audience is that I like to figure out how to do something, while their target audience - at least in their heads - likes to take a log flume through a Disneyworld attraction.
A little jostling, a little fluids, but don't worry, baby, daddy Walt's got ya. You're safey-wafe, you don't even have to move, just sit there and tee hee, here's a wittle splashy-splash.
If I wanted that, I'd go sit in a fucking dog park and pet a dog.
hypothesis:
Pe cangiâ argomento, ò visto quarchedun ch'o s'allamenta de quande i zeughi te domandan de passâ a-a modalitæ façile quande ti fallisci.
Sta chì a l'é unn'atra cösa ch'a me fa arraggiâ.
Me gusta avei unna mainea façile. Bellicite, mi penso che i zeughi dovieivan lasciâte barâ comme te gia, basta che e competiçioin aggian tutte de regole concordæ.
Ma tutti i zeughi che m'an ascidiou co-a modalitæ façile î ò scartæ a-a primma. Ò tanti zeughi da zugâ, e se ti veu che finisce ciù fito, complimenti, ò finio ciù fito.

Sta chì a l'é a cösa ch'a rende tanto imposcibile pe mi zugâ a-i Mario moderni, ò ciù ò meno moderni.
"T'ê mòrto træ vòtte, Marieto? T'ô chì o teu vestî d'öo de l'invinçibilitæ, perché t'ê un betòrdo! Se no ti ô veu, no stâ à toccâ nint'atro a-o de feua de "comensa torna o livello scì no nint'atro comensa o livello e basta".
Sto chì o l'é ascì o motivo pe-o quæ ò desmisso de provâ à zugâ à Phantom Pain. Tutte e vòtte che moiva, o m'offriva o cappello co-o pollastro e de base o metteiva "scì", e in sciâ fin me son ascordou de mette "vanni à bagasce".

Capiscio ch'a l'é unna cösa de conservaçion, ma a l'é mai tanta farta de respetto.
A difficortæ de l'autoscalaçion ascì a me manda feua de cascia, perché saiò apreuvo à inandiâme pe unna sfidda e dapeu o zeugo o va in panico e o vëgne super façile perché ò "avuo de difficoltæ".
Meuiò ò quarcösa, torniò à provâ torna, ma na, oua a sfidda a l'é finia. Ti gh'ê arriescio! T'æ fæto scentâ a partia! N'aggi poia, quelle sfidde ean pe quarchedun atro. Quarchedun de megio.
No m'arregòrdo s'ò mai completou un zeugo con unna difficortæ d'autoscalaçion.

Creddo che a differensa primmäia tra mi e o seu pubrico obiettivo a segge che à mi me piaxe capî comme fâ quarcösa, tanto che a-o seu pubrico obiettivo - a-o manco inta seu testa - ghe piaxe passâ un pö de tempo inte unn'attraçion de Disneyworld.
Un pö de sponcioin, un pö de liquidi che sccioiscian, ma n'aggi poia, mottin de succao, o papà Walt o te proteze. T'ê a-o seguo, no ti gh'æ manco da mesciâte, basta che ti stæ lì e se demoemmo tutti insemme.
Se avesse coæ de fâ coscì, me n'anieiva inte un bellin de parco à cæzâ un can.

source:
Campanīle
A #poetry thread
i.
A Roman church belfry,
gold cross reaching for clouds:
bell tolls, sets brass note free,
sings out through misty shroud,
its high peal an appeal
to the faithful long gone.
No more piety’s zeal:
many sunsetted dawns.
Its stone tower keeps watch
through the mask of dusk-rain,
skies loosing their barrage
upon roof tiles again.
🧵👇🏼
#poem #poemaday #moody #neoclassical #church #night #photography

ii.
Who pulled on the bell cord?
Lone monk in his cloister
with none left in accord.
He, grain in church oyster —
yet no cell holds his bed,
no dust stirred by his shoes,
his name never was said,
no old books that he used.
The bell rope hangs, worn, frayed,
gnawed by church mice’s teeth.
It’s been long since it swayed,
pulled by hands underneath.
🧵👇🏼

iii.
The night wind whispers psalms
and breathes canticles’ chant
to swing the clapper of bronze,
I answer in descant —
but not with my own voice.
The wind swallows my call,
chimes its own holy noise
with the hands of its squall.
✋🏼🧵
hypothesis:
Campanīle
Un fî de #poexia
i.
Un campanin de gexa romaña,
croxe d'öo ch'a l'arriva a-e nuvie:
seunna a campaña, se libera a nòtta d'arso,
o canta tramezo a-a coverta negia,
a seu ertixe a reciamma
a-i fedeli ch'en anæti da pe coscì.
No gh'é ciù l'axillo da pietæ:
tanti spæghi de sô.
A seu tore de pria a l'ammia
tramezo a-a maschera de l'ægua creusa,
o çê ch'o mollâ o seu barraggio
torna in scê ciappelle do teito.
🧵👇🏼
#poexia #poemaday #scimpatico #neoclascico #çerchia #neutte #föto

ii.
Chi l'é ch'o l'à tiou o cordon do campanin?
Monego solitäio into seu claustro
che no gh'ea ciù nisciun d'accòrdio.
Lê, o gran de l'östra de gexa
ma no gh'é çellula ch'a ghe tëgne o letto,
ninte pua mescciâ da-e seu scarpe,
o seu nomme o no l'é mai stæto dito,
no di libbri vegi ch'o l'addeuviava.
A còrda da campaña a l'é appeisa, frusta, frusta,
rosiggiou da-i denti di ratti da gexa.
L'é tanto ch'a no lòccia,
tiæ de man sotta.
🧵👇🏼

iii.
O vento da neutte o mormoña di salmi
e o respia di cantichi
d'aximâ o battaggio de bronzo,
Mi respondo in descantâ
ma no co-a mæ voxe.
O vento o se mangia o mæ ciammo,
o seunna o seu santo son
co-e moen da seu borrasca.
✋🏼🧵

Tonight in #MMRPG! My back finally shuts up enough that I can GM again as the heroes continue their search for the missing girl Cammie. Vega the Digital Dragon surprises a trio of mischievous scamps who snuck into her arcade in the middle of the night but one of them recognizes her as a town superhero and they end up having a heartwarming moment geeking out over video games. Unfortunately, the moment is interrupted by somebody or something landing on the roof of the arcade... 1/?

Vega goes to investigate and finds Dr. Vesper, in his monstrous bat form that the press has dubbed the "Gargoyle Man," along with a harpy-like creature that Vesper describes as his "little protegee." Vesper says that they have come to introduce themselves and invite Vega to join their society of man-creature misfits that is led by "The Madame," Dr. Diana Laughton of the Laughton Institute. 2/?

Vega buys some time to get the mischievous scamps out of the arcade and call the rest of the Mythics for backup, then plays along at being interested in joining this "new family." Vesper and Harpy (who does not speak once during the interaction) lead Vega to a ship in the harbor, where the Laughton Institute appears to be packing up their things... presumably because they know they're drawing attention from Agent Carter and A.R.G.E.N.T. among others. 3/?

Vega, o Dragon Digitale, a l'acciappa trei battoxi che se son intaffoæ inta seu salla zeughi into cheu da neutte, ma un de liatri o â reconosce comme a supereroiña da çittæ e finiscian pe scompartî un momento commovente, con appascionâse insemme a-i videozeughi. Pe desgraçia, sto momento o ven interrotto da quarchedun ò quarcösa ch'o l'attæra in sciô teito da salla zeughi... 1/?

A Vega a va à indagâ e a l'attreuva o dottô Vesper, inta seu forma mostrosa da rattopennugo che a stampa a l'à ciammou "Gargoyle Man", insemme à unna creatua ch'a s'assomeggia à unn'arpia che o Vesper o descrive comme a seu "picciña protetta". O Vesper o dixe ch'en vegnui à presentâse e invitan a Vega à azzonzise a-a seu soçietæ d'emarginæ, meitæ òmmi e meitæ bestie, ch'a l'é guiddâ da "A Scignoa", a dottoa Diana Laughton do Laughton Institute. 2/?

source:
In a surprise Inspector Clouseau twist, I now have an extra thing to investigate for Spooky Kitties Sciences!
I was doing a quick scroll through the evenings secondary camera video, when I spotted a curious The Inspector standing on the trunk of the tree near the feeding station. Kept jumping around, finding him near where the magpies had been, so I initially suspect(edit) he was simply chasing them as they sometimes let him do, until I randomly chance stop...
#SpookyKittiesSciences

There Inspector Clouseau was, rolling around like crazing about 2 meters NE of the tree, mostly hidden by the unfortunate placement of the awnings east post. Still, there he was for 5 minutes, at which point he ran back up the tree, walked across the lawn to the hill, flattened himself at the bottom, and then ran off camera, presumably in the middle of The Zoomies.
2/
#SpookyKittiesSciences

Now, as some of my Spooky Kitties Sciences readers may know, the motivations behind that tests are not just to entertain the kitties. While the most important aspect is the genuine curiosity I had seeing the kitties rolling around in the snow, I really wanted to find something that The Inspector liked. I came out of the initial testing with only a single moment to hint that he liked something. What that was is still a mystery.
3/
#SpookyKittiesSciences
hypothesis:
Con un gio à sorpreisa da inspettô Clouseau, oua ò unna cösa in ciù da indagâ pe Spooky Kitties Sciences!
Ea lì che me piggiava unna vista a-a spedia di video da telecamera segondäia da seia, quande ò visto un coioso Inspettô in pê in sciô teu de l'erbo vexin a-a greuppia. O continuava à sätâ in gio, e l'ò trovou da-a vexin donde gh'ea stæto e berte, donca in scê primme ò sospettou(cangia) ch'o ê scorriva, comme de vòtte ghe lascian fâ, fin à quande m'affermo pe caxo...
#SpookyKittiesSciences

Lì gh'ea l'Inspettô Clouseau, ch'o s'arrembava comme un matto à 2 metri pöcassæ à nòrd-est de l'erbo, squæxi ascoso do tutto da-a desfortunâ poxiçion do montante orientale de tende da sô. E sciben, o gh'é arrestou pe 5 menuti, dapeu o l'é montou torna in sce l'erbo, o l'à attraversou o prou fin a-a colliña, o s'é gh'é misso a-i pê, e dapeu o l'é scappou da-a machina fotografica, presumibilmente into mezo de unna crixi de frenexia.
2/
#SpookyKittiesSciences

Oua, comme çertidun di mæ lettoî de Sciense di Gatti Spooky porrieivan savei, e motivaçioin derê à quelle preuve no son solo che pe fâ demoâ i gattini. Sciben che l'aspeto ciù importante o l'é a vea coixitæ ch'o l'aiva de vedde i gattini che se spantegavan in gio pe-a nive, voeiva pe in davei attrovâ quarcösa ch'o ghe piaxeiva à L'ispettô. Son sciortio da-e primme preuve con solo che un momento pe dî che ghe piaxeiva quarcösa. Quello ch'o l'ea o l'é ancon un mistëio.
3/
#ScienseDiGattiSponi

@hacks4pancakes What do you think is actually going on?
Confused? Anxious? Executive Dysfunction? Unrealistic? Bone idle?
(I'm NOT confusing ND with idleness in my internal ontology here, but I wonder if either might be contributing...)

@hacks4pancakes @DamonHD Foe emigration at least, I can imagine myself saying “oh I’m so jealous, I would LOVE to do that” when the truth is there are internal or external reasons why I wouldn’t/couldn’t and someone offering to help me with the logistics wouldn’t change that so I politely decline.

@darryl @hacks4pancakes The grown-up way to politely decline would be "I got ahead of myself: I cannot do that for other reasons much as I'd like to", not brushing it off as a diary issue!

source:
Today's Sunday Best features my Knight from Ragnarok Online! This was my very first online PC game, he was an agi/dex 2HQ knight w/ a set of elemental claymores. I played on iRO Loki, and had two drawings featured as loadscreen art!
My online handle stems from this guy. O'Reiley -> Reiley -> Rally

Coming in just under the wire on today's Sunday Best, it's my Deep Rock Galactic Engineer! The loadout I ran most of the time was Executioner LOK-1 & RJ-250 Grenade Launcher. I think the LOK-1 is one of the coolest weapon designs in an FPS, a lock-on mechanic that encouraged finesse & deep mastery.

This week's Sunday Best is my Xenoverse OC, Parma (for parmesan cheese). She had a partner named Brie. Parma dressed up to match the teachers she studied under, but her final fit reflected the one she started with, styled to match this one pair of gloves. She used Giant Storm & Double Sunday a lot.

For my Sunday Best I drew my Paxultek from Remnant II. The goal of my build was to make the damage number from a single shot as large as possible. I used a Widowmaker single-shot elephant rifle we nicknamed The Governor. It was so strong it one-shot teammates through friendly fire damage reduction.

Today's Sunday Best features my funny gay dog lady from Webfishing. Her voice had a deeper, slower pitch so she sounded old & chill. One time I joined a full server, sat somewhere & started posting practical life advice, bits of big-sister wisdom, & the whole server found me & sat with me to listen.

It's Sunday, today's feature is my Darktide Zealot. Her name is Callista, she's chasing sainthood to be pardoned of her many crimes so she won't have to apologize for any of them. She has black dreams full of teeth and is constantly flirting with female Loner Psykers. She's unwell, but Female Loose Cannon Veterans think it's endearing and constantly hit on her for it. Their in-game voices say all of this.

Today's Sunday Best feature is QP from 100% Orange Juice! I played OJ a lot with my fighting game friends; for some reason I'd always have the hand pictured here. We used to post in text chat during games and I'd always say, Do NOT test me. I played so much QP the devs awarded me a special QP badge!

This week's Sunday Best is "Local Psychopath," Fem Boss #1 from Saint's Row 3. This was the first game I wanted to use the create-a-feature to make a character who blended in with the cast and looked like a genuine member of the Third Street Saints. I picked 3 cuz my favorite jacket wasn't in 4. :(

For today's Sunday Best I've got my Animal Crossing Villager to share. My favorite way to play these games is as part of a global cartel of goons who shared their wealth. When one person had big Turnips, everyone got paid. No profiteering; you need a rare item to make your room idea work? We got you.

It's technically Sunday, and this week's fit lands a bit early! I don't Tekken very often, but when I do I like to pick Steve and do all his slippery punches. In Tekken 7 he had a loose-fit, full-body track suit, so I made him into a deer man. When he's in Peekaboo Stance the antlers point forward!

This week's Sunday Best feature is Gaige from Borderlands 2. Pure Anarchy is one of the coolest FPS mechanics in the genre, an escalating accumulation of power that came with a diminishing level of control, lowering both TTK & effective range. Ride the wave & figure it out on the fly, it'll be fine.
Gaige's voice actress plays V in Cyberpunk 2077, I learned recently. An old friend.

Today's Sunday Best isn't a person, it's a plane from an old Vlambeer game called Luftrausers! The music changes to match your airplane. My favorite configuration is called "Shipwreck," a sword-hulled amphibious prop plane with shotgun cannons, it can divebomb through boats & burst up from the sea.

Tonight our Sunday Best feature is the Houndmaster from a charming Crawl-like sidescroller called Vagante. Lovingly referred to as the Dogmancer, I loved to spec into skills that increased damage when you threw the dog at monsters. The dog roams on its own, but you can also carry it on your back!

For this week's Sunday Best we're going all the way back to Cyborg Justice on the Genesis. I played this game a lot and I always liked to make this one guy: round torso, big stampy feet and the buzzsaw hand. I always remember the magazine ad for this game vividly; you might too if you're of an age.

I did a bit of archaeological research to uncover references for this week's Sunday Best. This was my guy from Loadout, a third-person arena shooter about fiddly weapon customization. My main gun was an electric pulse cannon called "Kill-a-Watts" and the backup was a flaming LMG named "Roast Beef."

O mæ nick online o vegne da sto tipo. O'Reiley -> Reiley -> Rally

Arrivou giusto à tempo pe-o Sunday Best d'ancheu, o l'é o mæ Deep Rock Galactic Engineer! L'equipaggiamento ch'ò deuviou a ciù parte de vòtte o l'ea o Executioner LOK-1 & RJ-250 Grenade Launcher. Penso che o LOK-1 o segge un di disegni d'arme ciù belli inte un FPS, unna mecanica de blòcco ch'a l'incoraggiava a finessa e unna profonda elegansa.

O Sunday Best de sta settemaña o l'é o mæ OC de Xenoverse, Parma (pe-o formaggio parmexan). A l'aiva unna compagna de nomme Brie. A Parma a s'é vestia pe assumeggiâse a-i meistri da-i quæ a l'à studiou, ma a seu forma finale a respëgiava quella da-a quæ a l'ea partia, abbinâ à sto pâ de guanti. A l'addeuviava assæ Giant Storm & Double Sunday.

Pe-o mæ Sunday Best ò disegnou o mæ Paxultek da Remnant II. L'obiettivo da mæ construçion o l'ea de rende o ciù grande poscibile o numero de danni da un solo tio. Ò addeuviou un scceuppo pe-i elefanti Widowmaker da un tio ch'emmo ciammou The Governor. O l'ea mai tanto fòrte ch'o l'ammassava i compagni de squaddra con un corpo solo, sciben che gh'ea unna reduçion do danno pe-o feugo amigo.

A-a giornâ d'ancheu inta Sunday Best gh'é a mæ graçiosa dònna lesbica co-o can de Webfishing. A seu voxe a l'aiva un ton ciù fondo e lento, donca a paiva vegia e relassâ. Unna vòtta son introu inte un server completo, me son assettou da quarche parte e ò comensou à pubricâ di conseggi prattichi pe-a vitta, di tòcchi de sæximo da seu grande, e tutto o server o m'à trovou e o s'é assettou con mi à sentî.

L'é domenega, a trasmiscion d'ancheu a l'é o mæ Darktide Zealot. A s'acciamma Callista, a çerca a santitæ pe ëse perdonâ pe-i seu tanti crimini, coscì ch'a no l'avià da ciammâ scuse pe nisciun de questi. A l'à di seunni neigri pin de denti e a l'é delongo apreuvo à flirtâ con de dònne Loner Psyker. A no stà ben, ma e vetereñe de Female Loose Cannon pensan ch'a l'é scimpatica e pe sta raxon ghe preuvan delongo con lê. E seu voxe into zeugo dixan tutto questo.

O Sunday Best d'ancheu o presenta QP de 100% Orange Juice! Zogâva a OJ un botto con i mæ amixi di zêughi de lòtta; pe quarche motivo gh'aveivo senpre a man in foto chi. Scriveivamo inta chat de testo durante e partie e mi dizeivo senpre: No provâmi. Ho zogòu coscì tanto con QP che i svilupatoî m'an dæto un badge speciale de QP!

O Sunday Best de sta settemann-a o l'é "Psicopata Locale", Fem Boss #1 de Saint's Row 3. Questo o l'é stæto o primmo zêugo dove voéiva dêuviâ o creatô pe fâ un personaggio ch'o se fondesse co-o cast e o pæscia un membro vero di Third Street Saints. Ho çernûo o 3 perché a mæ giacca preferia a no gh'êa into 4. :(

Pe-o Sunday Best d'ancheu gh'ho o mæ Abitante de Animal Crossing da condivide. O mæ mòddo preferio de zogâ a sti zêughi o l'é comme parte de un cartello globale de sgherri ch'ondividivan e seu riccheççe. Quando una personn-a a gh'aveiva de Rape de Valore, tutti piggiavan i palanche. Nisciun speculaçion; te serve un oggetto raro pe fâ fonçionâ l'idea da teu camera? Te dæmo na man.

Tecnicamente l'é doménega, e o look de sta settemann-a o l'ariva un po' in anticipo! No zeugo a Tekken troppo spesso, ma quando o fasso me piaxe çerne Steve e fâ tutti i seu colpi scivoloxi. In Tekken 7 o gh'aveiva una tuta larga ch'a coveriva tutto o corpo, coscì l'ho trasformòu inte un òmmo-cervo. Quando o l'é in Posiçion Peekaboo e corne puntan in avanti!

O spettacolo da settemaña o l'é Gaige da Borderlands 2. Pure Anarchy a l'é uña de mecaniche de FPS ciù belle do genere, unn'ammuggiâ de potensa ch'a compòrta unna diminuçion do livello de contròllo, con ammermâ tanto o TTK comme a portâ effettiva. Cavarca l'onda e appensiteghe in sciô xeuo, o l'anià ben.
Da pöco ò sacciuo che a doppiatoa de Gaige a l'interpreta V inte Cyberpunk 2077. Unna vegia amiga.

O nòstro Sunday Best de staseia o l'é o Houndmaster d'un appascionante sidescroller pægio a Crawl acciammou Vagante. Con affetto me acciammavan o Dogmancer, e mi adorava investî punti inte l’abilitæ che aumentavan o danno quande o can o vegniva tiou contra i mostri. O can o va in gio da pe lê, ma ti peu ascì portâlo in sciâ scheña!

Pe-o Sunday Best de sta settemaña tornemmo inderê into tempo fin à Cyborg Justice in sciô Genesis. Ò zugou ben ben à sto zeugo e m'é delongo piaxuo creâ sto personaggio: busto riondo, gròsci pê stampæ e a man à mòddo de særa rionda. M'arregòrdo delongo ben l'annonçio de revista pe sto zeugo; fòscia viatri ascì, s'ei unna çerta etæ.

Ò fæto un pö de reçerche archeològiche pe trovâ de referense pe-o Sunday Best de sta settemaña. Sto chì o l'ea o mæ personaggio de Loadout, un sparatutto d'arena in tersa persoña ch'o l'à da fâ co-a personalizzaçion de arme. A mæ arma primmäia a l'ea un cannon à impulso elettrico ciammou "Kill-a-Watts" e o supplemento o l'ea un LMG insciammou ciammou "Roast Beef".

source:
@JugglingWithEggs at least in my friend circle mobile phones not uncommon from early 90s, but they cost a *lot* to call from a landline (so if you were living at home your parents would discourage it), and until 1995-1999 were insecure, anyone with a radio scanner could (and often did) listen to them.
Whilst radio scanners were out of the price range of youths, many older folk had them, and until late 90s were often the kind of radio enthusiast who was a Tory bootlicker and supported the Police and other Establishment organisations, so you if discussing anything subversive on a mobile phone you risked being grassed up..
Ironically the tide turned by late 90s when scanners became affordable, and the Police were still on analogue radios 😁

@JugglingWithEggs by late 1990s everyone had a mobile phone and calls were cheaper (often with a good amount of free minutes) but SMS messages were unreliable and initially didn't even work across networks - people actually talked to each other on them!
One difference was access to physical spaces wasn't as heavily controlled as today - even though there was still CCTV and locals would call old bill on youths "hanging around", there was neither sufficient boots on the ground nor interconnected CCTV (a real security guard had to watch the footage locally, and property owners generally didn't want to pay for these folk at evenings and weekends.
There were also fewer cops on duty in outer suburbs during nights/weekends - they were all deployed into the town centres)

@vfrmedia
I remember texts sometimes taking hours to come through in the early noughties - so not always great for making on the fly arrangements.
Living in market town definitely meant less cctv and coppers back in 90’s. Remember difference when heading out into Bournemouth or Norwich of an evening. But young people having fun wasn’t frowned upon like it is now. My earlier post about facial recognition was about area where there has been uptick in teens just hanging out.
hypothesis:
@JugglingWithEggs a-o manco into çercio di mæ amixi i telefonin no ean infrequenti za da-i primmi anni '90, ma costavan *un muggio* pe ciammâ da un telefono fisso (donca, se ti stavi da-i teu, i genitoî de divan che l'ea megio no fâlo), e fin a-o 1995-1999 no ean segui: tutti quelli ch'aivan un scanner aradio poeivan stâte à sentî (e tante vòtte ô favan).
Se i scanner aradio ean feua da-a portâ di zoveni, ben ben di ançien ghe î aivan e, fin a-a fin di anni '90, de spesso ean di appascionæ d'araddi che leccavan i pê a-i conservatoî e sostegnivan a poliçia e atre organizzaçioin de l'establishment, donca se ti descorrivi de quarcösa de sovverscivo pe telefonin ti cointavi à vegnî denonçiou...
Pe ironia da sciòrte, a scituaçion a s'é imbösâ a-a fin di anni '90, quande i scanner en vegnui accescibili e a poliçia a deuviavan ancon i araddi analògichi 😁

@JugglingWithEggs verso a-a fin di anni '90 tutti gh'aivan un telefonin e e ciammæ costavan ciù pöco (tante vòtte con unna boña quantitæ de menuti de badda), ma in scî SMS no se ghe poeiva confiâ e a-o comenso no fonçionavan manco fra gestoî despægi: e gente î deuviavan davei pe parlâse!
Unna differensa a l'ea che l'intrâ inti spaçi fixichi a no l'ea coscì fortemente controllâ comme ancheu: ben che gh'ea za e telecamere à circuito serrou e e gente do pòsto ciammavan a poliçia pe-i zoveni che "stavan in gio sensa fâ ninte", no gh'ea ni abastansa agenti in sciô campo e ni manco telecamere interconnesse (unna guardia de seguessa a l'aiva da ammiâ i filmæ in sciô pòsto, e i propietäi di palaçi pe commun no voeivan pagâ ste gente a-a seia e into fin da settemaña.
Gh'ea ascì ciù pöchi poliçiòtti in servixo inte delegaçioin de neutte e inte fin de settemaña: ean tutti missi à travaggiâ into çentro de çittæ)

@vfrmedia
M’arregòrdo che i messaggi de vòtte ghe metteivan de oe pe arrivâ inti primmi anni 2000... donca no sempre boin pe fâ di cen a-a lesta.
Stâ inte unna çittæ de mercou voeiva dî de seguo meno telecamere e sbiri inti anni ’90. M’arregòrdo a differensa quande se sciortiva a-a seia à Bournemouth ò à Norwich. Ma a-i zoeni che se demoavan no se gh’ammiava mâ comme oua. O mæ primmo post in sciô reconoscimento facciale o parlava de unna zöna donde gh’é stæto un aumento di adolescenti che stan feua pe ëse insemme.

Good Morning Worlds!
We are going to the tip this morning. It will clear some of the stuff we sorted yesterday from the drive. I don't think we can clear it all unless we took the trailer, but the trailer is full of steel for weighing in.
Later I might carry on packing tote crates.
#GoodMorningWorlds

Tip trip done, and another car load cleared out.
I have taken the new trailer axle, and trailer drive motor system, out of the scrap metal trailer load. That means we can get more scrap metal in there and also not accidentally weigh in the parts I want to keep.
I think, next, I will start moving the scrap steel from the back garden into the trailer so that it is ready to go.
Scrap steel prices are not very high at the moment but better than nothing, if I take enough of it in one go.
Still have to sort the non-ferrous scrap.

That thing when you are taking the rotten tyres off small, wide lawn tractor wheels....
Huge effort to unmount one side of the tyre, but it was really badly rusted tight on the other side of the rim.
In the time it took me to break the bead free, I'd forgotten I had already done the other side, and ended up with the rim free but completely inside the tyre!
I had to remount the tyre that side, and then work around it to get the rim out.
I had to cut up the inner tube to get that out too!
I wonder how many more tyres I need to unmount? Four done so far.
hypothesis:
Bongiorno mondi!
Stamattin anemmo a-a descarrega. Coscì vuiemo o strazzetto da parte da röba ch'emmo çernuo vëi. No penso che porriemo portâ via tutto se no piggemmo o remorco, ma o remorco o l'é za pin de ferraggia da portâ à pesâ.
Ciù tardi porrieiva anâ avanti à impî e cascette.
#BongiornoMondi

Ò finio o viægio e ò descarregou un atro carrego da-a machina.
Ò levou a neuva töa da-o remorco e o scistema de trasmiscion do motô da-o carrego de ferraggia. Questo veu dî che poemmo carregâ ciù tanta ferraggia e ascì fâ à meno de pesâ pe errô i tòcchi che veuggio tegnî.
Penso che, comme pròscimo passo, comensiò à mesciâ a ferraggia d'äsâ da-o giardin in sciô derê do remorco, coscì a saià lesta pe partî.
I prexi da ferraggia d'äsâ no en guæi erti a-o momento, ma l'é megio de ninte, se ne pòrto via tanto ch'abbasta inte unna bòtta solo.
Ò ancon da dâ recatto a-o zetto no ferroso.

Quella scituaçion donde se leva i pneumatichi marsi da-e reue picciñe e larghe de un trattoin da giardin...
Gh'é vosciuo un bello giamin pe desmontâ unna parte do pneumatico, ma da l'atra parte do çercion gh'ea tutto incrostou da-a ruzze.
Into tempo che me gh'é vosciuo pe liberâ o tallon m'ea ascordou d'avei za desmontou l'atra parte, e me son arretrovou co-o çercion libero ma do tutto drento a-o pneumatico!
M'é toccou remontâ o pneumatico in sce quella parte e dapeu travaggiâghe in gio pe estraighe o çercion.
Ò dovuo taggiâ a camia d'äia pe tiâ feua anche quella!
Me domando quante pneumatichi me tocchià desmontâ ancon? Pe oua n'ò fæto quattro.

source:
project move out, spring break relay
day 1:
Cleared main bedroom closet
& contents of boxes on one wall.
I'm surveying all my belongings. Pulling out a small percentage to save. Sentimental items. Practical pieces for putting together a new life. At this stage I know I'm selecting more than I need, probably more than I can carry; but the amount that I'm leaving behind is far greater. Deciding what to keep & where comes after the survey. All the rest will be turned over to "scavengers."
#moverR

Day 2, midday break, Monday.
Today is harder than yesterday. I'm uncovering far more "sentimental" stuff. The challenge: these saved memories are a physical drag that impair rather than contribute anything practically to my future AND I feel integrated looking at them. There's a strong general condemnation, I feel, of holding onto sentimental items. Yet I know that they are powerful. But hey, I'm an artist. Even wistful, sad memories are valuable to me. I'm proceeding as before, retaining less+

+than I'm tossing, while knowing that I am keeping "too much." The next phase will be the actual moving & storing phase when more might be cut. This phase is the pre-screen before turning the cleared items over to others who will take everything away.
File under: how to move out of a home of 12 years & a home town of 45 years, with family roots here (& artifacts) from 150 years. I'm finally leaving, in search of a culture that suits my values.
#moverR

progetto stramuo, staffetta de vacanse de primmaveia
giorno 1:
Desbarassou l'armäio da stançia da letto primmäia
& contegnuo de scatoe arrembæ contra à unna miagia.
Son derê à ammiâ tutte e mæ cöse. Tiâ feua unna pöca perçentuale da conservâ. Oggetti sentimentali. Cöse prattiche pe costruime unna vitta neuva. Inte sta fase sò che son apreuvo à seleçionâ ciù de quello che me serve, fòscia ciù de quello che pòsso portâ con mi; ma quantitæ de cöse che son apreuvo à lasciâ inderê a l'é ben ben ciù grande. Deçidde cöse tegnî e donde a va a finî vegnià dòppo l'inventäio. Tutto o resto o vegnià consegnou a-i "desbarassatoî".
#moverR

Giorno 2, pösa de mëzogiorno, lunesdì.
Ancheu l'é ciù diffiçile che vëi. Screuvo de cöse ben ben ciù sentimentale. A desfia: sti arregòrdi conservæ son un peiso fixico che, incangio de dâ un contribuo concreto a-o mæ avvegnî, o me mette un sappello; e sciben, quande î ammio me sento in scintonia con mi mæxima. Ò l'imprescion che ghe segge un fòrte pregiudiçio generale verso o fæto che conservâ di oggetti sentimentali. Ascì ô sò ch'en ben ben potenti. Ma ehi, son unn'artista. Anche i regòrdi malincònichi e tristi an un valô pe mi. Vaggo avanti comme primma, conservando meno+

+de quello che butto, savendu che sto tegnindo "tròppo." A pròscima fase a saiâ quella do traslòcco vêo & do stocaggio quande se porrià taggiâ de ciù. Sta fase a l'è a pre-seleçion primma de lasciâ a ròba vêuia a-i atri che portan via tutto.
Metti sotta: comme trasloccâ da 'na cà de 12 anni & da 'na çittæ de 45 anni, con reixe de famiggia chi (& artefatti) da 150 anni. Finalmente me ne vago, in çerca de 'na coltûa che a se adatta a-i mê valôi.
#traslòccoR

@lorry
> Bumble is dire at Trust and Safety
Care to expand on that or link me?
> Whitney (Bumble) [is] a billionaire anyway, so what does she care?
I presume she didn't found Bumble by herself, maybe wasn't even part of the original group (as with Melon Husk and Tesla). What about the rest of them?
@screwlisp

(2/?)
@lorry
> I imagine there's still space for going back to the old model
There's plenty of new models to be tried that would be a huge improvement over playing hashtag roulette, either on DataFarms or decentralised social networks. One idea I saw was online dating as a group-based social experience. This is a handwave in the right direction. As is @cy's idea about matchmakers in another branch of this thread.

(3/?)
Speaking of roulette, what about a Chat Roulette style speed-dating app?
The app could;
* perform some basic T&S vetting (to minimise unsolicited dick-cam, etc), including confirming what general area you're in (ask me how!)
* throw you into a round of realtime speed dating with others in your area (text? Voice? Video? see 4/4).
* As with normal speed dating, if you both Favourite each other after talking, you get each others' contacts
#OnlineDating #ChatRoulette

@strypey I nearly joined #Chatroulette, but then Covid and the Ukraine war started, so that never went anywhere. I had a different direction I wanted to take them, though.
#Bumble #TrustAndSafety ? Well, the industry isn't exactly full of dating site whistleblowers, but safety workers in the industry do talk to me. I know more than I would ever want to know about the inside workings of most dating sites, and sadly. It's not really an amazing revelation that Bumble is as bad as the rest, though.
None of the dating sites puts more than a veneer of effort into T&S. They weigh the cost of litigation against the cost of actually doing the work, and so far, litigation costs have always been lower.

@lorry
> he industry isn't exactly full of dating site whistleblowers
Any particular reason for that?
> They weigh the cost of litigation against the cost of actually doing the work, and so far, litigation costs have always been lower
Huh. The Fight Club principle at work. Sad. We deserve better from our digital matchmaking tools.

My brother in He-Who-Shall-Not-Be-Named, what you are describing is a consequence of _misogyny_, not "misandry."

I desperately need men to realize that just because it's directed at them and an actual serious problem doesn't mean it is "misandry."
Just saw someone describe being discriminated against _for being considered effeminate_ as "misandry" and I just.

It's not that you aren't experiencing something real. You very well may be. But it isn't "misandry." Because "misandry" doesn't exist.
Yes, this applies to trans men as well. "Transmisandry" _also_ isn't a thing and just contributes to anti-feminist narratives. It treats itself as a mirror of transmisogyny, but transmisogyny is _intersective_: we experience transphobia _and_ we experience misogyny _and_ we experience this unholy thing that happens when the two interact. It's not a subset, even an exclusive subset, it's an intersection.
But the following all are absolutely problems that can be talked about!
* Transphobia/Transmisia
* Antitransmasculity
* Transemasculation
* Misogyny
It sucks to be discriminated against, but the language that we use is so, so important here.

Ò un beseugno despeou che i òmmi s'accòrzan che solo perché o l'é un problema serio eo l'é diretto à liatri , no veu dî ch'o segge un caxo de "misandria".
Ò visto giusto oua descrive comme misandria o fæto de vegnî discriminou _pe ëse consciderou effeminou_ e ghe son arrestou de pria.

No l'é che no t'ê apreuvo à vive quarcösa de veo. L'é ben ben probabile ch'a segge coscì. Ma a no l'é "misandria". Perché a "misandria" a no l'existe.

* Misoginia

I'm doing a eekly 1hr meeting where I'm going over with a director of engineering my soap box on managing a product management organization and actually it's coming out to be a pretty good episodic thing

Topics have been
- different types of product managers and the basic skill sets in developing requirements
- how product managers ensure an ongoing cadence for an engineering team
- dealing with product managers with varying backgrounds (engineering, data analyst, operational SME, consulting etc)
what's been fun is that this Director and I worked at a previous company with product managers that I didn't manage and I'm able to reference "hey remember that person? that person was awesome and here's why."

so in various email chains and slack threads I'll forward them to said director (if he's already not in there) and be like "ok a GOOD product manager would do THIS" and a "BAD product maanger would do THAT" rememember when so and so did THIS? that was good.

- e differense qualitæ de product manager e e competense de base pe-o sviluppo di requixiti
- comme i product manager garantiscian un ritmo continuo pe unna squaddra d'inzegneria

aloa, inte varie cadeñe d'e-mail e inte discuscioin in sce Slack, ghe ê passiò à quello direttô (s'o no l'é za presente) e diò tipo "ok, un BRAVO product manager o faieiva STA CÖSA" e "un PESCIMO product manager o faieiva ST'ATRA CÖSA". Tinkering with my stereo system this week has got me thinking about an oddity that I've never been able to get to the bottom of...let's see if the Mastodon hive mine can help.
The amp is a Philips FA454 and the CD Player is a Philips CD150.
According to the amp manual I can connect the units with a "8-pole DIN to 5-pole DIN + 2 x single-pole CINCH" cable."
I take this to mean an 8 pin din to a 5 pin + stereo RCA cable...which sounds cursed.
Never been able to find one. Can anyone make one?

The service manual for the amp is nice and clear (picture 2 in above toot), but I can't find anything as nice for the CD player. I've attached a picture (picture 4 in the above toot) from the service manual that I *think* is the relevant section.
Currently I have the CD player hooked up with just the RCA cables and it all works fine, but if I could find/make the correct Din to Din + RCA cable then I could use some additional functionality and free up the only RCA stereo inputs on my amp.

There's a repair café this weekend in the town where I live...if I'm still puzzling over it all by then I might take it all along there and see if they can help me hack together a cable.
hypothesis:
Sta settemaña, tanto ch'armezzava co-o mæ impianto stereo, m'é vegnuo in cheu unna stranessa che no son mai riescio à accapî... ammiemmo se a communitæ de Mastodon a peu dâme unna man.
L'amplificatô o l'é un Philips FA454 e o lettô CD un Philips CD150.
Segondo o manuale de l'amplificatô, pòsso collegâ e unitæ con un cavo "da DIN à 8 pöli à DIN à 5 pöli + 2 x CINCH à pölo scingolo".
Interpreto st'inddicaçion comme un cavo da DIN à 8 pin à 5 pin + RCA stereo... cösa ch'a pâ imposcibile da attrovâ.
No son mai riescio à trovâne un. Quarchedun o peu fabricâne un?

O manuale d'ascistensa de l'amplificatô o l'é ciæo e ben fæto (figua 2 into post chì de d'ato), ma no riëscio à attrovâ ninte d'ätretanto ciæo pe-o lettô CD. Ò alligou unna figua (figua 4 do post chì de d'ato) da-o manuale d'ascistensa che *penso* ch'a segge a seçion pertinente.
A-o momento ò colligou o lettô CD solo co-i cavi RCA e fonçioña tutto ben, ma se poesse trovâ/realizzâ o cavo Din à Din + RCA corretto, porrieiva addeuviâ çerte fonçionalitæ in azzonta e liberâ i unichi ingresci stereo RCA in sciô mæ amplificatô.

Sto fin de settemaña gh'é un repair café inta çittæ donde vivo... se pe aloa saiò ancon occupou con sto problema, porrieiva portâ lì tutto e ammiâ se peuan aggiuttâme à mette insemme un cavo.

source:
And being one of the weirdo, we just frequently get attacks here and there. Either online, offline, or even from your closest people. Those attacks usually stem from homophobia, transphobia, or sometimes just, don't like how weird we are and how weird we act, especially furries that do deeper immersions like roleplaying and therianthropy.

Hence some of us got safety by not needing to tell who we are and where we were from. Some of us got safety by only revealing ourselves to our friends or close friends. Face/body reveal is a culture that most of the furries did at least once in a private post, whether it be "delete soon" kind of post or in story.

Despite being so, we're still open for social interactions offline. We do furmeets—a personal meeting between furries, be it in a group or personal, be it in an event or just casually—and sometimes making a con/fur on, such as MWFF, IWAG, PAWAI, FURUM, and so on. It's fun to meet them offline, get to know each other, be able to see them in person as most of us have never seen each other's faces, take a photo to keep personally and censor publicly, laugh together and discuss similar interests, and so on. It's fun, social, and warm.

Although, things don't feel the same today. As people start trying to strip anonymity of people, attack furries, therian, LGBTQIA, and dox them, as how also our community participate and stir the dramas inside, things has been a little more chaotic, less warm, and less feeling like community or family. It's not the same anymore.

Part of me hopes things can return to how it feels in the 2000s and 2010s, but, I'll just let God do the rest. I'm a little hopeless in society and humans. I'm tired of how things get worse and meant to attack and divide small communities into a hopeless being. I don't like how society is now no longer respecting and being in unity.
hypothesis:
E, dæto che semmo tra quelli un pö stranni, ne capita tante vòtte de reçeive di attacchi in sà e in là. Che seggian online, offline ò fiña da-a parte de gente ciù vexiñe. Sti attacchi pe-o sòlito ne vëgnan da l'omofobia, da-a transfobia ò, de vòtte, solo che da-o fæto che à quarchedun no ghe piaxe quante semmo stranni e comme se comportemmo, mascime into caxo di furry che prattican de forme d'immerscion ciù profonde comme o zeugo de ròllo e a triantropia.

Pe sta raxon, çerti de niatri an trovou da seguessa into fæto de taxei in sce chi semmo e de donde ne vegnimmo. Di atri an trovou da seguessa into revellâse solo a-i seu amixi ò amixi streiti. A revellaçion da cea ò do còrpo a l'é unna prattica che a ciù parte di furry a l'à fæto a-o manco unna vòta inte un post privou, che se tratte de un post do stile "scassa fito" ò inte unna stöia.

E sciben, semmo averti a-e interaçioin soçiale offline. Organizzemmo di furmeet -- incontri personali tra furry, de gruppo ò de persoñe sence, in occaxon de un evento ò solo pe caxo - e de vòtte piggemmo parte à de convention/fur on, comme MWFF, IWAG, PAWAI, FURUM e coscì avanti. A l'é unna demoa incontrâli offline, conoscise, poeili vedde de persoña dæto che a ciù parte de niatri a no s'é mai vista inta cea, piggiâse unna föto da tegnîse e çensurâ in ciæo, rie insemme, discorrî d'interesci in commun e coscì avanti. A l'é unna cösa divertente, soçiale e ch'a l'arrecovia o cheu.

Sciben, e cöse ancheu no pan ciù e mæxime. Da maniman che e gente comensan à çercâ de privâ i atri da-o seu anonimato, attaccâ i firry, oi therian, e gente LGBTQIA e spantegnâne i dati personali, e da maniman che ascì a nòstra communitæ a parteçipa e a l'alimenta di drammi drento de lê, e cöse en vegnue un pö ciù caòtiche, meno calorose e s'assumeggian de meno à unna communitæ ò a unna famiggia. A no l'é ciù a mæxima cösa.

Unna parte de mi a spera che e cöse pòssan tornâ à ëse comme inti anni 2000 e 2010, ma lasciò che segge o Segnô à occupâse do resto. Son un pö dexincantoou inti confronti da soçietæ e de atre persoñe. Son stanco de comme e cöse van à pezo e de comme se çerche d'attaccâ e dividde e communitæ picciñe, co-o trasformâle inte di soggetti sensa speransa. No me piaxe o fæto che a soçietæ a no segge ciù respettosa e unia.

$partner has a video consult with Ikea to quote for a fitted kitchen. It's a fascinating glimpse into the ecosystem of online services for boomers.
1. They send link for video consult, three weeks ago. It uses Ikea's proprietary videoconf solution
2. They request the designs & 3D renders for the new kitchen
3. they send an email saying "thanks for sending through the design
4. We dial in today, they start the call with "our system blocked your files, let's design your kitchen together"
1/x

5. Partner asks if there's any way to share the (very detailed, took us like a full man week to put together) designs, but the Ikea salesdrone is on a script, and isn't having a bar of it.
6. The next step in the script is "laboriously do the design from scratch over the phone with the client, hunting and pecking on the keyboard and not fast using the UI of their design software"
2/x

7. They cannot share their screen, so it's a clown show of repeated misunderstanding about which part of which image is being referred to

8. the clock has just ticked past what should have been the full consult, and they're 35% the way thru getting the required measurements.

9. So far there's been literally 8 minutes of salesdrone laboriously inputting the measurements supplied

1. Træ settemañe fa gh'an inviou o ligammo pe-a consulensa video. Deuvia a soluçion de videoconferensa propietäia de Ikea.
2. An domandou i progetti e i rendering 3D pe-a neuva coxiña

1/x

right, so, as i was saying, i dmed this very well known and very friendly seeming artist-type person and gave em the usual spiel:
- how bridge works
- how to bridge
- please do so because i want to follow you and reblog some of your stuff that i like
- if you don't want to, that's fine
and they responded "not doing that" which is all well and good but then they blocked me???
just like, for absolutely no fucking reason

not naming any names because i do NOT dislike anybody involved and i certainly do not want to incite any brigading, but this has happened with several people now, including people who have REBLOGGED AND LIKED BRIDGED POSTS FROM THIS ACCOUNT (my main), which is WHY I WANTED TO FOLLOW THEM

if they had just said "no thanks" they would have gotten an "ok, perfectly understandable! :)" or the like from me, but now everyone has to put up with my confused ranting instead. i'm not even angry, i'm just *genuinely baffled*

bsky people, is this a genuine issue over on your platform (because it's one i've almost *never* had over here on this side of the bridge) or am i just running into bad apple after bad apple

I honestly don't know what people's general feelings are about enabling the Bridgy Fed here, because that's just not a topic that ever comes up tbh (unfortunately)… But there's definitely some subset of people here who are super trigger-happy about the block button, I'm not a fan of this either.

Ironing the lightweight green corduroy for my first try at the Sachi's Studio Newsboy Cap pattern. I don't know how I feel about the recommendation to use interfacing but it probably does want something to stiffen and thicken it a bit.
#millinery

Sachi's newsboy cap pattern advises to cut the crown pieces diagonal to the weave ("on the bias") to allow more stretch around the circumference but that will make the corduroy rows run aslant, where I prefer them vertical.
We shall see. This is the test cookie to get a feel for the pattern. I like corduroy for texture but green wouldn't be my first choice, and this fabric is lightweight enough that I should add a layer, whether interfacing or what-have-you from the stash.

On a second look, my fabric isn't corduroy at all, it's just velvet, so I can cut at 45° to the fabric weave like Sachi suggests in the Newsboy Cap pattern and it won't look strange.
#millinery

Son apreuvo à stiâ o velluo à còste verde legio pe-a mæ primma tentativa co-o modello de berretta da venditoî da giornali de Sachi's Studio. No sò ben cöse pensâ do conseggio de deuviâ l'inferfòddra, ma fòscia ghe vorrià quarcösa pe fâlo vegnî un pö ciù redeno e conscistente.
#modisteria

O disegno de cappello da giornalista de Sachi o conseggia de taggiâ i tòcchi da coroña in diagonale respetto a-o tesciuo ("de sbiascio") pe consentîghe un allonghimento ciù fòrte longo a-a çirconferensa, ma sta cösa a fa anâ in diagonale e righe do velluo à còste, ma à mi m'é ciù cao che seggian verticale.
Ghe veddiemo. Sto chì o l'é o modello de preuva pe fâse unn'idea do disegno. Me piaxe o velluo à còste pe-a tramma, ma o verde a no l'é a mæ primma çernia, e sto tesciuo o l'é mai tanto legio ch'aiva da azzonzine un atro seu, ch'o segge unn'interfòddra ò quarcös'atro ch'agge in casa.

À ammiâghe ben, o mæ tesciuo o no l'é pe ninte do velluo à coste, o l'é solo che do velluo, donca pòsso taggiâ à 45° respetto a-a tramma do tesciuo, comm'a conseggia Sachi into cartamodello da berretta da venditô de giornali, e o no parrià stranio.
#modisteria
