I argomënc por na destituziun dal’inciaria de Donald Trump

Bombes sura l’America Latina: chësc me recorda n pü’ na situaziun ala "Wag the Dog". Le govern, che evidentamënter oress indô reanimé les campagnes de concuista militara neoconservativa, á metü man adascusc süa ultima vera por le mudamënt de rejim tl Venezuela cun ataches indiscriminades a barches tles eghes dl Mer Caraibich y dl Pazifich dan l’America zentrala. Chëstes ataches, dötes fates zënza degun control da pert dl Congres y cun la premissa dubiosa che les barches foss plënes de fentanyl destiné ai Stac Unis, ê pordërt omizids. Mo la noela ch’al ti é gnu dé l’ordin ai soldas da ti trá a na barca bele dassënn danejada tl cheder de na ataca "double tap" por copé eventuai suraviënc á fat lové sö le fantasm di delic de vera - y te na manira che gnanca tröc republicans ne pé a öna da azeté.

Le partner de Trump sön Binance ciafa na amnestia: Changpeng Zhao á metü man en chësc ann coche ex-diretur general tomé en desgrazia de Binance, la maiú plataforma de barat de criptovaluta dl monn, do ester sté saré ia, sciöche le Ministere de iustizia dl’aministraziun Biden l’á formulé, "por n’avëi nia tigní impé n program efiziënt cuntra le reziclaje de scioldi (AML)", por avëi violé le Bank Security Act y por avëi lascé pro le flus incontrasté de scioldi a n gröm de criminai, danter chisc "terorisć, criminai informatics y pedofii". Mo Zhao, che â pordü le dërt da aministré Binance, orô indô gní zoruch. Insciö ál anuzé sü coliamënc cun la familia de Trump y le cërtl strënt incëria por s’assiguré na amnestia che ti dess indô la poscibilité da comané. Coche rengraziamënt á Zhao dediché döta süa atenziun a World Freedom Financial, anuzan l’influënza de Binance por arichí le fond de criptovalutes privat de Trump. Tim Noah de TNR ê dessené a mort por chësta acordanza dassënn ambivalënta.

Chips por la Cina: sce i baiun bele de Tim Noah y de so sënn: Al n’é plü dessigü nia na bona cossa che öna na firma sora, Nvidia, é rovada a avëi tan n gran podëi da influenzé le marcé. Süa importanza demorvëia por l’economia mondiala á porté pro che Noah ais nominé chësta aziënda danter i majeri pilastri che ess podü tomé adöm, canch’al á ipotisé, l’ultim otober, na eventuala crisa dla börsa gaujada da Trump. Trump fej indere ci ch’al pó por che ara ti vais bun a Nvidia: en chësc ann á le presidënt rot cun na vedla tradiziun de segurëza nazionala anunzian che al ess autorisé l’aziënda da vëne sü chip H200 ala Cina. Coche David Sanger dl "New York Times" á recordé, á l’acordanza - früt de n’ "ativité de lobby intensiva" da pert dl CEO de Nvidia y dl provocadú dla Ciasa Blancia Jensen Huang - fat lové sö na domanda de basa: "Sce i chips che alimentëia la tecnologia plü progredida pó ti gní venüs al maiú concorënt tecnologich, militar y finanziar di Stac Unis, olá vëgnel pa spo trat la linia de demarcaziun nöia?" Mo chël é bonamënter le mënder di festidi de Trump. L’acordanza garantî indere ince che "le 25 porcënt de dötes les entrades realisades cun les venüdes ti jiss ai Stac Unis", indô n ejëmpl dla predileziun de chësta aministraziun por le corporatism de stamp fascist.

source:
Celtic hammer Dundee United on O'Neill's return

Normal service resumed at Celtic Park as champions Celtic secured a dominant 4-0 win over Dundee United and their first clean sheet since Martin O'Neill's previous game in charge.

Two first-half goals in five minutes from Yang Hyun-jun and Arne Engels sent Celtic on their way as O'Neill returned to the dugout in style following Wilfried Nancy's brief but disastrous reign.

Substitute Benjamin Nygren grabbed his 11th goal of the season and Daizen Maeda netted on the rebound to equal Celtic's two biggest wins of the league season so far. Both of them were in O'Neill's caretaker spell in charge, which resulted in seven wins from eight games.

Celtic sent for the 73-year-old on Monday after terminating Nancy's contract in the wake of six defeats - and 18 goals against - in eight matches.

The chaos, confusion and defensive fragility that marked Nancy's reign disappeared as the Hoops moved three points off the top of the table.

Nobody in the stadium would have been surprised to see O'Neill restore Celtic's long-standing 4-3-3 formation and the team picked up where they left off under O'Neill, as if they had awoken from a nightmare and got on with life as normal.

Centre-back Liam Scales was back to the consistent form he displayed before suffering in and out of a back three under the Frenchman.

Callum McGregor dictated play again and Celtic's wide players, Yang and Sebastian Tounekti, were given attacking licence after being handed wing-back roles by the former Columbus Crew head coach.

Celtic enjoyed 78 per cent possession, had 22 shots at goal and let United have just three. Their opponents averaged 12 shots during Nancy's tenure and United managed 17 themselves during their 2-1 win over the Hoops at Tannadice less than four weeks ago.

Celtic penned United in from the start, with Kieran Tierney instrumental in creating a series of first-half chances.

The left-back had a shot deflected wide, Yang and Scales threatened from headers and Maeda flicked a low cross of the bar, before the pressure paid off in the 27th minute.

Such was Celtic's dominance that Scales found himself in possession on the edge of the box and rolled a pass to Yang, who drilled home from 20 yards.

Maeda soon mis-kicked a volley before Engels produced a first-time finish from Tierney's pass.

It was not all plain sailing for Celtic in the first half. Mexican right-back Julian Araujo marked his first start with a yellow card for a dangerous challenge on Will Ferry, who was still hobbling when he took the resulting free-kick.

United also had chances and Dario Naamo looked unsure whether to head or volley Craig Sibbald's deep cross and did neither and Owen Stirton twice came close.

The striker was firstly foiled by a goal-saving block from Scales after being gifted possession by Auston Trusty and later shot just wide from 18 yards after the Celtic central defence backed off.

United brought on winger Amar Fatah for holding midfielder Pan Camara at half-time but Celtic were even more dominant in the second half.

Reo Hatate and Maeda missed good chances before Nygren shot high into the net from six yards in the 63rd minute.

Maeda had an easy finish six minutes later after Tounekti's shot was saved.
hypothesis:
Le Celtic strapaza le Dundee United al retorn de O'Neill

Tl Celtic Park él indô gnü la normalité: i campiuns dl Celtic s’á assiguré na devënta dominanta por 4 a 0 söl Dundee United, fajon la pröma partida zënza se ciafé n goal dal’ultima partida sogada sot ala direziun de Martin O’Neill.

Dui gol tl pröm tëmp te cinch menüc de Yang Hyun-jun y Arne Engels á mené le Celtic sön la strada dla devënta, tratan che O'Neill é gnü zoruch al banch cun stil do le rëgn cört ma catastrofich de Wilfried Nancy.

Le suplënt Benjamin Nygren á abiné so 11. gol dla sajun y Daizen Maeda á segné la rebatüda por avalié les döes maius devëntes dl Celtic cina sëgn tla sajun de campionat. Trami é stá tla devënta a ce de O'Neill, che á porté a set devëntes sön ot partides.

Le Celtic á cherdé en lönesc l’alenadú de 73 agn, do avëi desdit le contrat de Nancy do sis pordüdes - y 18 goi ciafá - te ot partides.

Le caos, la confujiun y la fragilité de defenjiun che à caraterisé la perioda de Nancy é descomparis, cun i Hoops che s'à porté a ma trëi punc dala piza dla tlassifica.

Degügn te le stadium ne fossa stat surprais de odëi O'Neill ristablì la formaziun tradiziunela 4-3-3 dl Celtic, y la squadra à danü ciafé olà che ara s'era fermada sot O'Neill, desche sce ara se foss dascedada da n incö y foss jita inant cun la vita desche de normal.

Le difensur zentral Liam Scales á ciafé indô la forma costanta che al â mostré denant de patí tl sistem a trëi difensurs sot al allenadú franzesc.

Callum McGregor à indô mët man da mëte a jí le jüch, cun i jüiadus de fascia dl Celtic, Yang y Sebastian Tounekti, che à albü la liberté de atach do che l'ex alenadú dl Columbus Crew ti â dé i rosc de esterns de defenjiun.

Le Celtic á albü le 78 por cënt dl posses dl palé, á fat 22 trates te porta y ti un á lascé fá ma trëi al United. I aversars dl Celtich â na mesaria de 12 trates te porta tratan le tëmp dl alenadú Nancy, y le United instës á ciamó fat 17 trates te porta tratan süa devënta por 2 a 1 sön i Hoops a Tannadice dan da manco de cater edemes.

Le Celtic á metü le United sot presciun fin dal scomenciamënt, cun Kieran Tierney che é sté fondamental te na seria de ocajiuns tla pröma mesora.

Le defensur de man ciancia à albü n tiro devié demez, Yang y Scales à fat tëma cun di tirs de ce y Maeda à devié n cross bas sön la travërsa, denant co la presciun portes sü früc al 27ejm menüt.

La dominanza dl Celtic ê tan grana che Scales se á ciafé cun la pera al or dl area y á passé a Yang, che á tiré ite dai 20 metri.

Maeda á tosc falé n palé, denanche Engels realisëies n gol dl pröm tëmp sön le palé de Tierney.

Nia döt n'é sté saurí por le Celtic tl pröm tëmp. Le defensur a man dërta messican Julian Araujo á segné süa pröma partida cun na cherta cöcena por na desfida prigorosa sön Will Ferry, che stô ciamó a petlé canch'al ciafâ la puniziun che resultâ.

Ince l’United á albü sües ocajiuns y Dario Naamo parô malsigü sce al orô tó de ce o volley le cross en profondité de Craig Sibbald, mo al n’á fat no l’un no l’ater, deperpo che Owen Stirton é rové dui iadi daimpró dal gol.

L'atacant é impröma gnü desfanté da na puniziun de Scales do ch'al ti é gnü scinché le palé al Auston Trusty y dedô röiel de püch dlungia 18 iadi do che la defenjiun zentrala dl Celtic s'á trat zoruch.

Le United á fat gní ite l'ala Amar Fatah por le centrocampist defensif Pan Camara tl'arpausa, ma le Celtic é sté ciamò plü dominant tl secund temp.

Reo Hatate y Maeda á falé de bones ocajiuns denant che Nygren tirass alt te porta da siese iards al 63ejimo menüt.

Maeda á na conclujiun saurida sis menüc plü tert do che la trata de Tounekti é gnüda parada.

US bound Thompson stars as Galway reach FBD final

California-bound Matthew Thompson lashed home 2-06 as Galway overcame Leitrim by 11 points in Tuam to book their spot in next week's FBD League decider.

2025 Young Footballer of the Year nominee Thompson will be out of action for the entirety of the league and the early part of the championship, with Padraic Joyce confirming that the Salthill-Knocknacarra players is studying in Berkeley for the upcoming semester.

He was the leading figure on a largely experimental Galway side - which also contained Cian Hernon and Kieran Molloy - as they came from three points down at half-time to beat Leitrim.

Thompson buried a goal in the top corner in the first half but the Connacht champions trailed Leitrim at the break, Killian Gaffney proving effective from placed balls, while Ryan O'Rourke and Jack Kelly also landed points.

Galway manager Padraic Joyce remonstrates with the referee over a decision

However, with Thompson converting a second half penalty, Galway eased home after the interval, with 10 different scorers overall as they ran out 2-19 to 0-14 winners.

After two rounds of the FBD League, the top two progress to next week's final, with Galway facing the winner of tomorrow's Roscommon-Mayo tie.

In Leinster, Westmeath have booked their spot in the O'Byrne Cup final after an 11-point win over Offaly in a goal-fest in Mullingar.

Waiting for them in the decider is a Kildare outfit that defeated Dublin 1-22 to 1-13.

Mark McHugh's Westmeath side advanced ahead of reigning champions Longford following a coin toss last Saturday but they impressed on the field of play on Saturday.

A brace of goals apiece from Danny McCarton and Brandon Kelly, plus another from Senan Baker, saw them run out 5-10 to 2-08 winners.

Ciaran Murphy scored two goals either side of half-time to pull the visitors back into the contest, the margin being briefly reduced to three points 11 minutes into the second half.

However, an unanswered burst of 3-02 over the next 15 minutes saw the hosts settle the contest in an emphatic manner.

Kildare found their feet in the second half against Dublin and now are one game away from a first O'Byrne Cup since 2014.

Harry O'Neill fires to the net for Kildare

Both management teams experimented in Newbridge with Dublin in particular shorn of overly familiar faces, but in the first half it seemed to matter little as they led 1-08 to 0-08 at the break.

Jamie McCarville palmed home their goal but it was Clyde Burke who caught the eye for the travelling support with some brilliant shooting that included two orange flags - the second of which was of the highest quality.

Alex Beirne was racking up the scores for the Lilywhites though and his two-point free early in the second half kick-started a run of 1-05 without reply, Harry O'Neill with the goal in the 43rd minute.

Kildare continued to turn the screw with James Harris' late two-pointer sending them on their way.

Thompson, che é gnü nominé por le titul de "Sogadú de bal jonn dl ann 2025" tomará fora por döta la dorada dla League y por la pröma pert dl campionat. Padraic Joyce á confermé che le sogadú dl Salthill-Knocknacarra studiará tl proscim semester a Berkeley.

Ël é sté la figöra leader de na scuadra dl Galway en gran pert sperimentala - te chëra che al sogâ ince Cian Hernon y Kieran Molloy - che á avalié fora na desfarënza de trëi punc tl pröm tëmp y á ala fin batü le Leitrim.

Thompson á trat tl pröm tëmp n gol tl piz alt dla porta, mo i campiuns dl Connacht é restá indô ti confrunc dl Leitrim ala pröm palsa. Killian Gaffney s’â desmostré efetif tles situaziuns standard, deperpo che ince Ryan O’Rourke y Jack Kelly á arjunt punc.

L’alenadú dl Galway, Patrick Joyce, protestëia pro l’arbiter por na dezijiun

Do che Thompson á trasformé na puniziun tl secundo tëmp, él sté le Galway che á stlüt la partida zënza problems do la palsa, cun indöt 10 sogadus desvalis che á fat gol, davagnan cun le resultat de 2-19 a 0-14.

Do dui dis de campionat dla FBD League, röia les döes scuadres prömes classificades tla finala dl’edema che vëgn, olache Galway afruntará le davagnadú dla partida da en doman danter Roscommon y Mayo.

Tl Leinster él sté le Westmeath che s’á assiguré so post tla finala dla Copa O’Byrne do na devënta de 11 punc söl Offaly te na partida cun tröc goi a Mullingar.

Tla finala ti aspetel sëgn la formaziun dl Kildare che á batü le Dublin por 1-22 a 1-13.

La scuadra dl Westmeath de Mark McHugh se â cualifiché dan dai campiuns atuai dl Longford do na trata de monëda en sabeda dan otedé, mo chësta sabeda ára imprescioné söl ciamp de jüch.

Dui goi porom de Danny McCarton y Brandon Kelly, implü n ater de Senan Baker, ti á pormetü da se assiguré la devënta cun n resultat de 5-10 a 2-08.

Ciaran Murphy á segné dui goi, un dan y un do la palsa, condujon i ghesć indô zoruch tla competiziun, la desferënza s’á smendrí por n cört tëmp a trëi punc 11 menüc do le scomenciamënt dl secundo tëmp.

Mo na lovina de goi de 3-02 ti 15 menüc dedô zënza reaziun da pert di ghesć á porté pro che i patruns de ciasa podess stlüje la partida te na manira plü co tlera.

Tl secundo tëmp cuntra le Dublin é le Kildare rové ite miú tl jüch y é sëgn ma öna na partida dalunc dala devënta de süa pröma copa O’Byrne Cup dal 2014 incá.

Harry O'Neill tira tla rëi por Kildare

Intrami i teams de alenadus á esperimenté a Newbridge, y en particolar pro le Dublin manciâl tröc müsc conesciüs, mo tl pröm tëmp parôl che chësc ess pücia importanza, dal momënt ch’ai ê dant tl pröm tëmp cun le resultat de 1-08 a 0-08.

Jamie McCarville á realisé so gol cun la man, mo al é sté Clyde Burke che á atiré l'atenziun di sostegnidus in trasferta cun n valgügn tirs brilanc che á includü döes bandires orances – la secunda dles cuales ê de cualité altiscima.

Alex Beirne abinâ indere i punc por i "Lilywhites" y süa puniziun da dui punc al scomenciamënt dl secundo tëmp á fat pié ia na seria de 1-05 zënza resposta, cun Harry O’Neill che á trat le gol al 43. menüt.

Le Kildare á aumenté inant le druch, y la trata da dui punc de James Harris tla fasa finala dla partida é stada dezisiva.

Traction meets fashion: The best weatherproof trainers for rain-slicked pavements

The Cloudhorizon Waterproof feels purpose-built for the stop-start rhythm of winter commuting. Its lightweight waterproof upper keeps your feet dry without adding bulk, and the shoe's smooth rocker shape helps you roll forward easily, even when you're layered up and carrying heavy loads.

Underfoot, Helion foam creates a cushioned bounce that softens long walks between stations, while the grippy rubber outsole keeps things steady on wet steps and shiny tiles. The pared-back design gives it a polished, modern look, ideal if you prefer a trainer that handles lousy weather subtly, without shouting its technical credentials.

I Cloudhorizon Waterproof pé realisá aposta por le ritm nia tres saurí di spostamënc da d’invern. Süa pert dessura lisiera y che tëgn l’ega mantëgn i pisc assöc zënza i fá gní posoc y la forma dobliosa dl cialzá dëida le pe te so movimënt dl jí, ince canche an á indos deplü strac de guant y an porta de gran pëisc.

Sot i pisc él la scaia Helion che cheriëia n plomac amortisant che alisirëia i trus lunc danter les staziuns, deperpo che la sora de gume a gran aderënza garantësc stabilité söi scalins moi y söles platines liciorëntes. So design essenzial ti dá n aspet modern y rafiné, ideal sce te tires dant n cialzá da ginastica che afrontëies le bor tëmp cun discreziun, zënza scraié massa incërch sües carateristiches tecniches.

source:
Reading Gloria Steinem's undercover report on being a Playboy Bunny... finished Part I and damn🤔
Despite being well aware of Playboy being uh... a CORPORATION lol... had no idea how much their entire infrastructure truly served to perpetuate classism in an extremely creepy way while outwardly presenting themselves as the "classy" and thus "more ethical" option compared to say, Hustler

I'll post some screenshots later but to give you the gist, Bunnies (who were cocktail waitresses), had to:
- accept lower (by $200-150, equivalent to today's $2.5K) wages than advertised
- hand over 50% of all their tips
- give their last names to "Number 1 key holders" (ergo, celebrities/elites) if asked
- be subjected to a pelvic exam and blood test but weren't allowed to pick the physician
- be spied on by a private eye
- go out if their way to hide their husbands/bfs

The central point that unites all of this:
Bunnies were STRICTLY NOT ALLOWED TO (penalized by termination) date any other employees or customers... BUT accompanying and dating the "Number 1 key holders" was permitted, if not encouraged. See where this is going?

New recruits were given a "Bunny Bible" to study all those bizarre rules and instructions from.
To mention a few more:
- Bunnies' work performance was assessed by a "merit system" (YES, that exact wording!) instead of being written up. Unsurprisingly, merit was not only judged by a good work ethic but also very specific requirements on looks and attitude.
- there was an incentive system in place that rewarded Bunnies who sold the most liquor and merchandise
hypothesis:
I á lit la relaziun socrëta de Gloria Steinem sön l’ester na Playboy Bunny... i á rové la pert I y mostro ince 🤔
Scebëgn ch’i ê savô avisa che Playboy ê ... dijun ... na MULTINAZIONALA... n’âi degöna idea de tan che döta süa strotöra foss veramënter fata da perpetué l’atejamënt classist te na manira estremamënter da dlaié, deperpo che deforaia se presentâra coche l’alternativa "de classa" y insciö "plü etica" en confrunt a, ma por dí, Hustler

I postará n valgügn screenshots plü tert, mo por ves dé na idea dla cossa, êl les Bunnies (che ê pordert chelneres de cocktails) che messâ:
- azeté paiamënc plü basc (de 200-150$, ci che corespogn a 2.500$ d’aldedaincö) co ci che al gnô reclamisé
- dé jö le 50% de döta la bonaman che ares ciafâ
- ti dí so cognom a chi che â "la tle numer 1" (chel foss celebrités/elites), sce ares gnô damanades
- azeté da fá n ejam ginecologich y n ejam dl sanch zënza podëi se chirí fora le dotur
- azeté da gní spicolades da n detectif privat
- fá dles dötes por ascogne sü omi/chestians

Le punt zentral che liëia döt chësc:
Ales bunnies ti êl DASSËNN PROIBÍ (zenza gnôn lizenziá) da jí cun d’atri dependënc o cliënc ... MO l’acompagné y le jí fora con chi che â "la tle numer 1" ê conzedü, sce nia incorajé. Capîse te ci direziun che ara jô?

Ales colaboradësses nöies ti gnôl dé na "Bunny Bible" por imparé dötes chës regoles y istruziuns strambes.
Por nen nominé ciamó n valgönes d’atres:
- Les prestaziuns de laur dles bunnies gnô valutades aladô de n "sistem de mirit" (SCE, avisa insciö!) impede cun relaziuns scrites. Nia da se fá demorvëia sce le mirit ne gnô nia ma iudiché aladô de na bona etica de laur, mo ince söla basa de recuisic dër spezifics sön le ciaré fora y le comportamënt.
- al valô n sistem de inzentifs che premiâ les bunnies che venô le plü alcolics y articui de marcianzia

I just had a very nice #dream that I made friends with Lee Chaeyeon. I just started talking to her nand the next thing I know, I have stayed over her house (like when the French kidnapped me for Christmas) and she is telling me to go up stairs and "shuffle up a little bit" (her English was generally excellent) by which she meant "tidy up a little bit" to show her mom we were ready to eat.
She comes upstairs to "shuffle up" her room and starts making gestures to explain what she means ...
1/

(she was always so excited to see me in this dream) because I was taking my coat off instead of "shuffling up."
Then she indicates this little piece of paper and says she has left me an autograph but in return she wants this little trading card I made in second grade of "50 Spikes," a sonic knock-off, obviously with more spikes. (This card actually exists IRL BTW). I start explaining to her what it is and if she really wants it (she did) I at least needed a picture of her holding it.
2/

Partly because I would miss it, but also, otherwise no one would believe me that she had wanted this thing from me.
It was then I realized we still didn't have each others' phone numbers.
3/3
hypothesis:
I á apëna albü dër n bel #some che i â fat amizizia cun Lee Chaeyeon. I â madër metü man da baié cun ëra, y denant che i m’un ess anadé, êi che i stô sura nöt pro d’ëra (n’pü coche canche i franzesc m’â secuestré da Nadé), y ëra me dijô da jí sö alt y "romené sö n pü’" (so inglesc ê en general ezelënt), cun chël ch’ara minâ "fratiné n pü’" por ti fá capí a süa uma che i ên arjigná da mangé.
Ara gnô sö alt por "romené sö" süa ciamena y metô man da fá gesć por me splighé ci ch’ara orô dí ...
1/

(ara ê tres tan emozionada da m’odëi te chësc some) deach’i me despiâ le mantel impede "romené sö".
Spo me mostrâra chësc pice toch de papier y dijô ch’ara m’â lascé n autogram, mo coche retüda orôra chë picia figurina che i â fat te secunda elementara de "50 Spikes", na imitaziun de Sonic, sambëgn cun deplü spines. (Ma por dí, chësta figurina esist davëi tla vita reala). I metô man da ti splighé ci ch’al ê y sce ara l’orô veramënter (y ara l’orô) adorâi almanco na süa fotografia olache ara la tignî tla man.
2/

En pert, deach’ara m’ess zënza mancé, mo ince, deache zënza ne m’ess degügn cherdü ch’ara orô chësta cossa da me.
Al é te chël momënt che i m’â intenü che i n’ân nia ciamó i numeri de telefon l’un dl ater.
3/3

Whoa, you mean Blender Market, the thing I said was the first step towards the Blender environment becoming a shitty subscription service, renamed itself to the oh-so-appealing name "Superhive" and then decided to mandate subscriptions?
WHOA WHO COULD HAVE GUESSED?! Not me, that's for sure. This is completely out of left field!

TBH, I have never seen a single company with "Hive" in the name that wasn't a complete shitshow run by assholes, so I never bought anything on that platform -
Sorry
I didn't RENT anything on that platform if I could help it.
Maybe it's unfair, but "clearly we, a company that specializes in connecting creators with their audience, should name ourselves HIVE, because the creators are just our loyal little bees, and audience is our loyal little bees, work for us!" always gives me bad vibes.

"Hive implies busy crowds!"
Hive implies a queen.
hypothesis:
Ostro, te mines le Blender Market, chë cossa de chëra ch’i â dit che foss le pröm vare devers la trasformaziun dl ambiënt Blender te n sorvisc d’abonamënt de merda, che s’á dé l’inom nü tan atratif "Superhive" y á spo tut la dezijiun da sforzé sö abonamënc?
TÖO, CHE S’ESS PA PUNSÉ VAL’ DE TE?! Iö no, chël é sigü. Chësc vëgn daldöt fora de nia!

Da dí bel la verité, n’á ciamó mai odü öna na firma che á "Hive" tl inom y che ne foss nia n plunder fat, manajé da trotli, porchël ne m’ái mai cumpré val’ sön chë plataforma -

source:
On a lighter note, just saw someone complaining about when games beg you to switch to easy mode when you fail.
I also hate this.
I love having an easy mode. Hell, I think games should just fuckin' let you cheat, as long as competitions all have agreed-on rules about it.
But every game that's pestered me into easy mode has been an instant put-down. I have plenty of games to play, if you want me to be done faster, congrats, I'm done faster.

This is what makes modern Marios - modern-ish anyway - so impossible for me to play.
"Did you die thwee times mawwio? Here's the golden supersuit of invincibility because you suck! If you don't want it, just carefully avoid ever pressing anything besides "start level yes again no no nothing else just start the level".
This is also why I stopped trying to play Phantom Pain. Whenever I died, it'd offer me the chicken hat and default to "yes", eventually I forgot to manually say "fuck off".

I get it's a retention thing, but it's so disrespectful.
Autoscaling difficulty also pisses me off, because I'll be gearing up for a challenge and then the game will panic and lower it to super easy because I've been "struggling".
I'll die or something, go back to try again, but nope, now the challenge is gone. You succeeded! You made the game go away! Don't worry, those challenges were for someone else. Someone better.
I can't remember if I ever completed a game with autoscaling difficulty.

I guess the basic difference between me and their target audience is that I like to figure out how to do something, while their target audience - at least in their heads - likes to take a log flume through a Disneyworld attraction.
A little jostling, a little fluids, but don't worry, baby, daddy Walt's got ya. You're safey-wafe, you don't even have to move, just sit there and tee hee, here's a wittle splashy-splash.
If I wanted that, I'd go sit in a fucking dog park and pet a dog.
hypothesis:
Passun á val’ d’ater. I á apëna odü zacai che se baudiâ che i jüc te prëia da mudé söla modalité saurida, sce an ne ti é nia.
Chësc ne döri gnanca iö.
Al me sá bel da avëi na modalité saurida. Ostro, i arati che i jüc messass ma te lascé sbordené, tan inant che dötes les competiziuns se é gnüdes sön regoles aladô.
Mo vigni jüch che orô me sforzé tla modalité saurida é atira stá na delujiun por me. I á n gröm de jüc da soghé, sce i orëis che i röies plü debota, complimënc, i röii plü debota.

Chësc él da me infora ci che fej i Marios moderns - o almanco chi plü o manco moderns - imposcibli da soghé.
Este mort trëi iadi, Mario? Chiló aste la tuta d’or dl’invincibilité, deache t’es tan stlet! Sce te ne l’os nia, evitëia madër da druché sön val’ d’ater co "mët man le livel, sce, ciamó n iade, no no nia d’ater, mët madër man le livel".
Chësta é ince la rajun porciodí che i á lascé da porvé da soghé Phantom Pain. Vigni iade che i morî, me pitâl le ciapel da galüc y metô "sce" coche opziun standard, ala fin m’âi desmentié da dí a man "tofete le cü".

I capësci ch’al é na chestiun de retenziun, mo al é tan zënza respet.
Ince la dificolté che se adatëia da sora me dessëna a mort, deache i m’arjigni a na desfida y spo él le jüch che vá en panich y al arbassa le livel de dificolté a "super saurí", deach’i m’á n pü’ stenté.
I möri o val’ de te, vá indô zoruch a porvé ciamó n iade, mo no, sëgn n’él plü degöna desfida. T’es sté bun! T’as fat sparí le jüch! No te cruzié, chës desfides ê por zacai d’atri. Por zacai de mius.
I ne me recordi nia da avëi n iade soghé cina ala fin n jüch cun le livel de dificolté che s’adatâ da su.

I arati che la desfarënzia de basa danter me y so publich sides chëra che a me me sál bel da ciafé fora coche valch funzionëia, deperpo che a so publich de referimënt - almanco te sü ces - ti sál plü bel da fá na roda sön na atraziun acuatica de Disneyworld.
N pü’ de sbürles, n pü’ de mol, mo no te cruzié, picera, pa Walt mët averda de te. T’es al sigü, te n’as gnanca bria da te möie, stá ma iló senté y rítela n pü’, al é ma na picia sprinzada.
Sc’i oress val’ de te, jessi a me senté te n parch di cians y ti fajess aicia a n cian.

source:
Campanīle
A #poetry thread
i.
A Roman church belfry,
gold cross reaching for clouds:
bell tolls, sets brass note free,
sings out through misty shroud,
its high peal an appeal
to the faithful long gone.
No more piety’s zeal:
many sunsetted dawns.
Its stone tower keeps watch
through the mask of dusk-rain,
skies loosing their barrage
upon roof tiles again.
🧵👇🏼
#poem #poemaday #moody #neoclassical #church #night #photography

ii.
Who pulled on the bell cord?
Lone monk in his cloister
with none left in accord.
He, grain in church oyster —
yet no cell holds his bed,
no dust stirred by his shoes,
his name never was said,
no old books that he used.
The bell rope hangs, worn, frayed,
gnawed by church mice’s teeth.
It’s been long since it swayed,
pulled by hands underneath.
🧵👇🏼

iii.
The night wind whispers psalms
and breathes canticles’ chant
to swing the clapper of bronze,
I answer in descant —
but not with my own voice.
The wind swallows my call,
chimes its own holy noise
with the hands of its squall.
✋🏼🧵
hypothesis:
Ciampaní
N fi de #poesia
i.
N ciampaní de na dlijia romana,
crusc d’or che brancia do les niores:
le sonn de ciampanes, che lascia jí na nota de latun,
cianta fora por slaieri de ciarü,
so sonn alt é n apel
ai fedei oramai morc.
Nia plü se sacrifiché ala pietosité:
tröc rossagn jüs dojö.
So ciampaní tëgn verda
fora por la mascora dla plöia dles danterores,
le cil desćiaria indô so bombardamënt d’artilaria
sön plates da tët.
🧵👇🏼
#poesia #dedlapoesia #dalönes #neoclassich #dlijia #nöt #fotografia

ii.
Che á pa trat tla corda dles ciampanes?
N frater su te so convënt
cun degun romagnü tla comunité.
Ël, sciöche n granel pordü danter i mürs de dlijia —
mo degöna zela á so let,
degun stöp ne vëgn soflé sö da sü cialza,
so inom n’é mai gnü nominé ,
degügn libri vedli, ch’al adorâ.
La corda dles ciampanes taca, consumada, desfirada,
ciaugnada jö dai dënz dles sorüces.
Al é passé tröp tëmp, da canche ara á nainé l’ultim iade,
trata dales mans dessot.
🧵👇🏼

iii.
Le vënt dla nöt bisbiliëia salms
y flada daplan ciantilenes
por nainé le pantoncel de brom,
iö respogni en cuntracanon —
mo nia cun mia usc.
Le vënt dlot mia cherdada,
sona so sonn sant
cun les mans de süa tempesta.
✋🏼🧵

Ma, i arati che i implementará UCT, deache mi jüch é sëgn Go, chësta gnará sëgn na aziun de vega.

Vega the Digital Dragon surprises a trio of mischievous scamps who snuck into her arcade in the middle of the night but one of them recognizes her as a town superhero and they end up having a heartwarming moment geeking out over video games. Unfortunately, the moment is interrupted by somebody or something landing on the roof of the arcade... 1/?

Vega goes to investigate and finds Dr. Vesper, in his monstrous bat form that the press has dubbed the "Gargoyle Man," along with a harpy-like creature that Vesper describes as his "little protegee." Vesper says that they have come to introduce themselves and invite Vega to join their society of man-creature misfits that is led by "The Madame," Dr. Diana Laughton of the Laughton Institute. 2/?

Vega buys some time to get the mischievous scamps out of the arcade and call the rest of the Mythics for backup, then plays along at being interested in joining this "new family." Vesper and Harpy (who does not speak once during the interaction) lead Vega to a ship in the harbor, where the Laughton Institute appears to be packing up their things... presumably because they know they're drawing attention from Agent Carter and A.R.G.E.N.T. among others. 3/?

source:
In a surprise Inspector Clouseau twist, I now have an extra thing to investigate for Spooky Kitties Sciences!
I was doing a quick scroll through the evenings secondary camera video, when I spotted a curious The Inspector standing on the trunk of the tree near the feeding station. Kept jumping around, finding him near where the magpies had been, so I initially suspect(edit) he was simply chasing them as they sometimes let him do, until I randomly chance stop...
#SpookyKittiesSciences

There Inspector Clouseau was, rolling around like crazing about 2 meters NE of the tree, mostly hidden by the unfortunate placement of the awnings east post. Still, there he was for 5 minutes, at which point he ran back up the tree, walked across the lawn to the hill, flattened himself at the bottom, and then ran off camera, presumably in the middle of The Zoomies.
2/
#SpookyKittiesSciences

Now, as some of my Spooky Kitties Sciences readers may know, the motivations behind that tests are not just to entertain the kitties. While the most important aspect is the genuine curiosity I had seeing the kitties rolling around in the snow, I really wanted to find something that The Inspector liked. I came out of the initial testing with only a single moment to hint that he liked something. What that was is still a mystery.
3/
#SpookyKittiesSciences
hypothesis:
Te na ota nia aspetada dëgna de Inspector Clouseau, ái sëgn na cossa implü da inrescí por Spooky Kitties Sciences!
I platernâ debota fora por le video dla serada dla camera secundara, canche i á abiné n ispetur corius impé sön le ciüch dlungia la staziun da mangé. Al saltâ inant y zoruch, i l’â abiné dlungia les agaces, porchël sospetâi naota che al i ciaciass ma, sciöche al pó val’ iade, cina che i á archité por caje...
#SpookyKittiesSciences

Iló êl Inspector Closeau che se brodorâ incërch sciöche n mat incër 2 metri a nord-ost dl lëgn, la miú pert dl tëmp stopé dal pilaster a ost che ê te na posiziun desfortunada. Impó, al é sté iló por 5 menüc alalungia y é spo salté sö por le lëgn, jü ia por pre ia dal col, s’á metü dal plat y é spo salté fora dla zona de odüda dla camera, bonamënter amez i Zoomies.
2/
#SpookyKittiesSciences

Sëgn, sciöche n valgügn de mi leturs de Spooky Kitties Sciences magari sá, é les motivaziuns che stá do chëstes proes nia ma chëres da ti fá la aurela cörta ai mins. Deperpo che l’aspet plü important ê la coriosité sinziera ch’i â da ti ciaré ai mins che se brodorâ tla nei, orôi davëi ciafé val’ che ti plajô al ispetur. Les prömes proes á ma revelé un n momënt che á dé da capí che val’ ti plajô. Ci che chël ê, é tres ciamó n mister.
3/
#SpookyKittiesSciences

source:
Today's Sunday Best features my Knight from Ragnarok Online! This was my very first online PC game, he was an agi/dex 2HQ knight w/ a set of elemental claymores. I played on iRO Loki, and had two drawings featured as loadscreen art!
My online handle stems from this guy. O'Reiley -> Reiley -> Rally

Coming in just under the wire on today's Sunday Best, it's my Deep Rock Galactic Engineer! The loadout I ran most of the time was Executioner LOK-1 & RJ-250 Grenade Launcher. I think the LOK-1 is one of the coolest weapon designs in an FPS, a lock-on mechanic that encouraged finesse & deep mastery.

This week's Sunday Best is my Xenoverse OC, Parma (for parmesan cheese). She had a partner named Brie. Parma dressed up to match the teachers she studied under, but her final fit reflected the one she started with, styled to match this one pair of gloves. She used Giant Storm & Double Sunday a lot.

For my Sunday Best I drew my Paxultek from Remnant II. The goal of my build was to make the damage number from a single shot as large as possible. I used a Widowmaker single-shot elephant rifle we nicknamed The Governor. It was so strong it one-shot teammates through friendly fire damage reduction.

Today's Sunday Best features my funny gay dog lady from Webfishing. Her voice had a deeper, slower pitch so she sounded old & chill. One time I joined a full server, sat somewhere & started posting practical life advice, bits of big-sister wisdom, & the whole server found me & sat with me to listen.

It's Sunday, today's feature is my Darktide Zealot. Her name is Callista, she's chasing sainthood to be pardoned of her many crimes so she won't have to apologize for any of them. She has black dreams full of teeth and is constantly flirting with female Loner Psykers. She's unwell, but Female Loose Cannon Veterans think it's endearing and constantly hit on her for it. Their in-game voices say all of this.

Today's Sunday Best feature is QP from 100% Orange Juice! I played OJ a lot with my fighting game friends; for some reason I'd always have the hand pictured here. We used to post in text chat during games and I'd always say, Do NOT test me. I played so much QP the devs awarded me a special QP badge!

This week's Sunday Best is "Local Psychopath," Fem Boss #1 from Saint's Row 3. This was the first game I wanted to use the create-a-feature to make a character who blended in with the cast and looked like a genuine member of the Third Street Saints. I picked 3 cuz my favorite jacket wasn't in 4. :(

For today's Sunday Best I've got my Animal Crossing Villager to share. My favorite way to play these games is as part of a global cartel of goons who shared their wealth. When one person had big Turnips, everyone got paid. No profiteering; you need a rare item to make your room idea work? We got you.

It's technically Sunday, and this week's fit lands a bit early! I don't Tekken very often, but when I do I like to pick Steve and do all his slippery punches. In Tekken 7 he had a loose-fit, full-body track suit, so I made him into a deer man. When he's in Peekaboo Stance the antlers point forward!

This week's Sunday Best feature is Gaige from Borderlands 2. Pure Anarchy is one of the coolest FPS mechanics in the genre, an escalating accumulation of power that came with a diminishing level of control, lowering both TTK & effective range. Ride the wave & figure it out on the fly, it'll be fine.
Gaige's voice actress plays V in Cyberpunk 2077, I learned recently. An old friend.

Today's Sunday Best isn't a person, it's a plane from an old Vlambeer game called Luftrausers! The music changes to match your airplane. My favorite configuration is called "Shipwreck," a sword-hulled amphibious prop plane with shotgun cannons, it can divebomb through boats & burst up from the sea.

Tonight our Sunday Best feature is the Houndmaster from a charming Crawl-like sidescroller called Vagante. Lovingly referred to as the Dogmancer, I loved to spec into skills that increased damage when you threw the dog at monsters. The dog roams on its own, but you can also carry it on your back!

For this week's Sunday Best we're going all the way back to Cyborg Justice on the Genesis. I played this game a lot and I always liked to make this one guy: round torso, big stampy feet and the buzzsaw hand. I always remember the magazine ad for this game vividly; you might too if you're of an age.

I did a bit of archaeological research to uncover references for this week's Sunday Best. This was my guy from Loadout, a third-person arena shooter about fiddly weapon customization. My main gun was an electric pulse cannon called "Kill-a-Watts" and the backup was a flaming LMG named "Roast Beef."

Mia adressada online vëgn da chësc tipo. O'Reiley -> Reiley -> Rally

Rové propi al ultim momënt tl Sunday Best de incö, al é mi Engineer de Deep Rock Galactic! L'armamënt che i adorâ por la maiú pert dl tëmp ê Executioner LOK-1 & RJ-250 Grenade Launcher. I me pënsi che le LOK-1 sides un di design de erma plü bi te n FPS, na mecanica de coliamënt automatich che incorajâ finëza & na gran maestria.

Le Miù dla Domënia de chësta edema é mi OC de Xenoverse, Parma (por le formai parmigian). Ara â na compagnëssa che se tlamâ Brie. Parma se vistî por corespogne ai maestri da chi che ara imparâ, mo so vestimënt final refletô chël di scomenciamënc, stilisé por corespogne a chësc para de guanc. Ara adurâ gonot Giant Storm & Double Sunday.

Por mia Sunday Best ái dessigné mi Paxultek da Remnant II. Le travert de mi build ê chël da ingrandí le dann de n colp su. I tolô n stlop elefant a n colp su che â inom Widowmaker y le surainom The Governor. Al ê tan sterch che al copâ i compagns cun la reduziun dl dann dl füch amich cun n colp su.

Le Sunday Best presënta incö mia compagna gay da orëi bun cun le cian de webfishing. Süa usc â n sonn plü sot y pëigher, porchël sonâra da vedla y relassada. N iade sunsi jüda te n server plëgn, me sun sentada inzai y ha metü man da publiché consëis pratics por la vita, n pü’ de sapiënza sciöche gran so, y döt le server m’á ciafé y s’á senté pro me por m’ascuté sö.

Al é domënia, le personaje de incö é mia Zealot de Darktide. Ara á inom Callista, ara vá do la santité por gnì pordenada de sü tröc delic, insciö che ara ne mëss nia perié scüsa por degun de ëi. Ara á somi fosc colms de dënz y ara va dagnora do ales Loner Psykers femenes. Ara ne stá nia bëgn, mo les veteranes Loose Cannon femenes pënsa che chësc sides da plajëi y ti va dagnora do por chësc. Sües usc tl jüch dij döt chësc.

La protagonista dl Sunday Best de incö é QP da 100% Orange Juice! I á fat tröpes partides a OJ cun mi amisc di jüc de lota; por valch rajun i â dagnora la man mostrada chiló. Tratan les partides i un scrí te chat de test y i á dagnora dit, NO me metëi ala proa. I á fat tan de partides a QP che i svilupadus m'á dé n cuntrassëgn QP spezial!

Le Sunday Best de chësta edema é "Psicopatica dl post", Fem Boss #1 de Saints Row 3. Chësc ê le pröm jüch te chël che i orü adoré la funziun create-a-feature por fá n personaje da s'integré cun le cast y da parëi n mëmber vëi di Third Street Saints. I á chirí fora le 3 ajache mia iaca preferida n'ê nia tl 4. :(

Por le Sunday Best de incö ái mi abitant de Animal Crossing da partí.La mia manira preferida da soghé chisc jüc é da fá pert de n cartel global de tec che á partí deboriada süa richëza. Canche na porsona á Turnips gragn, vigni un vëgn paié. Nia speculaziun; te adores n oget rar por fá jí tüa idea por la ciamena? I ponsun nos.

Al é tecnicamënter Domënia, y le fit de chësta edema röia n pü' adora! I ne soghi nia a Tekken dër gonot, ma canch'i le feji me plej da cerne Steve y fá düc sü pügns evasifs. Tl Tekken 7 al â na tuta de ginastica lerga y intiera, porchël i l'á mudé te n om cerf.Canche al é te Peekaboo Stance, i corgn mira inant!

Tl Sunday Best de chësta edema é Gaige de Borderlands 2. Pure Anarchy é öna dles mecaniches FPS plü beles tl jëne, n'acumulaziun de podëi tres plü grana che comporta n livel de control tres manco, y che arbassa sides le TTK & la portada efetiva. Raita l'onda & capí le al jore, al jará bun.
Chëra che dá la usc a Gaige fej V te Cyberpunk 2077, i l'á descurí da impormó. N vedl amich.

Le Sunday Best de incö n'é nia na porsona, al é n aeroplan de n vedl jüch de Vlambeer che á inom Luftrausers! La musiga muda por s'adaté a to aeroplan. Mi configuraziun preferida á inom "Shipwreck," n aeroplan anfibie a trëndla cun scaf da spada y canuns a balins, al pó se sciuré te piciada tres les barches & salté fora dal mer.

Le nost Sunday Best de insnöt é le Houndmaster de n sidescroller charmant che somëia a Crawl y che á inom Vagante. Cherdé cun afët le Dogmancer, i adorâ da mëte punc tles abilitês por aumenté le dann canche te trat le cian cuntra i mostri. Le cian va en roda da su, mo te le pó ince porté sön le spiné!

Por le Sunday Best de chëst'edema junse döt indô a Cyborg Justice sön le Genesis. I á soghé dër a chësc jüch y i adorâ dagnora da cherié chësc tipo: torso toronn, gragn pisc da pesté y la man cun la siëia zircolara.I me recordi dagnora propi bën dla reclam tla revista por chësc jüch; te la podesses ince recordé, sce t'es de na certa eté.

I á fat na pü de inrescida archeologica por ciafé fora referimënc por le Sunday Best de chësta edema. Chësc ê mi tipo de Loadout, n arena shooter en terza porsona cun na personalisaziun dles ermes bela complicheda. Mia erma prinzipala ê n canun a impuls eletrich cherdé "Kill-a-Watts" y mia erma de resserva ê n LMG slominënt cherdé "Roast Beef."

source:
@JugglingWithEggs at least in my friend circle mobile phones not uncommon from early 90s, but they cost a *lot* to call from a landline (so if you were living at home your parents would discourage it), and until 1995-1999 were insecure, anyone with a radio scanner could (and often did) listen to them.
Whilst radio scanners were out of the price range of youths, many older folk had them, and until late 90s were often the kind of radio enthusiast who was a Tory bootlicker and supported the Police and other Establishment organisations, so you if discussing anything subversive on a mobile phone you risked being grassed up..
Ironically the tide turned by late 90s when scanners became affordable, and the Police were still on analogue radios 😁

@JugglingWithEggs by late 1990s everyone had a mobile phone and calls were cheaper (often with a good amount of free minutes) but SMS messages were unreliable and initially didn't even work across networks - people actually talked to each other on them!
One difference was access to physical spaces wasn't as heavily controlled as today - even though there was still CCTV and locals would call old bill on youths "hanging around", there was neither sufficient boots on the ground nor interconnected CCTV (a real security guard had to watch the footage locally, and property owners generally didn't want to pay for these folk at evenings and weekends.
There were also fewer cops on duty in outer suburbs during nights/weekends - they were all deployed into the town centres)

@vfrmedia
I remember texts sometimes taking hours to come through in the early noughties - so not always great for making on the fly arrangements.
Living in market town definitely meant less cctv and coppers back in 90’s. Remember difference when heading out into Bournemouth or Norwich of an evening. But young people having fun wasn’t frowned upon like it is now. My earlier post about facial recognition was about area where there has been uptick in teens just hanging out.
hypothesis:
@JugglingWithEggs almanco tla mia cerchia de amisc ê i telefons mobii bele plü che normai dai agn '90 incà, mo al costâ *un frac* da cherdé da na linia fissa (insciö, sce te vivoves ciamò a ciasa, te descorajâ i geniturs), y cina al 1995-1999 êi insigüsc, vignun cun n scanner radio podô (y savënza ël fat) i scuté.
Bëgn che i scanners radio foss fora dala portada di jogn, â tröc plü vedli de chi aparac, y cina ai agn '90 tardî êi suvënt apasciö chëi entusiasts de radio che fajô i bec ai Tories y sostignî la Polizia y d'atres organisaziuns dl Stat, insciö che sce te baiaves de valch de soviersif sun n telefon mobil rischiaraste da gnì denunzià..
Ironicamenter à les cosses se mudé vers la fin di agn '90 canche i scanners é deventà accessibli, y la Polizia doporâ ciamò radios analogiches 😁

@JugglingWithEggs Ala fin di agn 90 â düc n fonin y telefoné n’ê nia plü tan cer (gonot cun n bel numer de menüc debann), mo messaji SMS ê malsigüsc y ne funzionâ tl pröm gnanca danter rëis desfarëntes - les porsones baiâ efetivamënter un cun l’ater cun chisc aparac!
Öna na desfarënzia é che l’azes a locai n’ê nia tan controlé sciöche aldedaincö - ince sce al ê tres ciamó CCTC y vijins cherdâ la polizia por jogn che stô a "fraidí", n’êl nia assá personal no sistems CCTV colegá (na dërta verda messâ ti ciaré ales registraziuns söl post, y i proprietars n’orô nia paié por chësc da sera o la fin dl’edema.)
Al ê ince manco polizisć de nöt/fin dl’edema tles periferies - ai gnô düc mená ti zëntri dles cités)

@vfrmedia
I me recordi che ti agn 2000 adorâ i SMS val’ iade ores da rové a destinaziun - porchël n’êl nia dagnora l’ideal por fá fora val’ spontan.
Vire te a cité de marcé orô dí cotan manco CCTV y polizisć ti agn ’90. I me recordi la desfarënzia canche i jô fora da sera a Bournemouth o Norwich. Mo ai jogn che s’la lasciâ jí bona ti ciarân stort sciöche aldedaincö. Mi post da denant sora le reconescimënt dl müs revardâ na zona olache i sá madër por incërch é gnüs deplü.

painting with bazkie! 🧵 a (slow) thread [1/x]
I figured it'd be fun to share the whole process that goes into making a painting a custom scene. could be useful to some, and entertaining to others :)
👩‍🦱 ~ EVE & ADAM ~ 🧔‍♂️
as you all know, I'm a deeply religious person 🛐 so..
the scene: we're in the garden of eden. adam is eating apples from the forbidden tree, because of course he is. eve is having none of his shit, grabs an unfortunate unsuspecting nearby serpent, and is about to whip the shit out of adam. 🐍
#painting

painting with bazkie! 🧵 a (slow) thread [2/x]
so, we're gonna need reference photos. I want eve to be in the process of swinging the serpent around; so then I figured a baseball batter would be a good fit.
so wading through the AI slop, I found this actual photo that has a nice pose and good lighting.

painting with bazkie! 🧵 a (slow) thread [3/x]
I want adam to be in a protective stance, while also holding a forbidden apple, and all this, seen from the side/back. also, the lighting has to come from the same side as the batter. so all and all, it's pretty hard to find a proper reference pic for this, so I am posing for this one myself.
took about 20 pics with slightly different in stances etc., and decided on this one. (the right hand is going to hold the apple)

Good Morning Worlds!
We are going to the tip this morning. It will clear some of the stuff we sorted yesterday from the drive. I don't think we can clear it all unless we took the trailer, but the trailer is full of steel for weighing in.
Later I might carry on packing tote crates.
#GoodMorningWorlds

Tip trip done, and another car load cleared out.
I have taken the new trailer axle, and trailer drive motor system, out of the scrap metal trailer load. That means we can get more scrap metal in there and also not accidentally weigh in the parts I want to keep.
I think, next, I will start moving the scrap steel from the back garden into the trailer so that it is ready to go.
Scrap steel prices are not very high at the moment but better than nothing, if I take enough of it in one go.
Still have to sort the non-ferrous scrap.

That thing when you are taking the rotten tyres off small, wide lawn tractor wheels....
Huge effort to unmount one side of the tyre, but it was really badly rusted tight on the other side of the rim.
In the time it took me to break the bead free, I'd forgotten I had already done the other side, and ended up with the rim free but completely inside the tyre!
I had to remount the tyre that side, and then work around it to get the rim out.
I had to cut up the inner tube to get that out too!
I wonder how many more tyres I need to unmount? Four done so far.
hypothesis:
Bun de monn!
Incö danmisdé junse tla desćiaria dal ciomënt. Al gnará plinderné demez le ciomënt ch’i un coiü sö inier sön strada. I arati ch’i ne sun bëgn no bogn da tó döt y jí sce i ne tolun nia le remorch, mo le remorch é plëgn de feracia che mëss ciamó gní pesada.
Plü tert podessi spo ciamó pochené ite les scatores.
#BunDeMonn

Jita de spënora fata, y ciamó n auto ciarié demez.
I á tut l'assí nü dl trapolun, y l'implant dl motor da mené le trapolun, fora dla ciaria de rofl dl trapolun. Chël ó dí che i podun mëte ite plü fer vedl y ince nia por caje pesé ite i toc che iö ó me tigní.
I me pënsi, spo metarái man da sposté l'aciá vedl dal urt iadedô te roulotte por ch'al sides arjigné da jí.
I prisc dl aciá vedl n'é al momënt nia massa alc mo miú co nia, sce i nen toli assá te n iade.
Ciamó messëi despartí le refodam nia fer.

Chë cossa canche an tol i montli rotes dales pices rodes lerch dl tractor da pre....
Gran fadia da despié na pert dl montl, mo al ê propi dër da rüja strënta dal'atra pert dl rondel.
Tl tëmp ch'al m'á doré da deslié la perla, m'ái desmentié da avëi bele fat l'atra pert, y sun rové cun la brocia lëdia mo daldöt ite tl montl!
I á messü mëte sö danü le montl de chël vers, y spo lauré incërch por trá fora la roda.
I á messü taié sö la tuba daite por tó fora ince chëra!
I me damani tan de montli che i mëssi ciamó desćiolé? Cater garatá cina sëgn.

source:
project move out, spring break relay
day 1:
Cleared main bedroom closet
& contents of boxes on one wall.
I'm surveying all my belongings. Pulling out a small percentage to save. Sentimental items. Practical pieces for putting together a new life. At this stage I know I'm selecting more than I need, probably more than I can carry; but the amount that I'm leaving behind is far greater. Deciding what to keep & where comes after the survey. All the rest will be turned over to "scavengers."
#moverR

Day 2, midday break, Monday.
Today is harder than yesterday. I'm uncovering far more "sentimental" stuff. The challenge: these saved memories are a physical drag that impair rather than contribute anything practically to my future AND I feel integrated looking at them. There's a strong general condemnation, I feel, of holding onto sentimental items. Yet I know that they are powerful. But hey, I'm an artist. Even wistful, sad memories are valuable to me. I'm proceeding as before, retaining less+

+than I'm tossing, while knowing that I am keeping "too much." The next phase will be the actual moving & storing phase when more might be cut. This phase is the pre-screen before turning the cleared items over to others who will take everything away.
File under: how to move out of a home of 12 years & a home town of 45 years, with family roots here (& artifacts) from 150 years. I'm finally leaving, in search of a culture that suits my values.
#moverR
hypothesis:
spostamënt dl proiet, stafëta dles palses d'aisciöda
de 1:
L'armé dla ciamena prinzipala é gnü romené demez
& contignüs de scatores sön un n parëi.
I ti ciari do a dötes mies cosses. Tiré fora na picia porcentuala por sparagné. Elemënc sentimentai. Pezes pratiches por mëte adöm na vita nöia. Te chësc stadium sái che i selezionëii deplü de ci che i á debojëgn, bonamënter deplü de ci che i sun bun da porté; mo la cuantité che i lasci zoruch é cotan plü grana. Da fá fora ci che an ó tigní sö & olache al vëgn do la inrescida. Döt le rest i gnará fat zoruch a scarioc.
#moverR

Secundo de, palsa da misdé, lönesc.
Incö él plü ri co inier. I sun tl laur d‘abiné n gromun de patüc lié a sentimënc. La desfida: chisc recorc tignis sö é n straciamënt plütosc co n contribut pratich por mi dagní y i me sënti trat ite da d’ëi canche i ti ciari. I arati che al vëgnes dejaprové le tigní sö ogec cun valur sentimental. Porimpó sunsi sigü ch’ai sides de gran valur. Mo tö, i sun n artist. Ince recorc melancolics y da desplajëi á na valüta por me. I vá inant sciöche denant, conservé demanco+

+y sciuré demez deplü, mo indere sunsi cosciënt che i sun tl laur da tigní sö demassa. Le proscimo vare é le trasloch efetif & la fasa por arjigné ite gnará a s’al dé canche d’atres cosses gnará desgortes. Te chësta fasa ciari avisa denanco ti dé inant les cosses ch’i oress tó y jí a zacai, che les condüjará spo demez.
Da archivié sot a: co s’un jí da na ciasa che é stada tüa por 12 agn y da n paisc che é sté ciasa tüa por 45 agn alalungia, cun raisc familiares (& reperc) de dan da 150 agn. I sun finalmënter tl laur da m’un jí, por jí a chirí na cultura che respidlëia mi valurs.
#trasloché

@lorry
> Bumble is dire at Trust and Safety
Care to expand on that or link me?
> Whitney (Bumble) [is] a billionaire anyway, so what does she care?
I presume she didn't found Bumble by herself, maybe wasn't even part of the original group (as with Melon Husk and Tesla). What about the rest of them?
@screwlisp

(2/?)
@lorry
> I imagine there's still space for going back to the old model
There's plenty of new models to be tried that would be a huge improvement over playing hashtag roulette, either on DataFarms or decentralised social networks. One idea I saw was online dating as a group-based social experience. This is a handwave in the right direction. As is @cy's idea about matchmakers in another branch of this thread.

(3/?)
Speaking of roulette, what about a Chat Roulette style speed-dating app?
The app could;
* perform some basic T&S vetting (to minimise unsolicited dick-cam, etc), including confirming what general area you're in (ask me how!)
* throw you into a round of realtime speed dating with others in your area (text? Voice? Video? see 4/4).
* As with normal speed dating, if you both Favourite each other after talking, you get each others' contacts
#OnlineDating #ChatRoulette

@strypey I nearly joined #Chatroulette, but then Covid and the Ukraine war started, so that never went anywhere. I had a different direction I wanted to take them, though.
#Bumble #TrustAndSafety ? Well, the industry isn't exactly full of dating site whistleblowers, but safety workers in the industry do talk to me. I know more than I would ever want to know about the inside workings of most dating sites, and sadly. It's not really an amazing revelation that Bumble is as bad as the rest, though.
None of the dating sites puts more than a veneer of effort into T&S. They weigh the cost of litigation against the cost of actually doing the work, and so far, litigation costs have always been lower.

@lorry
> he industry isn't exactly full of dating site whistleblowers
Any particular reason for that?
> They weigh the cost of litigation against the cost of actually doing the work, and so far, litigation costs have always been lower
Huh. The Fight Club principle at work. Sad. We deserve better from our digital matchmaking tools.

My brother in He-Who-Shall-Not-Be-Named, what you are describing is a consequence of _misogyny_, not "misandry."

I desperately need men to realize that just because it's directed at them and an actual serious problem doesn't mean it is "misandry."
Just saw someone describe being discriminated against _for being considered effeminate_ as "misandry" and I just.

It's not that you aren't experiencing something real. You very well may be. But it isn't "misandry." Because "misandry" doesn't exist.
Yes, this applies to trans men as well. "Transmisandry" _also_ isn't a thing and just contributes to anti-feminist narratives. It treats itself as a mirror of transmisogyny, but transmisogyny is _intersective_: we experience transphobia _and_ we experience misogyny _and_ we experience this unholy thing that happens when the two interact. It's not a subset, even an exclusive subset, it's an intersection.
But the following all are absolutely problems that can be talked about!
* Transphobia/Transmisia
* Antitransmasculity
* Transemasculation
* Misogyny
It sucks to be discriminated against, but the language that we use is so, so important here.

Tinkering with my stereo system this week has got me thinking about an oddity that I've never been able to get to the bottom of...let's see if the Mastodon hive mine can help.
The amp is a Philips FA454 and the CD Player is a Philips CD150.
According to the amp manual I can connect the units with a "8-pole DIN to 5-pole DIN + 2 x single-pole CINCH" cable."
I take this to mean an 8 pin din to a 5 pin + stereo RCA cable...which sounds cursed.
Never been able to find one. Can anyone make one?

The service manual for the amp is nice and clear (picture 2 in above toot), but I can't find anything as nice for the CD player. I've attached a picture (picture 4 in the above toot) from the service manual that I *think* is the relevant section.
Currently I have the CD player hooked up with just the RCA cables and it all works fine, but if I could find/make the correct Din to Din + RCA cable then I could use some additional functionality and free up the only RCA stereo inputs on my amp.

There's a repair café this weekend in the town where I live...if I'm still puzzling over it all by then I might take it all along there and see if they can help me hack together a cable.
hypothesis:
I sun tl laur da ragagné pro mi implant stereo chisc dis y al m’é gnü en mënt na strambaria che i ne sun ciamó mai sté bun da stlarí... i odarun sce l’inteliënza coletiva de Mastodon pó me dé na man.
L’amplificadú é n Philips FA454 y l’aparat por CD é n Philips CD150.
Aladô dles istruziuns por l’adoranza dl amplificadú, pói colié i dui aparac cun n cabl “DIN da 8 poi a DIN da 5 poi + 2 CINCH da n pol su”.
Da me infora se tratera de n cabl DIN da 8 poi da öna na pert y DIN da 5 poi + RCA stereo dal’atra pert... ci che me pé na cossa bindebó intorta.
I ne sun mai sté bun da nen ciafé un. Fossel mo zacai che sciafia da nen fá?

Les istruziuns por l’adoranza dl amplificadú é dër tleres (foto 2 dl “toot” chiló dessura), mo i ne sun nia bun da ciafé val’ de plü tler por ci che reverda l’aparat por le CD. I á injunté n’imaja (foto 4 dl “toot” chiló dessura) tuta fora dal manual d’assistënza che i crëii sides la seziun importanta.
Al momënt é l’aparat por le CD ma colié tres i cabli RCA y al funzionëia indortöra. Mo sce i foss bun da ciafé o cherié le dër cabl DIN a DIN + RCA, podessi adoré n valgönes funziuns implü y desbloché le su ingres RCA stereo de mi amplificadú.

Chësta fin dl’edema, tla cité olache i viri, gnarál tigní n “repair café”. Sce i sun ciamó tl laur da me dé jö cun chësc problem, podessi porté döt iló y odëi sce ai é bugn da me daidé da mëte adöm le cabl.

source:
And being one of the weirdo, we just frequently get attacks here and there. Either online, offline, or even from your closest people. Those attacks usually stem from homophobia, transphobia, or sometimes just, don't like how weird we are and how weird we act, especially furries that do deeper immersions like roleplaying and therianthropy.

Hence some of us got safety by not needing to tell who we are and where we were from. Some of us got safety by only revealing ourselves to our friends or close friends. Face/body reveal is a culture that most of the furries did at least once in a private post, whether it be "delete soon" kind of post or in story.

Despite being so, we're still open for social interactions offline. We do furmeets—a personal meeting between furries, be it in a group or personal, be it in an event or just casually—and sometimes making a con/fur on, such as MWFF, IWAG, PAWAI, FURUM, and so on. It's fun to meet them offline, get to know each other, be able to see them in person as most of us have never seen each other's faces, take a photo to keep personally and censor publicly, laugh together and discuss similar interests, and so on. It's fun, social, and warm.

Although, things don't feel the same today. As people start trying to strip anonymity of people, attack furries, therian, LGBTQIA, and dox them, as how also our community participate and stir the dramas inside, things has been a little more chaotic, less warm, and less feeling like community or family. It's not the same anymore.

Part of me hopes things can return to how it feels in the 2000s and 2010s, but, I'll just let God do the rest. I'm a little hopeless in society and humans. I'm tired of how things get worse and meant to attack and divide small communities into a hopeless being. I don't like how society is now no longer respecting and being in unity.
hypothesis:
Y dal momënt che i aldun pro chi che vëgn aratá n pü’ strisciá, ciafunse gonot pataches olache mai. Online, dal vi o ince da chi che nes é plü daimpró. Por le plü nasceres dal’omofobia, dala transfobia o, datrai, porí ma dal fat che ala jënt ne ti scüsel nia tan demorvëia che i sun o la manira che i nes comportun. Chësc ti sozed dantadöt ai “furry” che vir le “fandom” te na manira plü sota, por ejëmpl cun le “roleplay” o la “teriantropia”.

Porchël se sintî tröc de nos plü al sigü zënza messëi dí che che ai ê o da olache ai gnô. N valgügn tolô la dezijiun da se mostré ma ai amisc o ales porsones a chëres che ai ti â dër crëta. Lascé odëi le müs o le corp é na cossa che, tla community “furry”, scialdi düc á fat almanco un n iade te n “post” privat, magari te un de chi olache al gnô scrit “eliminëia tosc”, o te na “story”.

Sambëgn sunse impó daverc ales interaziuns soziales dal vi. I organisun i “furmeet”, chël ó dí incuntades danter “furry”, sides de grup co de dui, tratan manifestaziuns o ma te na manira informala, y i tolun ince pert a “furry conventions” sciöche WWFF, IWAG, PAWAI, FURUM y tröpes d’atres. Al é bel da s’incunté de porsona, da se conësce damí y da podëi finalmënter se odëi dal vi, dal momënt che tröc de nos n’á mai odü le müs di atri. An fej fotografies da tigní coche recort, por se instësc o da publiché ascognon i müsc, an s’la rí deboriada, an baia di interesc che an partësc y an passa tëmp en compagnia. Al é na esperiënza da rí, da fá saurí y da sté saurí.

Mo incö ne pé les cosses nia plü les medemes. Dagnora plü porsones proa da ti tó l’anonimité ai atri, s’la tolon sö cun i “furry”, “therian” y les porsones LGBTQIA+ , rovan ince a fá “doxxing”. Tl medem tëmp, baldi, contribuësc ince nosta comunité instëssa al problem, alimentan dramesc y conflic interns. De conseguënza é l’ambiënt gnü plü caotich, manco da sté saurí y dá cotan manco la sensaziun da ester na comunité o na familia. Al n’é nia plü sciöche inlaota.

Na pert de me spera che les cosses pois indô ester sciöche ti agn 2000 y 2010, mo por le rest lasci döt tles mans de Dî. Oramai ái n pü’ pordü la crëta tla sozieté y tles porsones. I sun stüf da odëi les cosses gní peso y da odëi sciöche an proa tresfora da ataché y da despartí les pices comunités, cina da les fá sintí zënza speranza. La direziun che la sozieté á tut ne me plej nia: al me pé che al sides jü a perde le respet reziproch y le spirit de unité.

$partner has a video consult with Ikea to quote for a fitted kitchen. It's a fascinating glimpse into the ecosystem of online services for boomers.
1. They send link for video consult, three weeks ago. It uses Ikea's proprietary videoconf solution
2. They request the designs & 3D renders for the new kitchen
3. they send an email saying "thanks for sending through the design
4. We dial in today, they start the call with "our system blocked your files, let's design your kitchen together"
1/x

5. Partner asks if there's any way to share the (very detailed, took us like a full man week to put together) designs, but the Ikea salesdrone is on a script, and isn't having a bar of it.
6. The next step in the script is "laboriously do the design from scratch over the phone with the client, hunting and pecking on the keyboard and not fast using the UI of their design software"
2/x

7. They cannot share their screen, so it's a clown show of repeated misunderstanding about which part of which image is being referred to

8. the clock has just ticked past what should have been the full consult, and they're 35% the way thru getting the required measurements.

9. So far there's been literally 8 minutes of salesdrone laboriously inputting the measurements supplied
hypothesis:
$partner á na consulënza a destanza cun Ikea, por ciafé na oferta por la ciasadafüch da istalé. Al é na vijiun afascinanta tl ecosistem di sorvisc online por boomers.
1. Ai mëna n link por la consulënza a destanza, trëi edemes denant. Al vëgn adoré n program de videoconsulënza proprietar de Ikea
2. Ai se damana i designs y i renders 3D por la ciasadafüch nöia
3. Ai mëna n e-mail che dij "Dilan por avëi mené le design"
4. Incö se colegunse, ai mët man la telefonada cun "nosc sistem a bloché tü files, láscesse proieté adöm tüa ciasadafüch"
1/x

5. Le partner damana sce al é meso da partí i designs (dër detaiá, al nes á doré n’edema intiera i mëte adöm), mo le consulënt de Ikea se tëgn a n manoscrit che ne lascia nia pro chësc.
6. Le proscimo vare dl manoscrit é da "cherié la planificaziun danü al telefon cun le cliënt, fajon fadia da adoré so program, impede podëi lauré debota cun tüa software de design"
2/x

7. Ai ne pó nia partí so vidrel, porchël él n dër zircus de malintenüdes por capí sön ci pert dl’imaja che an se referësc.

8. La ora é mefodër jüda sora le tëmp preodü por na consulënza intiera fora, y ai á impormó abiné adöm le 35% dles mosoraziuns damanades.

9. Cina sëgn él passé leteralmënter 8 menüc, olache le consulënt â ma dé ite cun fadia i dac de mosoraziuns dá dant.

right, so, as i was saying, i dmed this very well known and very friendly seeming artist-type person and gave em the usual spiel:
- how bridge works
- how to bridge
- please do so because i want to follow you and reblog some of your stuff that i like
- if you don't want to, that's fine
and they responded "not doing that" which is all well and good but then they blocked me???
just like, for absolutely no fucking reason

not naming any names because i do NOT dislike anybody involved and i certainly do not want to incite any brigading, but this has happened with several people now, including people who have REBLOGGED AND LIKED BRIDGED POSTS FROM THIS ACCOUNT (my main), which is WHY I WANTED TO FOLLOW THEM

if they had just said "no thanks" they would have gotten an "ok, perfectly understandable! :)" or the like from me, but now everyone has to put up with my confused ranting instead. i'm not even angry, i'm just *genuinely baffled*

bsky people, is this a genuine issue over on your platform (because it's one i've almost *never* had over here on this side of the bridge) or am i just running into bad apple after bad apple

I honestly don't know what people's general feelings are about enabling the Bridgy Fed here, because that's just not a topic that ever comes up tbh (unfortunately)… But there's definitely some subset of people here who are super trigger-happy about the block button, I'm not a fan of this either.

source:
Ironing the lightweight green corduroy for my first try at the Sachi's Studio Newsboy Cap pattern. I don't know how I feel about the recommendation to use interfacing but it probably does want something to stiffen and thicken it a bit.
#millinery

Sachi's newsboy cap pattern advises to cut the crown pieces diagonal to the weave ("on the bias") to allow more stretch around the circumference but that will make the corduroy rows run aslant, where I prefer them vertical.
We shall see. This is the test cookie to get a feel for the pattern. I like corduroy for texture but green wouldn't be my first choice, and this fabric is lightweight enough that I should add a layer, whether interfacing or what-have-you from the stash.

On a second look, my fabric isn't corduroy at all, it's just velvet, so I can cut at 45° to the fabric weave like Sachi suggests in the Newsboy Cap pattern and it won't look strange.
#millinery
hypothesis:
I sun tl laur da sferié fora le cord vërt por mi pröm tentatif cun le model dl Newsboy Cap de Sachi’s Studio. I ne sá nia ci ponsé dla racomanaziun da adoré n flis mo bonamënter ól ester val’ che ne feji nia gní le tiesciü stare y gros.
#millinery

Le model de Sachi’s por le Newsboy Cap aconsiëia da taié i toc dla corona diagonalmenter dal fi ("sön le fi stort") por pormëte plü elastizité tla zirconferënza, mo cun chël vá les linies dl cord stort, deperpo che iö les ess plü ion roduntes.
I odarun. Chësta é na proa por ciafé la dërta sensibilité por le model. Cord me plej por süa consistënza, mo vërt ne metessi nia al pröm post y chësc tiesciü é tan lisier che i podessi mëte lapró n strat, sides cun flis che ince cun val’ d’ater che foss da tó ca.

Sce an ciara plü avisa n’é mi tiesciü gnanca cord mo ma lüch, porchël pói, sciöche aconsié da Sachi tl model dl Newsboy Cap, taié pormez a 45 degrá dal fi y al ne gnará nia feter.
#millinery
